## 1. Architectural Overview & Directory Hierarchy

The Agafari platform is structured as a single, hardened **Next.js 15 App Router monolith** backed by **MySQL**. The application codebase strictly enforces Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles across 4 isolated layers:

```
frontend/
  src/
    domain/          <- Rich Domain Entities, Value Objects, Domain Errors, Repositories
    application/     <- Use Cases, Application Services, DTOs
    infrastructure/  <- MySQL Connection Pool, Repositories, Redis Rate Limiter, Sentry Telemetry
    app/             <- Next.js App Router (14 UI Routes & 22 REST API Route Handlers)
    components/      <- Modular Feature UI Components (rsvp, scanner, feed, dashboard)
    config/          <- Zod Environment Schema & Configuration
    lib/             <- Security, Auth, Rate Limiting, Error Tracking Utilities
    locales/         <- Bilingual English & Amharic i18n Dictionaries
    types/           <- TypeScript Interfaces & Shared Types
```

## 2. Complete Source Code Files (117 Files)

### File: `frontend/db/001_schema.sql`

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- AGAFARI (አጋፋሪ) WEDDING PLATFORM — FIXED SCHEMA (Phase 3)
-- Replaces frontend/db/schema.sql. Fixes vs. the audited version:
--   - stray "]" syntax error in event_status_enum (was breaking this file)
--   - users.event_id removed (blocked an organizer from owning >1 event)
--   - organizers table + event_staff join table added (multi-tenancy, multi-role staff)
--   - templates + per-event customization added
--   - cms_sections added (admin-controlled landing page blocks)
--   - post_likes added (media_assets.likes_count was an unprotected counter)
--   - invitations.rsvp_locked_at added (2-day-before-wedding RSVP lock)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- =============================================================================
-- ENUM TYPES
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TYPE event_status_enum AS ENUM (
    'DRAFT',
    'COMING_SOON',
    'LIVE',
    'COMPLETED',
    'ARCHIVED'
);

CREATE TYPE admin_approval_enum AS ENUM (
    'PENDING',
    'APPROVED',
    'REJECTED'
);

-- Kept identical to the existing frontend enum values on purpose — every page
-- component and lib/auth.ts UserRole type already depends on these exact
-- strings, and renaming them would mean touching ~58 frontend files for no
-- functional gain. The fix for the "one event per user" problem is structural
-- (see `organizers` / `event_staff` below), not a role-name change.
CREATE TYPE user_role_enum AS ENUM (
    'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
    'EVENT_ORGANIZER',
    'BRIDE_GROOM',
    'LIVE_STREAMER',
    'GATE_SCANNER',
    'GUEST'
);

CREATE TYPE event_managed_by_enum AS ENUM (
    'ORGANIZER',
    'ADMIN'
);

CREATE TYPE staff_role_enum AS ENUM (
    'GATE_SCANNER',
    'LIVE_STREAMER',
    'CONTENT_MODERATOR',
    'QUOTA_DELEGATE'
);

CREATE TYPE rsvp_status_enum AS ENUM (
    'ATTENDING',
    'MAYBE',
    'DECLINED',
    'PENDING'
);

CREATE TYPE invitation_type_enum AS ENUM (
    'CARD',
    'LINK'
);

CREATE TYPE media_category_enum AS ENUM (
    'WISHES',
    'BTS',
    'LIVE'
);

CREATE TYPE media_type_enum AS ENUM (
    'VIDEO',
    'IMAGE'
);

-- =============================================================================
-- 1. USER ACCOUNTS (global identity — no event_id here, see event_staff below)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    full_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    role user_role_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GUEST',
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id), -- e.g. the admin who created an organizer login
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_role ON users(role);

-- =============================================================================
-- 2. ORGANIZERS (a EVENT_ORGANIZER user can own many events)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE organizers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    owner_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    business_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(50),
    created_by_admin_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_organizers_owner ON organizers(owner_user_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 3. TEMPLATES (couples pick one, then customize)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE templates (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    preview_url TEXT,
    config_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- =============================================================================
-- 4. WEDDING EVENTS TABLE
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    slug VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    managed_by event_managed_by_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ADMIN',
    organizer_id UUID REFERENCES organizers(id),        -- NULL when managed_by = 'ADMIN'
    couple_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),            -- the BRIDE_GROOM login for this event
    template_id UUID REFERENCES templates(id),
    template_customization_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    bride_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    groom_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    event_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    start_time VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '14:00',
    second_event_date TIMESTAMPTZ,
    venue_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    venue_address TEXT,
    venue_map_url TEXT,
    dress_code VARCHAR(255),
    welcome_message TEXT,
    cover_image_url TEXT,
    status event_status_enum DEFAULT 'COMING_SOON' NOT NULL,
    admin_approval_status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    is_live BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    thank_you_message TEXT,
    thank_you_image_url TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CHECK (
        (managed_by = 'ORGANIZER' AND organizer_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (managed_by = 'ADMIN' AND organizer_id IS NULL)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_slug ON events(slug);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_status ON events(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_date ON events(event_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_organizer ON events(organizer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_couple ON events(couple_user_id);

-- Multiple venues per wedding (ceremony / hall / melse, etc.)
CREATE TABLE event_locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,     -- "Church", "Reception Hall", "Melse Venue"
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    map_url TEXT,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_event_locations_event ON event_locations(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 5. EVENT STAFF (per-event role assignment — one user, many events, many roles)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE event_staff (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role staff_role_enum NOT NULL,
    assigned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(event_id, user_id, role)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_event_staff_event ON event_staff(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_staff_user ON event_staff(user_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 6. DIGITAL GUEST INVITATIONS & QR PASSES
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE invitations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    invite_type invitation_type_enum DEFAULT 'CARD' NOT NULL,
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    max_guests INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    table_number VARCHAR(100),
    rsvp_status rsvp_status_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    rsvp_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    rsvp_locked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,           -- set by scheduled job at (event_date - 2 days); NULL = still editable
    attending_headcount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    is_scanned BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    scanned_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    scanned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    qr_code_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_code ON invitations(invite_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_event ON invitations(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_is_scanned ON invitations(is_scanned);

-- =============================================================================
-- 7. 1-CLICK INSTANT RSVPS (also carries the singer/zemari recommendation —
--    kept merged per the Phase 2 confirmed decision, not split into its own table)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE rsvps (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invitation_id UUID REFERENCES invitations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50),
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    attendance_status rsvp_status_enum NOT NULL,
    attending_count INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    song_recommendation TEXT,      -- singer/zemari recommendation, free text
    dietary_notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_rsvps_event_id ON rsvps(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rsvps_status ON rsvps(attendance_status);

-- =============================================================================
-- 8. GUEST WISHES & BLESSINGS (text/video wishes to the couple)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE wishes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    media_type media_type_enum,
    video_url TEXT,
    status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    is_featured BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_wishes_event_id ON wishes(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_wishes_status ON wishes(status);

-- =============================================================================
-- 9. TIKTOK-STYLE VIDEO MEMORY FEED
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE media_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    uploader_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    media_type media_type_enum DEFAULT 'VIDEO' NOT NULL,
    category media_category_enum DEFAULT 'WISHES' NOT NULL,
    cdn_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    thumbnail_url TEXT,
    caption TEXT,
    views_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    likes_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,    -- kept as a fast-read cache, now driven by post_likes via trigger below
    status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    moderated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_media_event_id ON media_assets(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_category ON media_assets(category);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_status ON media_assets(status);

-- Per-guest like tracking (fixes the unprotected likes_count counter)
CREATE TABLE post_likes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    guest_identifier VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,   -- device/session id; guests aren't authenticated users
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(media_id, guest_identifier)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_media_likes_count() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        UPDATE media_assets SET likes_count = likes_count + 1 WHERE id = NEW.media_id;
        RETURN NEW;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        UPDATE media_assets SET likes_count = GREATEST(likes_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = OLD.media_id;
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_post_likes_insert AFTER INSERT ON post_likes
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE sync_media_likes_count();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_post_likes_delete AFTER DELETE ON post_likes
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE sync_media_likes_count();

CREATE TABLE media_comments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    comment TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_comments_media_id ON media_comments(media_id);

CREATE TABLE live_streams (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    started_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(20) CHECK (status IN ('SCHEDULED','LIVE','ENDED')) DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX idx_live_streams_event ON live_streams(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 10. MEZMUR & WEDDING MUSIC PLAYLIST
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE mezmur_playlist (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    artist VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'MEZMUR' NOT NULL,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_mezmur_event_id ON mezmur_playlist(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 11. ADMIN-CONTROLLED LANDING PAGE SECTIONS
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE cms_sections (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    section_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- 'memories_powered_by_agafari_card' | 'packages' | 'experience_agafari_live'
    content_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    updated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- =============================================================================
-- AUTOMATIC updated_at TRIGGER
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_events_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_invitations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON invitations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();

```

### File: `frontend/db/migration_gate_scan_logs.sql`

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Phase 3b addition — run this after db/schema.sql from Phase 3a.
-- Adds the gate check-in audit log (every scan attempt, not just the latest
-- status on the invitation row) — needed so double-scan attempts, offline
-- reconciliation, and "which staff member scanned this" are all reconstructable.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE gate_scan_logs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    invitation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES invitations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    event_staff_id UUID REFERENCES event_staff(id),
    result VARCHAR(20) CHECK (result IN ('VALID','ALREADY_SCANNED','INVALID','HEADCOUNT_EXCEEDED')) NOT NULL,
    headcount_admitted INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    client_scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,   -- timestamp from the scanner device (may be offline-queued)
    server_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_gate_scan_logs_invitation ON gate_scan_logs(invitation_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gate_scan_logs_staff ON gate_scan_logs(event_staff_id);

```

### File: `frontend/db/migration_quota_groups.sql`

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Phase 3e addition — run after Phase 3a's db/schema.sql and 3b's
-- migration_gate_scan_logs.sql.
--
-- Adds quota delegation: your original chat spec and the Phase 1 doc both
-- described a QUOTA_DELEGATE role, and staff_role_enum has included it since
-- Phase 3a — but no table ever backed it, and nothing enforced a delegate's
-- cap. This is that missing piece: a delegate (e.g. "the groom's uncle gets
-- 20 seats to fill himself") gets an allocation, then can add guest
-- invitations against it up to the cap, tracked and enforced server-side.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE quota_groups (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    delegate_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),  -- nullable: an admin/organizer can pre-create
                                                   -- an allocation before the delegate has a login
    delegate_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    delegate_phone VARCHAR(50),
    allocated_quota INT NOT NULL CHECK (allocated_quota > 0),
    used_quota INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CHECK (used_quota <= allocated_quota)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_quota_groups_event ON quota_groups(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_quota_groups_delegate_user ON quota_groups(delegate_user_id);

-- Ties an invitation back to the delegate whose allocation it was created
-- under. NULL means a "direct" invitation not counted against anyone's cap
-- (the normal case when an organizer/couple/admin creates it themselves).
ALTER TABLE invitations ADD COLUMN quota_group_id UUID REFERENCES quota_groups(id);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_quota_group ON invitations(quota_group_id);

```

### File: `frontend/db/migration_template_lock.sql`

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Phase 3e addition — run alongside migration_quota_groups.sql.
--
-- Backs the organizer template-review step from your spec: "the organizer can
-- change main things or essential things that must be different from couples
-- to couples." Once an organizer/admin has finalized their edits, they can
-- lock the template so the couple can't overwrite those changes by mistake.
-- =============================================================================

ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN template_locked_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN template_locked_by UUID REFERENCES users(id);
```

```sql
    venue_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    venue_address TEXT,
    venue_map_url TEXT,
    dress_code VARCHAR(255),
    welcome_message TEXT,
    cover_image_url TEXT,
    status event_status_enum DEFAULT 'COMING_SOON' NOT NULL,
    admin_approval_status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    is_live BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    thank_you_message TEXT,
    thank_you_image_url TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CHECK (
        (managed_by = 'ORGANIZER' AND organizer_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (managed_by = 'ADMIN' AND organizer_id IS NULL)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_slug ON events(slug);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_status ON events(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_date ON events(event_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_organizer ON events(organizer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_couple ON events(couple_user_id);

-- Multiple venues per wedding (ceremony / hall / melse, etc.)
CREATE TABLE event_locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,     -- "Church", "Reception Hall", "Melse Venue"
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    map_url TEXT,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_event_locations_event ON event_locations(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 5. EVENT STAFF (per-event role assignment — one user, many events, many roles)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE event_staff (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role staff_role_enum NOT NULL,
    assigned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(event_id, user_id, role)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_event_staff_event ON event_staff(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_staff_user ON event_staff(user_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 6. DIGITAL GUEST INVITATIONS & QR PASSES
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE invitations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    invite_type invitation_type_enum DEFAULT 'CARD' NOT NULL,
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    max_guests INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    table_number VARCHAR(100),
    rsvp_status rsvp_status_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    rsvp_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    rsvp_locked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,           -- set by scheduled job at (event_date - 2 days); NULL = still editable
    attending_headcount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    is_scanned BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    scanned_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    scanned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    qr_code_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_code ON invitations(invite_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_event ON invitations(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_is_scanned ON invitations(is_scanned);

-- =============================================================================
-- 7. 1-CLICK INSTANT RSVPS (also carries the singer/zemari recommendation —
--    kept merged per the Phase 2 confirmed decision, not split into its own table)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE rsvps (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invitation_id UUID REFERENCES invitations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50),
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    attendance_status rsvp_status_enum NOT NULL,
    attending_count INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    song_recommendation TEXT,      -- singer/zemari recommendation, free text
    dietary_notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_rsvps_event_id ON rsvps(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rsvps_status ON rsvps(attendance_status);

-- =============================================================================
-- 8. GUEST WISHES & BLESSINGS (text/video wishes to the couple)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE wishes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    media_type media_type_enum,
    video_url TEXT,
    status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    is_featured BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_wishes_event_id ON wishes(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_wishes_status ON wishes(status);

-- =============================================================================
-- 9. TIKTOK-STYLE VIDEO MEMORY FEED
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE media_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    uploader_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    media_type media_type_enum DEFAULT 'VIDEO' NOT NULL,
    category media_category_enum DEFAULT 'WISHES' NOT NULL,
    cdn_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    thumbnail_url TEXT,
    caption TEXT,
    views_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    likes_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,    -- kept as a fast-read cache, now driven by post_likes via trigger below
    status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    moderated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_media_event_id ON media_assets(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_category ON media_assets(category);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_status ON media_assets(status);

-- Per-guest like tracking (fixes the unprotected likes_count counter)
CREATE TABLE post_likes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    guest_identifier VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,   -- device/session id; guests aren't authenticated users
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(media_id, guest_identifier)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_media_likes_count() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        UPDATE media_assets SET likes_count = likes_count + 1 WHERE id = NEW.media_id;
        RETURN NEW;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        UPDATE media_assets SET likes_count = GREATEST(likes_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = OLD.media_id;
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_post_likes_insert AFTER INSERT ON post_likes
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE sync_media_likes_count();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_post_likes_delete AFTER DELETE ON post_likes
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE sync_media_likes_count();

CREATE TABLE media_comments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    comment TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_comments_media_id ON media_comments(media_id);

CREATE TABLE live_streams (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    started_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(20) CHECK (status IN ('SCHEDULED','LIVE','ENDED')) DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX idx_live_streams_event ON live_streams(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 10. MEZMUR & WEDDING MUSIC PLAYLIST
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE mezmur_playlist (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    artist VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'MEZMUR' NOT NULL,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_mezmur_event_id ON mezmur_playlist(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 11. ADMIN-CONTROLLED LANDING PAGE SECTIONS
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE cms_sections (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    section_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- 'memories_powered_by_agafari_card' | 'packages' | 'experience_agafari_live'
    content_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    updated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- =============================================================================
-- AUTOMATIC updated_at TRIGGER
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_events_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_invitations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON invitations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
```

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Phase 3b addition — run this after db/schema.sql from Phase 3a.
-- Adds the gate check-in audit log (every scan attempt, not just the latest
-- status on the invitation row) — needed so double-scan attempts, offline
-- reconciliation, and "which staff member scanned this" are all reconstructable.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE gate_scan_logs (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    invitation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES invitations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    event_staff_id UUID REFERENCES event_staff(id),
    result VARCHAR(20) CHECK (result IN ('VALID','ALREADY_SCANNED','INVALID','HEADCOUNT_EXCEEDED')) NOT NULL,
    headcount_admitted INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    client_scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,   -- timestamp from the scanner device (may be offline-queued)
    server_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_gate_scan_logs_invitation ON gate_scan_logs(invitation_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_gate_scan_logs_staff ON gate_scan_logs(event_staff_id);
```

### File: `frontend/db/migrations/003_quota_groups.sql`

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Phase 3e addition — run after Phase 3a's db/schema.sql and 3b's
-- migration_gate_scan_logs.sql.
--
-- Adds quota delegation: your original chat spec and the Phase 1 doc both
-- described a QUOTA_DELEGATE role, and staff_role_enum has included it since
-- Phase 3a — but no table ever backed it, and nothing enforced a delegate's
-- cap. This is that missing piece: a delegate (e.g. "the groom's uncle gets
-- 20 seats to fill himself") gets an allocation, then can add guest
-- invitations against it up to the cap, tracked and enforced server-side.
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE quota_groups (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    delegate_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),  -- nullable: an admin/organizer can pre-create
                                                   -- an allocation before the delegate has a login
    delegate_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    delegate_phone VARCHAR(50),
    allocated_quota INT NOT NULL CHECK (allocated_quota > 0),
    used_quota INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CHECK (used_quota <= allocated_quota)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_quota_groups_event ON quota_groups(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_quota_groups_delegate_user ON quota_groups(delegate_user_id);

-- Ties an invitation back to the delegate whose allocation it was created
-- under. NULL means a "direct" invitation not counted against anyone's cap
-- (the normal case when an organizer/couple/admin creates it themselves).
ALTER TABLE invitations ADD COLUMN quota_group_id UUID REFERENCES quota_groups(id);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_quota_group ON invitations(quota_group_id);

```

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- AGAFARI (አጋፋሪ) WEDDING PLATFORM — MYSQL / MARIADB SCHEMA
-- Converted from PostgreSQL schema.sql to MySQL 8.0+ / MariaDB syntax
-- =============================================================================

SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 0;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS post_likes;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS media_comments;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS media_assets;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS wishes;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS rsvps;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS invitations;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS event_staff;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS event_locations;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS live_streams;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS mezmur_playlist;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS templates;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS organizers;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cms_sections;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users;

SET FOREIGN_KEY_CHECKS = 1;

-- 1. USERS
CREATE TABLE users (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    full_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    role ENUM('SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'EVENT_ORGANIZER', 'BRIDE_GROOM', 'LIVE_STREAMER', 'GATE_SCANNER', 'GUEST') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GUEST',
    created_by VARCHAR(36),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_users_email (email),
    INDEX idx_users_role (role)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 2. ORGANIZERS
CREATE TABLE organizers (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    business_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(50),
    created_by_admin_id VARCHAR(36),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_organizers_owner (owner_user_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_organizers_owner FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 3. TEMPLATES
CREATE TABLE templates (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    preview_url TEXT,
    config_json JSON NOT NULL,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 4. EVENTS
CREATE TABLE events (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    slug VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    managed_by ENUM('ORGANIZER', 'ADMIN') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ADMIN',
    organizer_id VARCHAR(36),
    couple_user_id VARCHAR(36),
    template_id VARCHAR(36),
    template_customization_json JSON,
    bride_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    groom_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    event_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
    start_time VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '14:00',
    second_event_date DATETIME,
    venue_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    venue_address TEXT,
    venue_map_url TEXT,
    dress_code VARCHAR(255),
    welcome_message TEXT,
    cover_image_url TEXT,
    status ENUM('DRAFT', 'COMING_SOON', 'LIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'ARCHIVED') DEFAULT 'COMING_SOON' NOT NULL,
    admin_approval_status ENUM('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    is_live BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    thank_you_message TEXT,
    thank_you_image_url TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_events_slug (slug),
    INDEX idx_events_status (status),
    INDEX idx_events_date (event_date),
    INDEX idx_events_organizer (organizer_id),
    INDEX idx_events_couple (couple_user_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_events_organizer FOREIGN KEY (organizer_id) REFERENCES organizers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_events_couple FOREIGN KEY (couple_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_events_template FOREIGN KEY (template_id) REFERENCES templates(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 5. EVENT LOCATIONS
CREATE TABLE event_locations (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    map_url TEXT,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_event_locations_event (event_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_event_locations_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 6. EVENT STAFF
CREATE TABLE event_staff (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    role ENUM('GATE_SCANNER', 'LIVE_STREAMER', 'CONTENT_MODERATOR', 'QUOTA_DELEGATE') NOT NULL,
    assigned_by VARCHAR(36),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE KEY uk_event_user_role (event_id, user_id, role),
    INDEX idx_event_staff_event (event_id),
    INDEX idx_event_staff_user (user_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_event_staff_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_event_staff_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 7. INVITATIONS
CREATE TABLE invitations (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    invite_type ENUM('CARD', 'LINK') DEFAULT 'CARD' NOT NULL,
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    max_guests INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    table_number VARCHAR(100),
    rsvp_status ENUM('ATTENDING', 'MAYBE', 'DECLINED', 'PENDING') DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    rsvp_updated_at DATETIME,
    rsvp_locked_at DATETIME,
    attending_headcount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    is_scanned BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    scanned_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    scanned_at DATETIME,
    scanned_by VARCHAR(36),
    qr_code_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_invitations_code (invite_code),
    INDEX idx_invitations_event (event_id),
    INDEX idx_invitations_is_scanned (is_scanned),
    CONSTRAINT fk_invitations_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 8. RSVPS
CREATE TABLE rsvps (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    invitation_id VARCHAR(36),
    invite_code VARCHAR(50),
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    attendance_status ENUM('ATTENDING', 'MAYBE', 'DECLINED', 'PENDING') NOT NULL,
    attending_count INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    song_recommendation TEXT,
    dietary_notes TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_rsvps_event_id (event_id),
    INDEX idx_rsvps_status (attendance_status),
    CONSTRAINT fk_rsvps_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_rsvps_invitation FOREIGN KEY (invitation_id) REFERENCES invitations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 9. WISHES
CREATE TABLE wishes (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    media_type ENUM('VIDEO', 'IMAGE'),
    video_url TEXT,
    status ENUM('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    is_featured BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_wishes_event_id (event_id),
    INDEX idx_wishes_status (status),
    CONSTRAINT fk_wishes_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 10. MEDIA ASSETS
CREATE TABLE media_assets (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    uploader_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    media_type ENUM('VIDEO', 'IMAGE') DEFAULT 'VIDEO' NOT NULL,
    category ENUM('WISHES', 'BTS', 'LIVE') DEFAULT 'WISHES' NOT NULL,
    cdn_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    thumbnail_url TEXT,
    caption TEXT,
    views_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    likes_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    moderated_by VARCHAR(36),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_media_event_id (event_id),
    INDEX idx_media_category (category),
    INDEX idx_media_status (status),
    CONSTRAINT fk_media_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 11. POST LIKES
CREATE TABLE post_likes (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    media_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    guest_identifier VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE KEY uk_media_guest (media_id, guest_identifier),
    CONSTRAINT fk_post_likes_media FOREIGN KEY (media_id) REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 12. MEDIA COMMENTS
CREATE TABLE media_comments (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    media_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    comment TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_comments_media_id (media_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_comments_media FOREIGN KEY (media_id) REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 13. LIVE STREAMS
CREATE TABLE live_streams (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    started_by VARCHAR(36),
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
    started_at DATETIME,
    ended_at DATETIME,
    INDEX idx_live_streams_event (event_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_live_streams_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 14. MEZMUR PLAYLIST
CREATE TABLE mezmur_playlist (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    artist VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'MEZMUR' NOT NULL,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    INDEX idx_mezmur_event_id (event_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_mezmur_event FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 15. CMS SECTIONS
CREATE TABLE cms_sections (
    id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
    section_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    content_json JSON NOT NULL,
    updated_by VARCHAR(36),
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

```

### File: `frontend/db/schema.sql`

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- AGAFARI (አጋፋሪ) WEDDING PLATFORM — FIXED SCHEMA (Phase 3)
-- Replaces frontend/db/schema.sql. Fixes vs. the audited version:
--   - stray "]" syntax error in event_status_enum (was breaking this file)
--   - users.event_id removed (blocked an organizer from owning >1 event)
--   - organizers table + event_staff join table added (multi-tenancy, multi-role staff)
--   - templates + per-event customization added
--   - cms_sections added (admin-controlled landing page blocks)
--   - post_likes added (media_assets.likes_count was an unprotected counter)
--   - invitations.rsvp_locked_at added (2-day-before-wedding RSVP lock)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- =============================================================================
-- ENUM TYPES
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TYPE event_status_enum AS ENUM (
    'DRAFT',
    'COMING_SOON',
    'LIVE',
    'COMPLETED',
    'ARCHIVED'
);

CREATE TYPE admin_approval_enum AS ENUM (
    'PENDING',
    'APPROVED',
    'REJECTED'
);

-- Kept identical to the existing frontend enum values on purpose — every page
-- component and lib/auth.ts UserRole type already depends on these exact
-- strings, and renaming them would mean touching ~58 frontend files for no
-- functional gain. The fix for the "one event per user" problem is structural
-- (see `organizers` / `event_staff` below), not a role-name change.
CREATE TYPE user_role_enum AS ENUM (
    'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
    'EVENT_ORGANIZER',
    'BRIDE_GROOM',
    'LIVE_STREAMER',
    'GATE_SCANNER',
    'GUEST'
);

CREATE TYPE event_managed_by_enum AS ENUM (
    'ORGANIZER',
    'ADMIN'
);

CREATE TYPE staff_role_enum AS ENUM (
    'GATE_SCANNER',
    'LIVE_STREAMER',
    'CONTENT_MODERATOR',
    'QUOTA_DELEGATE'
);

CREATE TYPE rsvp_status_enum AS ENUM (
    'ATTENDING',
    'MAYBE',
    'DECLINED',
    'PENDING'
);

CREATE TYPE invitation_type_enum AS ENUM (
    'CARD',
    'LINK'
);

CREATE TYPE media_category_enum AS ENUM (
    'WISHES',
    'BTS',
    'LIVE'
);

CREATE TYPE media_type_enum AS ENUM (
    'VIDEO',
    'IMAGE'
);

-- =============================================================================
-- 1. USER ACCOUNTS (global identity — no event_id here, see event_staff below)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE users (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    full_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    role user_role_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GUEST',
    created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id), -- e.g. the admin who created an organizer login
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email);
CREATE INDEX idx_users_role ON users(role);

-- =============================================================================
-- 2. ORGANIZERS (a EVENT_ORGANIZER user can own many events)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE organizers (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    owner_user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    business_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(50),
    created_by_admin_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_organizers_owner ON organizers(owner_user_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 3. TEMPLATES (couples pick one, then customize)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE templates (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    preview_url TEXT,
    config_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- =============================================================================
-- 4. WEDDING EVENTS TABLE
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE events (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    slug VARCHAR(120) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    managed_by event_managed_by_enum NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ADMIN',
    organizer_id UUID REFERENCES organizers(id),        -- NULL when managed_by = 'ADMIN'
    couple_user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),            -- the BRIDE_GROOM login for this event
    template_id UUID REFERENCES templates(id),
    template_customization_json JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    bride_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    groom_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    event_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    start_time VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT '14:00',
    second_event_date TIMESTAMPTZ,
    venue_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    venue_address TEXT,
    venue_map_url TEXT,
    dress_code VARCHAR(255),
    welcome_message TEXT,
    cover_image_url TEXT,
    status event_status_enum DEFAULT 'COMING_SOON' NOT NULL,
    admin_approval_status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    is_live BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    thank_you_message TEXT,
    thank_you_image_url TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CHECK (
        (managed_by = 'ORGANIZER' AND organizer_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (managed_by = 'ADMIN' AND organizer_id IS NULL)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_slug ON events(slug);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_status ON events(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_date ON events(event_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_organizer ON events(organizer_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_events_couple ON events(couple_user_id);

-- Multiple venues per wedding (ceremony / hall / melse, etc.)
CREATE TABLE event_locations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,     -- "Church", "Reception Hall", "Melse Venue"
    address TEXT NOT NULL,
    map_url TEXT,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_event_locations_event ON event_locations(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 5. EVENT STAFF (per-event role assignment — one user, many events, many roles)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE event_staff (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role staff_role_enum NOT NULL,
    assigned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(event_id, user_id, role)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_event_staff_event ON event_staff(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_event_staff_user ON event_staff(user_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 6. DIGITAL GUEST INVITATIONS & QR PASSES
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE invitations (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    invite_type invitation_type_enum DEFAULT 'CARD' NOT NULL,
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    max_guests INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    table_number VARCHAR(100),
    rsvp_status rsvp_status_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    rsvp_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    rsvp_locked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,           -- set by scheduled job at (event_date - 2 days); NULL = still editable
    attending_headcount INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    is_scanned BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    scanned_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    scanned_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    scanned_by UUID REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    qr_code_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_code ON invitations(invite_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_event ON invitations(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_invitations_is_scanned ON invitations(is_scanned);

-- =============================================================================
-- 7. 1-CLICK INSTANT RSVPS (also carries the singer/zemari recommendation —
--    kept merged per the Phase 2 confirmed decision, not split into its own table)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE rsvps (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invitation_id UUID REFERENCES invitations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    invite_code VARCHAR(50),
    guest_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    guest_phone VARCHAR(50),
    attendance_status rsvp_status_enum NOT NULL,
    attending_count INT DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    song_recommendation TEXT,      -- singer/zemari recommendation, free text
    dietary_notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_rsvps_event_id ON rsvps(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_rsvps_status ON rsvps(attendance_status);

-- =============================================================================
-- 8. GUEST WISHES & BLESSINGS (text/video wishes to the couple)
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE wishes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    media_type media_type_enum,
    video_url TEXT,
    status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'APPROVED' NOT NULL,
    is_featured BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_wishes_event_id ON wishes(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_wishes_status ON wishes(status);

-- =============================================================================
-- 9. TIKTOK-STYLE VIDEO MEMORY FEED
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE media_assets (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    uploader_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    media_type media_type_enum DEFAULT 'VIDEO' NOT NULL,
    category media_category_enum DEFAULT 'WISHES' NOT NULL,
    cdn_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    thumbnail_url TEXT,
    caption TEXT,
    views_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    likes_count INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,    -- kept as a fast-read cache, now driven by post_likes via trigger below
    status admin_approval_enum DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
    moderated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_media_event_id ON media_assets(event_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_category ON media_assets(category);
CREATE INDEX idx_media_status ON media_assets(status);

-- Per-guest like tracking (fixes the unprotected likes_count counter)
CREATE TABLE post_likes (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    guest_identifier VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,   -- device/session id; guests aren't authenticated users
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(media_id, guest_identifier)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_media_likes_count() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
        UPDATE media_assets SET likes_count = likes_count + 1 WHERE id = NEW.media_id;
        RETURN NEW;
    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
        UPDATE media_assets SET likes_count = GREATEST(likes_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = OLD.media_id;
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_post_likes_insert AFTER INSERT ON post_likes
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE sync_media_likes_count();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_post_likes_delete AFTER DELETE ON post_likes
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE sync_media_likes_count();

CREATE TABLE media_comments (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    media_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES media_assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    comment TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_comments_media_id ON media_comments(media_id);

CREATE TABLE live_streams (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    started_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    youtube_video_id VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(20) CHECK (status IN ('SCHEDULED','LIVE','ENDED')) DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' NOT NULL,
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX idx_live_streams_event ON live_streams(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 10. MEZMUR & WEDDING MUSIC PLAYLIST
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE mezmur_playlist (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    artist VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    category VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'MEZMUR' NOT NULL,
    order_index INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_mezmur_event_id ON mezmur_playlist(event_id);

-- =============================================================================
-- 11. ADMIN-CONTROLLED LANDING PAGE SECTIONS
-- =============================================================================

CREATE TABLE cms_sections (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
    section_key VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,  -- 'memories_powered_by_agafari_card' | 'packages' | 'experience_agafari_live'
    content_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    updated_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- =============================================================================
-- AUTOMATIC updated_at TRIGGER
-- =============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_events_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();
CREATE TRIGGER trg_invitations_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON invitations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE PROCEDURE update_updated_at_column();

```

```html
    .diagram-container {

    .table-wrapper {

      <div class="diagram-container">
        <pre class="mermaid">
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Org as 🏢 Event Organizer
    actor Admin as 👑 System Admin
    actor Couple as 👰 Bride & Groom
    actor Guest as 👤 Guest
    actor Scanner as 🔍 Gate Scanner

    Note over Org,Admin: Phase 1: Onboarding & Approval
    Org->>Admin: POST /api/organizer/events (Submit new wedding)
    Admin->>Admin: Review & PATCH /api/admin/events (Status: APPROVED)
    Admin-->>Couple: Issue credentials (email + password)

    Note over Couple,Guest: Phase 2: Invitations & Engagement
    Couple->>Couple: Login -> /couple/dashboard
    Couple->>Couple: Generate QR invitations (Headcount quota)
    Couple-->>Guest: Distribute unique link (/event/slug?code=INV-XXX)
    Guest->>Guest: Open Hub -> 1-Click Instant RSVP (Yes/Maybe/No)
    Guest->>Guest: Submit text/video blessings -> Wish Wall

    Note over Couple,Scanner: Phase 3: Wedding Day Execution
    Admin->>Admin: Toggle Live Broadcast (isLive: true)
    Guest->>Guest: Watch Live Ceremony (/event/slug/live)
    Guest->>Guest: Upload video memories to TikTok Feed
    Scanner->>Scanner: Scan guest QR code at gate
    Scanner->>Scanner: Confirm check-in (Update scannedCount)

    Note over Couple,Admin: Phase 4: Archive
    Admin->>Admin: Mark event COMPLETED
        </pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Section 5: 1-Click RSVP Flow -->
  <section id="rsvp">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-header">
        <div class="section-num">Section 05</div>
        <h2 class="section-title">1-Click Instant RSVP Mechanism</h2>
        <p class="section-desc">The RSVP system is engineered for zero friction: the modal automatically appears 5 seconds after page load, requiring only a single tap to record the response immediately.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="diagram-container">
        <pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
    A["Guest Opens /event/[slug]"] --> B["Page loads event details & wish wall"]
    B --> C{"5-Second Timer Fires"}
    C --> D["RSVP Modal Emerges with 3 Choices"]
    
    D --> E["Choice 1: YES 🥂<br/>(Attending Confirmed)"]
    D --> F["Choice 2: MAYBE 🤔<br/>(Undecided)"]
    D --> G["Choice 3: NO 💔<br/>(Declined with Wishes)"]

    E --> H["Instant POST /api/events/[slug]/rsvp"]
    F --> H
    G --> H

    H --> I["Display Checkmark Confirmation Banner"]
    I --> J["Auto-dismiss Modal after 1.8 seconds"]
    J --> K["Update Guest Status in Couple Dashboard"]
        </pre>
      </div>

      <div class="grid-3" style="margin-top: 24px;">
        <div class="card" style="border-color: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.5);">
          <div class="card-title">🥂 Choice 1: YES</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            Saves status as <code>ATTENDING</code>. Confirms guest headcount and marks the invitation as confirmed on the couple's live dashboard.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card" style="border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5);">
          <div class="card-title">🤔 Choice 2: MAYBE</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            Saves status as <code>MAYBE</code>. Acknowledges response while allowing the guest to adjust their decision later before final catering lock.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card" style="border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5);">
          <div class="card-title">💔 Choice 3: NO</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            Saves status as <code>DECLINED</code>. Politely records non-attendance while inviting the guest to send their blessings on the Wish Wall.
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- Section 6: QR Gate Scanner Flow -->
  <section id="scanner">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-header">
        <div class="section-num">Section 06</div>
        <h2 class="section-title">QR Gate Verification Flow</h2>
        <p class="section-desc">The gate scanner system ensures venue security by validating unique invitation codes, tracking headcount quotas, and blocking duplicate entry attempts.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="diagram-container">
        <pre class="mermaid">
flowchart TD
    A["Security Staff Opens /scanner"] --> B["Input / Scan QR Code (INV-SD2026-XXX)"]
    B --> C{"Verify Code in Database"}

    C -->|"Valid & Unscanned"| D["🟢 VALID PASS<br/>Show Guest Name & Quota (e.g. 2 Heads)"]
    C -->|"Already Used"| E["🟡 ALREADY SCANNED<br/>Show Timestamp & Warning"]
    C -->|"Unknown Code"| F["🔴 INVALID PASS<br/>Show Access Denied Alert"]

    D --> G["Staff Selects Headcount & Taps 'Check In'"]
    G --> H["Update scannedCount & Set isScanned = true"]
    H --> I["Display Success Checkmark & Reset for Next Guest"]
        </pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
```

### File: `frontend/public/presentation.html`

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Agafari — Smart Digital Wedding Celebration Platform (Client Presentation)</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,600;0,800;1,400&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --gold: #D4AF37;
      --gold-light: #F3E5AB;
      --gold-dark: #997A15;
      --emerald-dark: #07120D;
      --emerald-card: #10261D;
      --emerald-border: #1E4535;
      --text: #F5F7F6;
      --muted: #A3B8AD;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      background: var(--emerald-dark);
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .container { max-width: 1140px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }
    
    /* Header */
    header {
      background: rgba(7, 18, 13, 0.95);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--emerald-border);
      padding: 16px 0;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }
    .nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
    .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
    .badge-gold {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-dark));
      color: #07120D;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .brand-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #FFF; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; }
    .btn-pdf {
      background: var(--gold);
      color: #07120D;
      border: none;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 13px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: transform 0.2s, background 0.2s;
    }
    .btn-pdf:hover { background: var(--gold-light); transform: scale(1.02); }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 70px 0 50px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15) 0%, rgba(7, 18, 13, 0) 70%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--emerald-border);
    }
    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 6px 16px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
      color: var(--gold-light);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      font-size: 46px;
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      color: #FFF;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .hero h1 span {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF 30%, var(--gold-light) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }
    .hero p {
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0 auto 30px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    /* Pillars Grid */
    .section-title {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      color: #FFF;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .section-desc {
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 14px;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto 36px;
    }
    .grid-4 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }
    .pillar-card {
      background: var(--emerald-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--emerald-border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }
    .pillar-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--gold);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    }
    .pillar-icon {
      font-size: 32px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;

      font-size: 17px;

    }

      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* Screen Walkthrough Showcase */
    .screen-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 36px;
      margin-bottom: 50px;
      background: var(--emerald-card);

      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 32px;
    }

    .screen-info { flex: 1; }

      font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
      color: #FFF;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .screen-badge {
      display: inline-block;

      border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);

      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .screen-visual {
      flex: 1;
      background: #060E0A;
      border: 1px solid var(--gold);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px;
      font-family: monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #A3E635;

    }

    /* Comparison Table */
    .table-box {

    }
    table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; }
    th {

      padding: 16px 20px;

    /* Packages */
    .packages-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }
    .pkg-card {
      background: var(--emerald-card);

    .pkg-subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .pkg-list { list-style: none; text-align: left; margin: 20px 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
```

```html
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 24px;
      margin: 24px 0;
      overflow-x: auto;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* Wireframe & Code Box */
    .wireframe-box {
      background: #040A07;
      border: 1px solid var(--gold);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 18px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #A3E635;
      margin: 12px 0;
      overflow-x: auto;
      white-space: pre;
    }

    /* Print Styles */
    @media print {
      header, .btn-pdf { display: none !important; }
      body { background: #FFF !important; color: #000 !important; }
      .card, .diagram-container, .table-box, .wireframe-box {
        background: #F9F9F9 !important;
        border-color: #CCC !important;
        color: #000 !important;
        break-inside: avoid;
      }
      .sec-title, .card-title, h1 { color: #000 !important; }

    }

  <!-- Section 2: Architecture & Security -->
  <section>
    <div class="container">
      <div class="sec-num">Section 02</div>
      <h2 class="sec-title">Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Architecture & Security</h2>
      <p class="sec-desc">A hardened Next.js App Router monolith backed by MySQL, structured cleanly into 4 distinct architectural layers.</p>

      <div class="grid-2">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">🏗️ 4-Layer DDD Architecture</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            <ul style="padding-left: 18px; margin-top: 8px;">
              <li><strong>Domain Layer (src/domain/):</strong> Rich domain entities, value objects, domain events, and repository interfaces. Completely decoupled from frameworks.</li>
              <li><strong>Application Layer (src/application/):</strong> Orchestrates use cases, application services, input/output DTOs, and transaction boundaries.</li>
              <li><strong>Infrastructure Layer (src/infrastructure/):</strong> MySQL connection pool, repository implementations, Upstash Redis rate limiting, and Sentry error tracking.</li>
              <li><strong>Presentation Layer (src/app/ & components/):</strong> Next.js Server & Client Components, API route handlers, and modular feature components.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">🛡️ Security & Hardening Features</div>
          <div class="card-body">
            <ul style="padding-left: 18px; margin-top: 8px;">
              <li><strong>JWT Cookie Auth:</strong> Cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 tokens stored in secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies.</li>
              <li><strong>Salted Password Hashing:</strong> PBKDF2-SHA512 algorithm with 16-byte random cryptographic salts.</li>
              <li><strong>Rate Limiting:</strong> Dual-layer protection (Upstash Redis + in-memory token bucket fallback) against brute force attacks.</li>
              <li><strong>Telemetry & Masking:</strong> Sentry integration with automatic masking of sensitive PII (passwords, emails, phone numbers).</li>
              <li><strong>Strict Env Validation:</strong> Zod schema validation ensuring all secrets exist before app startup.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
```

```typescript
import {
```
