```typescript
  Heart
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation, LanguageSwitcher } from '@/lib/i18n';

interface EventData {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  brideName: string;
  groomName: string;
  eventDate: string;
  startTime?: string;
  venueName: string;
  venueAddress: string;
  venueMapUrl: string;
  dressCode?: string;
  welcomeMessage?: string;
  coverImageUrl?: string;
  status: string;
}

interface MediaAssetData {
  id: string;
  eventId: string;
  uploaderName: string;
  mediaType: 'VIDEO' | 'IMAGE';
  category?: 'BTS' | 'WISHES' | 'LIVE';
  cdnUrl: string;
  thumbnailUrl?: string;
  caption: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED';
  createdAt: string;
}

interface InvitationRecord {
  id: string;
  inviteCode: string;
  guestName: string;
  guestPhone: string;
  maxGuests: number;
  inviteType: 'CARD' | 'LINK';
  rsvpStatus: 'ATTENDING' | 'DECLINED' | 'MAYBE' | 'PENDING';
  attendingHeadcount?: number;
  scannedCount: number;
  isScanned: boolean;
  qrCodeUrl?: string;
  createdAt?: string;
}

export default function ScopedCouplePortalPage({ params }: { params: { organizerSlug: string; eventSlug: string } }) {
  const { organizerSlug, eventSlug } = params;
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const [event, setEvent] = useState<EventData | null>(null);
  const [mediaAssets, setMediaAssets] = useState<MediaAssetData[]>([]);
  const [invitations, setInvitations] = useState<InvitationRecord[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Permitted total quota allocated by Organizer/Admin
  const [permittedTotalQuota, setPermittedTotalQuota] = useState(150);

  // Active Navigation Tab: 'GUESTS' | 'MEDIA'
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'GUESTS' | 'MEDIA'>('GUESTS');

  // Guest Submission Form State
  const [guestName, setGuestName] = useState('');
  const [guestPhone, setGuestPhone] = useState('');
  const [guestHeadcount, setGuestHeadcount] = useState(2);
  const [inviteType, setInviteType] = useState<'CARD' | 'LINK'>('CARD');
  const [submittingGuest, setSubmittingGuest] = useState(false);
  const [guestSuccessMsg, setGuestSuccessMsg] = useState('');
  const [guestErrorMsg, setGuestErrorMsg] = useState('');

  // Media Section Filters ('ALL' | 'BTS' | 'GATHERED')
  const [mediaSubTab, setMediaSubTab] = useState<'ALL' | 'BTS' | 'GATHERED'>('ALL');

  // Interactive Modal State for QR Pass & Card Download
  const [selectedInviteForPass, setSelectedInviteForPass] = useState<InvitationRecord | null>(null);
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState('');

  const fetchPortalData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [eventRes, mediaRes, invitesRes, quotaRes] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`/api/events/${eventSlug}`),
        fetch(`/api/events/${eventSlug}/media?status=ALL`),
        fetch(`/api/events/${eventSlug}/invitations`),
        fetch(`/api/events/${eventSlug}/quota`),
      ]);

      if (eventRes.ok) {
        const data = await eventRes.json();
        if (data.event) {
          setEvent({
            ...data.event,
            brideName: data.event.bride_name || data.event.brideName || 'Bride',
            groomName: data.event.groom_name || data.event.groomName || 'Groom',
            venueName: data.event.venue_name || data.event.venueName || 'Sheraton Addis Luxury Ballroom',
            eventDate: data.event.event_date || data.event.eventDate || '2026-09-20',
          });
        }
      }

      if (mediaRes.ok) {
        const data = await mediaRes.json();
        const rawItems = data.items || data.mediaAssets || [];
        setMediaAssets(
          rawItems.map((m: any) => ({
            id: m.id,
            eventId: m.event_id || m.eventId,
            uploaderName: m.uploader_name || m.uploaderName || 'Anonymous Guest',
            mediaType: m.media_type || m.mediaType || 'IMAGE',
            category: m.category || 'WISHES',
            cdnUrl: m.cdn_url || m.cdnUrl || '',
            caption: m.caption || '',
            status: m.status || 'APPROVED',
            createdAt: m.created_at || m.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
          }))
        );
      }

      if (invitesRes.ok) {
        const data = await invitesRes.json();
        const rawInvites = data.invitations || [];
        setInvitations(
          rawInvites.map((inv: any) => ({
            id: inv.id,
            inviteCode: inv.invite_code || inv.inviteCode || 'INV-0000',
            guestName: inv.guest_name || inv.guestName || 'Guest',
            guestPhone: inv.guest_phone || inv.guestPhone || '',
            maxGuests: inv.max_guests || inv.maxGuests || 1,
            inviteType: inv.invite_type || inv.inviteType || 'CARD',
            rsvpStatus: inv.rsvp_status || inv.rsvpStatus || 'ATTENDING',
            scannedCount: inv.scanned_count || inv.scannedCount || 0,
            isScanned: Boolean(inv.is_scanned || inv.isScanned),
            qrCodeUrl: inv.qr_code_url || inv.qrCodeUrl,
            createdAt: inv.created_at || inv.createdAt,
          }))
        );
      }

      if (quotaRes.ok) {
        const data = await quotaRes.json();
        if (data.totalAllocatedQuota) {
          setPermittedTotalQuota(data.totalAllocatedQuota);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load couple portal data:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPortalData();
  }, [eventSlug]);

  // Calculate current quota usage
  const currentTotalGuestsSubmitted = invitations.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + (inv.maxGuests || 1), 0);
  const remainingPermittedSeats = Math.max(0, permittedTotalQuota - currentTotalGuestsSubmitted);

  // Submit Guest Data to Organizer / System Admin
  const handleAddGuest = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGuestErrorMsg('');
    setGuestSuccessMsg('');

    if (!guestName.trim()) return;

    if (currentTotalGuestsSubmitted + guestHeadcount > permittedTotalQuota) {
      setGuestErrorMsg(`Exceeds your total permitted quota of ${permittedTotalQuota} guests! Remaining available seats: ${remainingPermittedSeats}.`);
      return;
    }

        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          guestName: guestName.trim(),
          guestPhone: guestPhone.trim(),
          maxGuests: guestHeadcount,
          inviteType,

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.invitation) {
        const newInv: InvitationRecord = {
          id: data.invitation.id,
          inviteCode: data.invitation.invite_code || data.invitation.inviteCode,
          guestName: data.invitation.guest_name || data.invitation.guestName,
          guestPhone: data.invitation.guest_phone || data.invitation.guestPhone || '',
          maxGuests: data.invitation.max_guests || data.invitation.maxGuests || 1,
          inviteType: data.invitation.invite_type || data.invitation.inviteType || 'CARD',
          rsvpStatus: 'ATTENDING',
          scannedCount: 0,
          isScanned: false,
          qrCodeUrl: data.invitation.qr_code_url || data.invitation.qrCodeUrl,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        setInvitations((prev) => [newInv, ...prev]);
        setGuestName('');
        setGuestPhone('');
        setGuestHeadcount(2);
        setGuestSuccessMsg(`✓ Successfully generated QR Pass & Invitation link for ${newInv.guestName}!`);
        setTimeout(() => setGuestSuccessMsg(''), 4000);
      } else {
        setGuestErrorMsg(data.error || 'Failed to submit guest data.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setGuestErrorMsg('Network error. Failed to generate guest pass.');
    } finally {
      setSubmittingGuest(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyCode = (code: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopiedCode(code);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(''), 2500);
  };

  const filteredMedia = mediaAssets.filter((item) => {
    if (mediaSubTab === 'ALL') return true;
    if (mediaSubTab === 'BTS') return item.category === 'BTS';
    return item.category === 'WISHES' || item.category === 'LIVE';
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-stone-950 text-white font-sans selection:bg-gold-500 selection:text-black">
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row min-h-screen">

        {/* Sidebar Navigation */}
        <aside className="w-full lg:w-72 bg-black/90 border-r border-gold-500/30 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-gold-500/20">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                </div>
                <div>

                    {event ? `${event.brideName} & ${event.groomName}` : 'Adeday & Addisu'}
                  </h2>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-gold-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    COUPLE'S PORTAL
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Event Meta Summary */}
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-stone-900/90 border border-stone-800 space-y-2 text-xs text-gray-300 font-light">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gold-400 font-medium">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gold-400" />
                <span>{event?.eventDate || '2026-09-20'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{event?.venueName || 'Sheraton Addis Luxury Ballroom'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Navigation Tabs */}
            <nav className="space-y-2">
              <button

                className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-between transition-all cursor-pointer ${

                    ? 'bg-gold-500 text-black shadow-gold'
                    : 'bg-stone-900/60 hover:bg-stone-900 text-gray-300 border border-stone-800'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                  <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>1. Guest List & QR Passes</span>
                </div>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${

                }`}>
                  {invitations.length}
                </span>

              <button

                className={`w-full p-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-between transition-all cursor-pointer ${

                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleCopyCode(`${window.location.origin}/event/${eventSlug}?code=${inv.inviteCode}`)}
                            className="px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-700 text-gray-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all border border-stone-700 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Copy Invitation Link"
                          >
                            {copiedCode.includes(inv.inviteCode) ? (
                              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: BTS & GATHERED MEDIA GALLERY */}
          {activeTab === 'MEDIA' && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setMediaSubTab('ALL')}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                      mediaSubTab === 'ALL'
                        ? 'bg-gold-500 text-black border-gold-400 shadow-gold'
                        : 'bg-black/60 text-gray-400 border-stone-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    All Media ({mediaAssets.length})
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setMediaSubTab('BTS')}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                      mediaSubTab === 'BTS'
                        ? 'bg-gold-500 text-black border-gold-400 shadow-gold'
                        : 'bg-black/60 text-gray-400 border-stone-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Behind The Scenes (BTS)
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setMediaSubTab('GATHERED')}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                      mediaSubTab === 'GATHERED'
                        ? 'bg-gold-500 text-black border-gold-400 shadow-gold'
                        : 'bg-black/60 text-gray-400 border-stone-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Guest Wishes & Gathered Clips
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {filteredMedia.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-12 rounded-3xl bg-black/80 border border-stone-800 text-center text-gray-400 space-y-2">
                  <Film className="w-10 h-10 text-gold-400/40 mx-auto" />
                  <p className="font-serif text-base text-white">No media uploads available yet</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Guest photos, videos, and behind-the-scenes clips will display here.</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                  {filteredMedia.map((media) => (
                    <div key={media.id} className="p-4 rounded-3xl bg-black/80 border border-gold-500/30 space-y-3">
                      <div className="aspect-video rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 relative">
                        {media.mediaType === 'VIDEO' || media.cdnUrl.includes('.mp4') ? (
                          <video src={media.cdnUrl} controls className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                        ) : (
                          <img src={media.cdnUrl} alt={media.caption} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="font-bold text-white">{media.uploaderName}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gold-400 font-semibold uppercase">{media.category}</span>
                      </div>
                      {media.caption && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 font-light bg-stone-900/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-stone-800">
                          "{media.caption}"
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

            </div>
          )}

        </main>
      </div>

      {/* QR PASS MODAL */}
      {selectedInviteForPass && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="max-w-sm w-full bg-black border-2 border-gold-500 rounded-3xl p-6 text-center space-y-6 shadow-2xl relative">
            <button
              onClick={() => setSelectedInviteForPass(null)}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-gray-400 hover:text-white p-2"
            >
              ✕
            </button>

            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-gold-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                OFFICIAL AGAFARI INVITATION PASS
              </span>
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-xl text-white mt-1">
                {selectedInviteForPass.guestName}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gold-400 font-semibold mt-0.5">
                Headcount Quota: {selectedInviteForPass.maxGuests} Persons
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="w-56 h-56 mx-auto bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-gold-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg">
              <img
                src={`https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=200x200&data=${encodeURIComponent(
                  JSON.stringify({ code: selectedInviteForPass.inviteCode, guests: selectedInviteForPass.maxGuests })
                )}`}
                alt="Guest Pass QR Code"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-stone-900 border border-stone-800 font-mono text-xs text-gold-400 font-bold">
              {selectedInviteForPass.inviteCode}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleCopyCode(`${window.location.origin}/event/${eventSlug}?code=${selectedInviteForPass.inviteCode}`)}
                className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-400 text-black font-extrabold text-xs shadow-gold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                <span>Copy Invitation Digital Link</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
  };

    setStoryCards(storyCards.filter((c) => c.id !== id));
  };

  const handleCardImageUpload = async (id: string, file: File) => {
    const compressed = await compressAndResizeImage(file, 1000, 700, 0.85);
    if (compressed) {
      handleUpdateStoryCard(id, 'image', compressed);
    }
  };

  const compressAndResizeImage = (file: File, maxWidth = 1200, maxHeight = 800, quality = 0.85): Promise<string> => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (e) => {
        const dataUrl = e.target?.result as string;
        if (!dataUrl) {
          resolve('');
          return;
        }
        const img = new Image();
        img.onload = () => {
          let width = img.width;
          let height = img.height;

          if (width > maxWidth) {
            height = Math.round((height * maxWidth) / width);
            width = maxWidth;
          }
          if (height > maxHeight) {
            width = Math.round((width * maxHeight) / height);
            height = maxHeight;
          }

          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!ctx) {
            resolve(dataUrl);
            return;
          }

          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
          const compressed = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
          resolve(compressed);
        };
        img.onerror = () => resolve(dataUrl);
        img.src = dataUrl;
      };
      reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  };

  const handleCoverFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const compressed = await compressAndResizeImage(file, 1200, 800, 0.85);
      if (compressed) {
        setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, coverImageUrl: compressed }));

    }
  };

  const handleCouplePhotoFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {

    if (file) {
      const compressed = await compressAndResizeImage(file, 800, 800, 0.85);
      if (compressed) {
        setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, couplePhotoUrl: compressed }));
      }
    }
  };

  const handleAudioFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      if (file.size > 20 * 1024 * 1024) {
        alert('Audio file size must be less than 20MB.');
        return;
      }
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => {
        const audioUrl = event.target?.result as string;
        if (audioUrl) {
          setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, backgroundAudioUrl: audioUrl }));
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

    const newItem: ProgramItem = {

      time: '06:00 PM',

      location: formState.venueName || 'Main Hall',
      description: 'Event description...'
    };
    setPrograms([...programs, newItem]);

    setPrograms(programs.filter((p) => p.id !== id));
  };

                      >
                        Approve
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleUpdateMediaStatus(m.id, 'REJECTED')}
                        className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs transition-all ${
                          m.status === 'REJECTED'
                            ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Reject
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteMediaAsset(m.id)}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-200 hover:bg-rose-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-rose-700 transition-all border border-slate-300"
                        title="Delete permanently"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
        const createdUser: UserData = {
          id: data.user.id,
          email: data.user.email,
          fullName: orgAgencyName.trim(),
          companyName: orgAgencyName.trim(),
          description: orgCompanyDesc.trim() || `Official certified event management partner (${orgAgencyName.trim()}).`,
          role: 'EVENT_ORGANIZER',
          temporaryPassword: effectivePassword,
        };

        setUsers((prev) => [createdUser, ...prev]);

        const orgIdVal = data.user.organizerId || `org-${data.user.id}`;
        const dedicatedLink = `/organizer/dashboard?id=${encodeURIComponent(orgIdVal)}`;

        setOrgSuccessMsg(`Agency "${orgAgencyName.trim()}" onboarded successfully! Dedicated Dashboard Link: ${dedicatedLink}`);
        setOrgAgencyName('');
        setOrgContactEmail('');
        setOrgCompanyDesc('');
      } else {
        setOrgErrorMsg(data.error || 'Failed to onboard agency partner.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to onboard organizer:', err);
      setOrgErrorMsg('A network error occurred while connecting to the server.');
    } finally {
      setCreatingOrg(false);
    }
  };

  // Password Reset Handler
  const handleResetPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!resettingUser || !newPasswordVal) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/users', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId: resettingUser.id, newPassword: newPasswordVal }),
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setUsers((prev) =>
          prev.map((u) => (u.id === resettingUser.id ? { ...u, temporaryPassword: newPasswordVal } : u))
        );
        setResettingUser(null);
        setNewPasswordVal('');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to reset password:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(''), 3000);
  };

  const toggleShowPassword = (key: string) => {
    setShowPasswords((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: !prev[key] }));
  };

  // Metric Computations
  const pendingApprovals = events.filter((e) => e.adminApprovalStatus === 'PENDING');
  const activeHosting = events.filter((e) => e.status !== 'COMPLETED' && e.status !== 'ARCHIVED' && e.adminApprovalStatus === 'APPROVED');
  const hostedArchives = events.filter((e) => e.status === 'COMPLETED' || e.status === 'ARCHIVED');
  const organizerUsers = users.filter((u) => u.role === 'EVENT_ORGANIZER');

  // Filtered Fleet
  const filteredEvents = events.filter((evt) => {
    const query = (searchFleetQuery || '').toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch = (evt.title || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
                          (evt.venueName || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
                          (evt.brideName || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
                          (evt.groomName || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
    if (!matchesSearch) return false;
    if (fleetFilter === 'ALL') return true;
    if (fleetFilter === 'ACTIVE') return evt.status !== 'COMPLETED' && evt.status !== 'ARCHIVED' && evt.adminApprovalStatus === 'APPROVED';
    if (fleetFilter === 'ARCHIVE') return evt.status === 'COMPLETED' || evt.status === 'ARCHIVED';
    if (fleetFilter === 'PENDING') return evt.adminApprovalStatus === 'PENDING';
    return true;
  });

  // Filtered Users
  const filteredUsers = users.filter((u) => {
    const query = (userSearchQuery || '').toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch = (u.fullName || '').toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
                          (u.email || '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
    if (!matchesSearch) return false;
    if (userRoleFilter === 'ALL') return true;
    return u.role === userRoleFilter;
  });

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden bg-white text-gray-900 flex font-sans selection:bg-gold-500 selection:text-black">
      
      {/* =========================================================================
          1. SYSTEM ADMIN EXECUTIVE SIDEBAR
         ========================================================================= */}
      <aside className={`
        fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-72 bg-gray-950 text-white flex flex-col justify-between border-r border-gold-500/30 transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out
        md:translate-x-0 ${mobileSidebarOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full'}
      `}>
        <div>
          {/* Brand Header */}
          <div className="p-6 border-b border-gold-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <img
                  src="/branding/artboard-13.png"
                  alt="Agafari (አጋፋሪ) Logo"
                  className="h-10 w-auto object-contain"
                />
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-gold-400 tracking-wide">
                    {t('adminDashboard.brand')}
                  </h2>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-gold-500/80 font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest block">
                    {t('adminDashboard.subtitle')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => setMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
                className="md:hidden p-1 text-white/70 hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Metrics */}
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px]">
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black/20 border border-white/5">
                <div className="text-amber-300 font-bold text-base">{pendingApprovals.length}</div>
                <div className="text-white/70 text-[10px]">{t('adminDashboard.kpiPending')}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black/20 border border-white/5">
                <div className="text-emerald-400 font-bold text-base">{activeHosting.length}</div>
                <div className="text-white/70 text-[10px]">{t('adminDashboard.kpiActive')}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Navigation Links */}
          <nav className="p-4 space-y-1.5 text-xs font-semibold">
            
            {/* 1. Licensing & Approvals */}
            <button
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab('APPROVALS'); setMobileSidebarOpen(false); }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'APPROVALS'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-gold-500 to-gold-600 text-black font-bold shadow-md'
                  : 'text-white/80 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-400" />
                <span>{t('adminDashboard.tabs.approvals')}</span>
              </div>
              {pendingApprovals.length > 0 ? (
                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-amber-950 font-bold animate-pulse">
                  {pendingApprovals.length}
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 text-gold-300 font-bold">
                  0
                </span>
              )}
            </button>

            {/* 2. Global Weddings Fleet & Role Command */}
            <button
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab('EVENTS'); setMobileSidebarOpen(false); }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'EVENTS'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-gold-500 to-gold-600 text-black font-bold shadow-md'
                  : 'text-white/80 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-400" />
                <span>{t('adminDashboard.tabs.events')}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 text-gold-300 font-bold">
                {events.length}
              </span>
            </button>

            {/* 3. Event Organizing Agencies */}
            <button
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab('ORGANIZERS'); setMobileSidebarOpen(false); }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'ORGANIZERS'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-gold-500 to-gold-600 text-black font-bold shadow-md'

            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-400" />
                <span>{t('adminDashboard.tabs.organizers')}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 text-gold-300 font-bold">
                {organizerUsers.length}
              </span>
            </button>

            {/* 4. Platform Users & RBAC */}
            <button
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab('USERS'); setMobileSidebarOpen(false); }}

                activeTab === 'USERS'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-gold-500 to-gold-600 text-black font-bold shadow-md'
                  : 'text-white/80 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'

            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-400" />
                <span>{t('adminDashboard.tabs.users')}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/40 text-gold-300 font-bold">
                {users.length}
              </span>
            </button>
          </nav>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/10 space-y-2">
          <Link
            href="/admin/login"
            className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-300 text-xs font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors"
          >
            <LogOut className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{t('nav.signOut')}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* Mobile Drawer Backdrop */}
      {mobileSidebarOpen && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setMobileSidebarOpen(false)}
          className="md:hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-40 backdrop-blur-sm"
        />
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          2. MAIN EXECUTIVE WORKSPACE
         ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex-1 md:pl-72 flex flex-col min-w-0">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-gold-500/30 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-gold-600 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">
                {t('adminDashboard.header.tag')}
              </div>
              <h1 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg sm:text-xl text-gray-900">
                {activeTab === 'APPROVALS' && t('adminDashboard.approvals.title')}
                {activeTab === 'EVENTS' && t('adminDashboard.fleet.title')}
                {activeTab === 'ORGANIZERS' && t('adminDashboard.agencies.title')}
                {activeTab === 'USERS' && t('adminDashboard.users.title')}

            </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0 ml-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowCreateModal(true)}

            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gold-400" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">{t('adminDashboard.header.createBtn')}</span>
            </button>

            <LanguageSwitcher />
          </div>
        </header>

        {/* Workspace Main Area */}
        <main className="p-6 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto space-y-6">
          
          {/* =========================================================================
              TAB 1: LICENSING & APPROVALS PIPELINE
             ========================================================================= */}
          {activeTab === 'APPROVALS' && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              
              {/* Header Box */}
              <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-white border border-gold-500/30 shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-gray-100">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="font-serif font-bold text-xl text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-gold-500" />
                      {t('adminDashboard.approvals.title')} ({pendingApprovals.length})
                    </h2>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-light mt-0.5">
                      {t('adminDashboard.approvals.subtitle')}

                  </div>

                  <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700" />
                    {pendingApprovals.length} Awaiting Verification
                  </span>
                </div>

                {pendingApprovals.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-12 text-gray-500 text-xs">
                    🎉 All wedding onboarding requests have been reviewed and approved!
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-4">
                    {pendingApprovals.map((evt) => (
                      <div
                        key={evt.id}
                        className="p-5 rounded-2xl border-[1.5px] border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/40 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 shadow-sm"
                      >
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 flex-wrap gap-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-200 text-amber-950 text-[10px] font-bold">
                                🟡 Pending Review
                              </span>
                              {evt.isIndividual ? (
                                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-100 text-purple-900 text-[10px] font-bold border border-purple-200">
                                  👤 Individual Event
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 text-[10px] font-bold border border-blue-200 flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <Building2 className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-700" />
                                  {evt.organizerName || 'Organizer Agency'}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-500 font-bold">
                              {new Date(evt.eventDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-gray-900">
                            {evt.brideName} & {evt.groomName}
                          </h3>
                          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                            <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gold-500" />
                            <span>{evt.venueName}</span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-white border border-amber-200 text-xs space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex justify-between">
                              <span className="text-gray-500 text-[11px]">Event Host / Company:</span>
                              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-900 text-[11px]">
                                {evt.isIndividual ? '👤 Individual Event (Direct)' : `🏢 ${evt.organizerName || 'Organizer Agency'}`}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between">
                              <span className="text-gray-500 text-[11px]">Couple Email:</span>
                              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-900">
                                {evt.coupleCredentials?.email || `couple@${evt.slug}.com`}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex justify-between">
                              <span className="text-gray-500 text-[11px]">Proposed Slug:</span>
                              <span className="font-mono text-gray-900 text-[11px]">/event/{evt.slug}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2 border-t border-amber-200">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleApproveEventRequest(evt.id)}

                          >
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                            <span>Accept & Approve Request ✓</span>
                          </button>

                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleRejectEventRequest(evt.id)}
                            className="py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
                            title="Reject Request"
                          >
                            <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                            <span>Reject ✗</span>
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Approved & Active Licenses Grid (2nd Image Card Style) */}
              <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl bg-white border border-gold-500/30 shadow-sm space-y-4">
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-gray-900">
                  {t('adminDashboard.approvals.approvedTableTitle')} ({events.filter((e) => e.adminApprovalStatus === 'APPROVED').length})
                </h3>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  {events.filter((e) => e.adminApprovalStatus === 'APPROVED').length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="md:col-span-2 p-8 text-center bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 text-gray-500 text-xs">
                      No active wedding platform licenses found. Create or approve your first wedding event to get started!
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    events.filter((e) => e.adminApprovalStatus === 'APPROVED').map((evt) => {
                      const rawOrgId = (evt as any).organizerId || (evt as any).organizer_id || `org-${evt.slug}`;
                      const cleanOrgId = String(rawOrgId).startsWith('org-') ? String(rawOrgId) : `org-${String(rawOrgId)}`;
                      const dedicatedUrl = `/${cleanOrgId}/${evt.slug}`;

                      const coupleEmail = evt.credentials?.couple?.email || evt.coupleCredentials?.email || `couple@${evt.slug}.com`;

                      return (
                        <div

                          className="p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gold-500/30 bg-gray-50/50 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all"

                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
                              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-black text-gold-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg shadow-sm shrink-0 border border-gold-500/30">
                                <Crown className="w-6 h-6 text-gold-400" />
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <div className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm">{evt.title}</div>
                                <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono">{coupleEmail}</div>
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-gold-600 font-mono font-bold mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                  <span>Wedding ID: <span className="bg-gold-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-black">evt-{evt.slug}</span></span>
                                  {evt.isIndividual ? (
                                    <span className="bg-purple-100 text-purple-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-sans text-[10px] font-bold border border-purple-200">
                                      👤 Individual Event
                                    </span>
                                  ) : (
                                    <span className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-sans text-[10px] font-bold border border-blue-200 flex items-center gap-1">
                                      <Building2 className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-700" /> {evt.organizerName || 'Organizer Agency'}
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 text-[10px] font-bold">
                              ✓ Certified License
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-gray-200 text-xs font-mono text-gray-600 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <span className="truncate text-[11px]">{dedicatedUrl}</span>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => {
                                navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${window.location.origin}${dedicatedUrl}`);
                                setCopiedKey(`approved-${evt.id}`);
                                setTimeout(() => setCopiedKey(''), 2500);
                              }}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-black text-gold-400 text-[10px] font-bold hover:bg-gray-800 shrink-0 ml-2"
                            >
                              {copiedKey === `approved-${evt.id}` ? 'Copied ✓' : 'Copy Link'}

                          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">

            </div>

          {/* =========================================================================
              TAB 2: GLOBAL WEDDINGS FLEET & 1-CLICK ROLE COMMAND (PILLAR 2)
             ========================================================================= */}
          {activeTab === 'EVENTS' && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              
              {/* Filter Pills & Search */}
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-gold-500/30 shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">

                    className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${

                  </button>

                  <button

                    className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${

                        ? 'bg-blue-800 text-white shadow-sm'
                        : 'bg-gray-50 text-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {t('organizerDashboard.fleet.archive')} ({hostedArchives.length})
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => setFleetFilter('PENDING')}
                    className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${

                  >
```

```typescript
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import DedicatedEventControlPage from '@/app/[organizerSlug]/[eventSlug]/page';

export default function AdminIndividualEventControlPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const slug = params.slug;

  const [organizerSlug, setOrganizerSlug] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function resolveAndRedirect() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/events/${slug}`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.event) {
            const orgId = data.event.organizerId || data.event.organizer_id || `org-${slug}`;
            const cleanOrgId = String(orgId).startsWith('org-') ? String(orgId) : `org-${String(orgId)}`;
            setOrganizerSlug(cleanOrgId);
            router.replace(`/${cleanOrgId}/${slug}`);
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error resolving organizer slug:', err);
      }
      const fallbackOrgId = `org-${slug}`;
      setOrganizerSlug(fallbackOrgId);
      router.replace(`/${fallbackOrgId}/${slug}`);
    }

    resolveAndRedirect();
  }, [slug, router]);

  return (
    <DedicatedEventControlPage
      params={{
        organizerSlug: organizerSlug || `org-${slug}`,
        eventSlug: slug,
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requireRole } from '@/lib/auth';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  try {
    const { sectionKey, contentJson } = await req.json();
    if (!sectionKey || !contentJson) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'sectionKey and contentJson are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const sectionId = `cms-${sectionKey}`;
    await query(
      `INSERT INTO cms_sections (id, section_key, content_json, updated_by)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
       ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
         content_json = VALUES(content_json),
         updated_by = VALUES(updated_by),
         updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`,
      [sectionId, sectionKey, JSON.stringify(contentJson), auth.user?.userId || 'admin-001']
    );

    const section = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM cms_sections WHERE section_key = $1', [sectionKey]);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, section });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to update CMS section:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update CMS section.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
// GET: every wedding event on the platform, with organizer/couple names and stats
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  let rawEvents: any[] = [];
  let dbSuccess = false;
  try {
    rawEvents = await query(`
      SELECT
        e.*,
        o.business_name AS organizer_business_name,
        cu.full_name AS couple_full_name,
        cu.email AS couple_email,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invitations i WHERE i.event_id = e.id) AS total_invites,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wishes w WHERE w.event_id = e.id) AS total_wishes,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_assets m WHERE m.event_id = e.id) AS total_media
      FROM events e
      LEFT JOIN organizers o ON o.id = e.organizer_id
      LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.id = e.couple_user_id
      ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
    `);
    dbSuccess = true;
  } catch (e) {
    // Database fallback to mockStore
  }

  if (dbSuccess) {
    return NextResponse.json({ events: (rawEvents || []).map(formatEvent) });
  }

  const mockUniques = mockStore.events.map(formatEvent);
  return NextResponse.json({ events: mockUniques });
}

// PATCH: approve/reject, change status, toggle live broadcast
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  try {
    const { eventId, adminApprovalStatus, status, isLive, youtubeVideoId } = await req.json();
    if (!eventId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId is required.' }, { status: 400 });

    try {
      const isLiveVal = isLive !== undefined && isLive !== null ? (isLive ? 1 : 0) : null;
      await query(
        `UPDATE events SET
           admin_approval_status = COALESCE($2, admin_approval_status),
           status = COALESCE($3, status),
           is_live = COALESCE($4, is_live),
           youtube_video_id = COALESCE($5, youtube_video_id)
         WHERE id = $1 OR slug = $1`,
        [eventId, adminApprovalStatus ?? null, status ?? null, isLiveVal, youtubeVideoId ?? null]
      );

      const event = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = $1 OR slug = $1', [eventId]);

      if (event) {
        // Keep mockStore in sync
        const idx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === eventId || e.slug === eventId);
        if (idx >= 0) {
          if (adminApprovalStatus) mockStore.events[idx].adminApprovalStatus = adminApprovalStatus as any;
          if (status) mockStore.events[idx].status = status as any;
          if (isLive !== undefined) mockStore.events[idx].isLive = isLive;
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event: formatEvent(event) });
      }
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.warn('DB PATCH event fallback:', dbErr);
      // DB failed, fallback to mockStore
      const idx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === eventId || e.slug === eventId);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        if (adminApprovalStatus) mockStore.events[idx].adminApprovalStatus = adminApprovalStatus as any;
        if (status) mockStore.events[idx].status = status as any;
        if (isLive !== undefined) mockStore.events[idx].isLive = isLive;
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event: formatEvent(mockStore.events[idx]) });
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update event.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE: remove an event (cascades to invitations/media/etc. via FK ON DELETE CASCADE)
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  const eventId = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('eventId');
  if (!eventId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId is required.' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const existing = await queryOne('SELECT id FROM events WHERE id = $1 OR slug = $1', [eventId]);
    if (!existing) {
      // Check mockStore
      const idx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === eventId || e.slug === eventId);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        mockStore.events.splice(idx, 1);
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Event deleted successfully from mock store.' });
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    await query('DELETE FROM events WHERE id = $1 OR slug = $1', [eventId]);

    // Also remove from mockStore if present
    const idx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === eventId || e.slug === eventId);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      mockStore.events.splice(idx, 1);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Event deleted successfully.' });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to delete event:', err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to delete event.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requireRole, hashPassword, sanitizeUser, UserRole } from '@/lib/auth';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

import { mockStore } from '@/lib/mockData';

// GET: list accounts — never returns password_hash or any plaintext password
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  try {
    const users = await query(`
      SELECT u.id, u.email, u.full_name, u.role, u.is_active, u.created_at,
             o.id AS organizer_id, o.business_name
      FROM users u
      LEFT JOIN organizers o ON o.owner_user_id = u.id
      ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
    `);

    const formatted = users.map((u: any) => ({
      id: u.id,
      email: u.email,
      fullName: u.full_name,
      full_name: u.full_name,
      role: u.role,
      companyName: u.business_name || u.full_name,
      company_name: u.business_name || u.full_name,
      organizerId: u.organizer_id || `org-${u.id}`,
      isActive: Boolean(u.is_active),
      createdAt: u.created_at
    }));

    return NextResponse.json({ users: formatted });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ users: mockStore.users });
  }
}

// These are the only values `users.role` (user_role_enum) actually accepts.
const GLOBAL_ROLES: UserRole[] = ['SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'EVENT_ORGANIZER', 'BRIDE_GROOM', 'LIVE_STREAMER', 'GATE_SCANNER', 'GUEST'];

// POST: create an account.
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  try {
    const { email, password, fullName, companyName, description, role, eventId } = await req.json();
    if (!email || !fullName || !role) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email, full name, and role are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!GLOBAL_ROLES.includes(role)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          error: `role must be one of ${GLOBAL_ROLES.join(', ')}.`,
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const effectivePassword = password?.trim() || `org${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;

    try {
      const existing = await queryOne('SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower($1)', [email.trim()]);
      if (existing) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `An account with email '${email}' already exists.` }, { status: 400 });
      }

      const newUserId = `usr-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;
      const effectiveName = (fullName || companyName || 'Event Organizer').trim();

      await query(
        `INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, full_name, role, created_by)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)`,
        [newUserId, email.toLowerCase().trim(), hashPassword(effectivePassword), effectiveName, role as UserRole, auth.user?.userId || 'admin-001']
      );

      let orgId = `org-${newUserId}`;
      if (role === 'EVENT_ORGANIZER') {
        const orgBizName = (companyName || fullName || 'Certified Event Agency').trim();
        await query(
          `INSERT INTO organizers (id, owner_user_id, business_name, created_by_admin_id)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)`,
          [orgId, newUserId, orgBizName, auth.user?.userId || 'admin-001']
        );
      }

      const newUser = await queryOne('SELECT id, email, full_name, role FROM users WHERE id = $1', [newUserId]);

      const userPayload = {
        id: newUser.id,
        email: newUser.email,
        fullName: newUser.full_name || effectiveName,
        full_name: newUser.full_name || effectiveName,
        role: newUser.role,
        companyName: companyName || effectiveName,
        company_name: companyName || effectiveName,
        description: description || `Official certified event management partner (${companyName || effectiveName}).`,
        organizerId: orgId,
        temporaryPassword: effectivePassword,
      };

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: true,
          message: `Account created successfully with role '${role}'.`,
          user: userPayload,
        },
        { status: 201 }
      );
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.warn('DB User Creation fallback:', dbErr);
      const newMockUser = {
        id: `usr-org-${Date.now()}`,
        eventId: eventId || null,
        email: email.toLowerCase().trim(),
        passwordHash: hashPassword(effectivePassword),
        temporaryPassword: effectivePassword,
        fullName: (fullName || companyName || 'Event Organizer').trim(),
        companyName: (companyName || fullName || 'Event Organizer').trim(),
        description: description || '',
        organizerId: `org-usr-org-${Date.now()}`,
        role: role as any,
      };
      mockStore.users.unshift(newMockUser);

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: true,
          message: `Account created successfully with role '${role}'.`,
          user: newMockUser,
        },
        { status: 201 }
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to create user account.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// PATCH: reset password or change role/name
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  try {
    const { userId, newPassword, fullName, role } = await req.json();
    if (!userId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'userId is required.' }, { status: 400 });
    if (role && !GLOBAL_ROLES.includes(role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `role must be one of ${GLOBAL_ROLES.join(', ')}.` }, { status: 400 });
    }

    try {
      await query(
        `UPDATE users SET
           password_hash = COALESCE($2, password_hash),
           full_name = COALESCE($3, full_name),
           role = COALESCE($4, role)
         WHERE id = $1`,
        [userId, newPassword ? hashPassword(newPassword) : null, fullName?.trim() ?? null, role ?? null]
      );
      const updated = await queryOne('SELECT id, email, full_name, role FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);

      if (updated) {
        // Keep mockStore in sync
        const idx = mockStore.users.findIndex((u) => u.id === userId);
        if (idx >= 0) {
          if (fullName) mockStore.users[idx].fullName = fullName;
          if (role) mockStore.users[idx].role = role as any;
          if (newPassword) mockStore.users[idx].temporaryPassword = newPassword;
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, user: sanitizeUser(updated) });
      }
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.warn('DB User update fallback:', dbErr);
      const idx = mockStore.users.findIndex((u) => u.id === userId);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        if (fullName) mockStore.users[idx].fullName = fullName;
        if (role) mockStore.users[idx].role = role as any;
        if (newPassword) mockStore.users[idx].temporaryPassword = newPassword;
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, user: mockStore.users[idx] });
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'User not found.' }, { status: 404 });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update user account.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { OrganizerService } from '@/application/services/OrganizerService';

import { DomainError, OrganizerHasActiveEventsError } from '@/domain/errors/DomainError';

const organizerService = new OrganizerService(
  new MySqlUserRepository(),
  new MySqlEventRepository()
);

// DELETE: remove an account & associated organizer profile
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
  if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;

  const userId = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('userId');
  if (!userId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'userId is required.' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const result = await organizerService.deleteOrganizer(userId);
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    if (err instanceof OrganizerHasActiveEventsError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 409 });
    }
    if (err instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 400 });
    }
    console.error('Failed to delete user:', err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to delete user account.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { RsvpService } from '@/application/services/RsvpService';
import { MySqlEventRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlEventRepository';
import { MySqlInvitationRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlInvitationRepository';

const rsvpService = new RsvpService(
  new MySqlEventRepository(),
  new MySqlInvitationRepository()
);

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const secret = req.headers.get('authorization')?.replace('Bearer ', '');
  if (process.env.CRON_SECRET && secret !== process.env.CRON_SECRET) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const maxRetries = 2;
  let attempt = 0;
  let lastError: any = null;

  while (attempt < maxRetries) {
    try {
      attempt++;
      console.log(`[CRON LOG] Executing RSVP lock scan (Attempt ${attempt}/${maxRetries})...`);
      
      const lockedCount = await rsvpService.lockEligibleRsvps();
      
      console.log(`[CRON LOG] RSVP lock scan completed successfully. Locked ${lockedCount} event(s).`);
      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        message: 'RSVP lock cron executed successfully.',
        lockedCount,
        attempts: attempt,
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      lastError = error;
      console.error(`[CRON WARNING] RSVP lock attempt ${attempt} failed:`, error.message || error);
      if (attempt < maxRetries) {
        await new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 1000)); // 1s backoff before retry
      }
    }
  }

  // Structured failure logging
  console.error('[CRON ALERT] All RSVP lock retry attempts exhausted. Final Error:', lastError);
  return NextResponse.json(
    { error: 'Failed to lock RSVPs after retries.', details: lastError?.message || String(lastError) },
    { status: 500 }
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';

const checkInService = new CheckInService(
  new MySqlEventRepository(),
  new MySqlInvitationRepository()
);

async function resolveEventOrRespond(slug: string) {
  const event = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [slug]);
  if (!event) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 }) } as const;
  return { event } as const;
}

// GET: list invitations for this event or resolve public invitation by code
export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const codeParam = searchParams.get('code');

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  // Public lookup for guest invitation links & QR passes (no auth token required)
  if (codeParam) {
    const raw = await queryOne<any>(
      `SELECT id, event_id, invite_code, invite_type, guest_name, guest_phone, max_guests, table_number,
              rsvp_status, rsvp_updated_at, rsvp_locked_at, attending_headcount,
              is_scanned, scanned_count, scanned_at, qr_code_url, created_at
       FROM invitations
       WHERE event_id = $1 AND LOWER(invite_code) = LOWER($2)`,
      [resolved.event.id, codeParam.trim()]
    );

    if (!raw) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invitation not found for this code.' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const invitation = {
      id: raw.id,
      eventId: raw.event_id,
      inviteCode: raw.invite_code,
      invite_code: raw.invite_code,
      inviteType: raw.invite_type,
      invite_type: raw.invite_type,
      guestName: raw.guest_name,
      guest_name: raw.guest_name,
      guestPhone: raw.guest_phone || '',
      guest_phone: raw.guest_phone || '',
      maxGuests: Number(raw.max_guests || 1),
      max_guests: Number(raw.max_guests || 1),
      tableNumber: raw.table_number || '',
      rsvpStatus: raw.rsvp_status || 'PENDING',
      rsvp_status: raw.rsvp_status || 'PENDING',
      attendingHeadcount: Number(raw.attending_headcount || 0),
      isScanned: Boolean(raw.is_scanned),
      is_scanned: Boolean(raw.is_scanned),
      scannedCount: Number(raw.scanned_count || 0),
      scannedAt: raw.scanned_at,
      qrCodeUrl: raw.qr_code_url,
      qr_code_url: raw.qr_code_url,
      createdAt: raw.created_at,
    };

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, invitation });
  }

  // Dashboard lookup: require authenticated user & event access for bulk guest list
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized — login required to access guest list.' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed && user.role !== 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const rawRows = await query<any>(
    `SELECT id, invite_code, invite_type, guest_name, guest_phone, max_guests, table_number,
            rsvp_status, rsvp_updated_at, rsvp_locked_at, attending_headcount,
            is_scanned, scanned_count, scanned_at, qr_code_url, created_at
     FROM invitations
     WHERE event_id = $1
     ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
    [resolved.event.id]
  );

  const invitations = rawRows.map((raw: any) => ({
    id: raw.id,
    inviteCode: raw.invite_code,
    invite_code: raw.invite_code,
    inviteType: raw.invite_type,
    invite_type: raw.invite_type,
    guestName: raw.guest_name,
    guest_name: raw.guest_name,
    guestPhone: raw.guest_phone || '',
    guest_phone: raw.guest_phone || '',
    maxGuests: Number(raw.max_guests || 1),
    max_guests: Number(raw.max_guests || 1),
    tableNumber: raw.table_number || '',
    rsvpStatus: raw.rsvp_status || 'PENDING',
    rsvp_status: raw.rsvp_status || 'PENDING',
    attendingHeadcount: Number(raw.attending_headcount || 0),
    isScanned: Boolean(raw.is_scanned),
    is_scanned: Boolean(raw.is_scanned),
    scannedCount: Number(raw.scanned_count || 0),
    scannedAt: raw.scanned_at,
    qrCodeUrl: raw.qr_code_url,
    qr_code_url: raw.qr_code_url,
    createdAt: raw.created_at,
  }));

// POST: create one invitation (single guest/family unit).
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized — login required to create invitations.' }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed && user.role !== 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });
  }


  try {
    const { guestName, guestPhone, maxGuests, tableNumber, inviteType } = await req.json();
    if (!guestName) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'guestName is required.' }, { status: 400 });

    // Use domain Ticket class — single source of truth for QR generation
    const inviteCode = Ticket.generateInviteCode();
    const qrPayload = Ticket.buildQrPayload(resolved.event.id, inviteCode, maxGuests ?? 1, SIGNING_SECRET);
    const qrCodeUrl = `${process.env.PUBLIC_APP_URL ?? ''}/scan?d=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(qrPayload))}`;
    const inviteId = `inv_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`;

    await query(
      `INSERT INTO invitations (id, event_id, invite_code, invite_type, guest_name, guest_phone, max_guests, table_number, qr_code_url)
       VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)`,
      [
        inviteId, resolved.event.id, inviteCode, inviteType ?? 'LINK', guestName.trim(),
        guestPhone ?? null, maxGuests ?? 1, tableNumber ?? null, qrCodeUrl,
      ]
    );

    const invitation = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE id = $1', [inviteId]);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, invitation }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Failed to create invitation:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to create invitation.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// PATCH: check in a guest by inviteCode (used by GateScanner component).
// Routes through CheckInService — same domain path as the dedicated /api/qr/[code] endpoint.
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id, ['GATE_SCANNER']);
  if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden — not a gate scanner for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

  try {
    const { inviteCode, checkInCount, maxGuests, sig } = await req.json();
    if (!inviteCode) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'inviteCode is required.' }, { status: 400 });

    // If a full QR payload with sig is supplied, route through CheckInService directly
    if (sig && maxGuests !== undefined) {
      const outcome = await checkInService.performCheckIn({
        eventId: resolved.event.id,
        inviteCode: inviteCode.trim(),
        maxGuests: Number(maxGuests),
        sig,
        admitCount: checkInCount ? Number(checkInCount) : undefined,
        staffUserId: user.userId,
        signingSecret: SIGNING_SECRET,
      });
      return NextResponse.json(outcome);
    }

    // Legacy path (no sig): look up the invitation from DB and build signed payload on the fly
    const row = await queryOne<any>(
      `SELECT id, max_guests, scanned_count, is_scanned, guest_name, table_number, invite_code
       FROM invitations WHERE event_id = $1 AND LOWER(invite_code) = LOWER($2)`,
      [resolved.event.id, inviteCode.trim()]
    );
    if (!row) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invitation not found.' }, { status: 404 });

    const builtSig = Ticket.signPayload(resolved.event.id, row.invite_code, Number(row.max_guests), SIGNING_SECRET);
    const outcome = await checkInService.performCheckIn({
      eventId: resolved.event.id,
      inviteCode: row.invite_code,
      maxGuests: Number(row.max_guests),
      sig: builtSig,
      admitCount: checkInCount ? Number(checkInCount) : undefined,
      staffUserId: user.userId,
      signingSecret: SIGNING_SECRET,
    });
    return NextResponse.json({ ...outcome, invitation: { guestName: row.guest_name, tableNumber: row.table_number, maxGuests: row.max_guests, scannedCount: outcome.admitted } });
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { result: error.name.replace('Error','').toUpperCase(), message: error.message, invitation: null },
        { status: error.name === 'AlreadyScannedError' ? 409 : 400 }
      );
    }
    console.error('Check-in error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Check-in failed.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const category = searchParams.get('category'); // WISHES | BTS | LIVE
  const guestIdentifier = searchParams.get('guestId'); // device/session id, for "did I like this"

  try {
    const event = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [params.slug]);
    if (!event) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });

    const user = getAuthUser(req);
    const access = user ? await checkEventAccess(user, event.id, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']) : { allowed: false as const };
    const isModerator = access.allowed;

    const rawStatus = searchParams.get('status');
    const statusFilter = (rawStatus === 'ALL' || rawStatus === 'null') ? null : (isModerator ? (rawStatus ?? null) : (rawStatus ?? 'APPROVED'));

    const rawItems = await query(
      `SELECT m.*,
              ${guestIdentifier ? '(pl.id IS NOT NULL) AS liked_by_me' : 'FALSE AS liked_by_me'}
       FROM media_assets m
       ${guestIdentifier ? 'LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.media_id = m.id AND pl.guest_identifier = $4' : ''}
       WHERE m.event_id = $1
         AND ($2 IS NULL OR m.category = $2)
         AND ($3 IS NULL OR m.status = $3)
       ORDER BY m.created_at DESC`,
      guestIdentifier
        ? [event.id, category || null, statusFilter, guestIdentifier]
        : [event.id, category || null, statusFilter]
    );

    const items = rawItems.map((item: any) => ({
      ...item,
      id: item.id,
      uploaderName: item.uploader_name || item.uploaderName || 'Guest',
      mediaType: item.media_type || item.mediaType || 'VIDEO',
      category: item.category || 'WISHES',
      cdnUrl: item.cdn_url || item.cdnUrl || item.url || '',
      thumbnailUrl: item.thumbnail_url || item.thumbnailUrl || null,
      caption: item.caption || '',
      viewsCount: Number(item.views_count || item.viewsCount || 0),
      likesCount: Number(item.likes_count || item.likesCount || 0),
      status: item.status || 'APPROVED'
    }));

    return NextResponse.json({ items, mediaAssets: items });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching media:', err);
    return NextResponse.json({ items: [], mediaAssets: [] });
  }
}

// POST: guest uploads a wish/BTS clip — always starts PENDING, a moderator must approve it
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  try {
    const { uploaderName, mediaType, category, cdnUrl, thumbnailUrl, caption } = await req.json();
    if (!uploaderName || !mediaType || !cdnUrl) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'uploaderName, mediaType, and cdnUrl are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const event = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [params.slug]);
    if (!event) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });

    const mediaId = `med_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`;
    await query(
      `INSERT INTO media_assets (id, event_id, uploader_name, media_type, category, cdn_url, thumbnail_url, caption, status)
       VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,'PENDING')`,
      [mediaId, event.id, uploaderName.trim(), mediaType, category ?? 'WISHES', cdnUrl, thumbnailUrl ?? null, caption ?? null]
    );

    const item = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1', [mediaId]);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, item }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to upload media.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// PATCH: like/unlike a post
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { mediaId, guestIdentifier, action } = await req.json(); // action: 'like' | 'unlike'
    if (!mediaId || !guestIdentifier || !action) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'mediaId, guestIdentifier, and action are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const targetMedia = await queryOne<{ id: string; category: string }>(
      'SELECT id, category FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1',
      [mediaId]
    );

    if (!targetMedia) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Media post not found.' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (targetMedia.category === 'LIVE') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Likes are disabled on live broadcasts.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    if (action === 'like') {
      const likeId = `like_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
      await query(
        'INSERT IGNORE INTO post_likes (id, media_id, guest_identifier) VALUES ($1,$2,$3)',
        [likeId, mediaId, guestIdentifier]
      );
    } else if (action === 'unlike') {
      await query('DELETE FROM post_likes WHERE media_id = $1 AND guest_identifier = $2', [mediaId, guestIdentifier]);
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "action must be 'like' or 'unlike'." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const updated = await queryOne('SELECT id, likes_count FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1', [mediaId]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, media: updated });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update like.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```
