```typescript
// Not for delegates themselves: a delegate sees their own remaining quota via
// GET /api/events/[slug]/invitations instead, scoped to just their guests.
export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed || access.via === 'STAFF') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let groups: any[] = [];
  try {
    groups = await query(
      `SELECT qg.*, u.email AS delegate_email
       FROM quota_groups qg LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = qg.delegate_user_id
       WHERE qg.event_id = $1 ORDER BY qg.created_at DESC`,
      [resolved.event.id]
    );
  } catch (err) {
    // If quota_groups table is absent, return empty list gracefully
    groups = [];
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ totalAllocatedQuota: 150, quotaGroups: groups });
}

// POST: create a new allocation. If delegateEmail is given and no account
// exists yet, creates one (role 'GUEST' globally, QUOTA_DELEGATE only via
// event_staff — same pattern as /api/events/[slug]/team) and returns a
// one-time temporary password. If delegateEmail is omitted, the allocation is
// created unlinked — useful for reserving seats before you know who's
// managing them; link it later with PATCH.
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed || access.via === 'STAFF') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const { delegateName, delegatePhone, delegateEmail, allocatedQuota } = await req.json();
    if (!delegateName?.trim() || !allocatedQuota || allocatedQuota <= 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'delegateName and a positive allocatedQuota are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    let delegateUserId: string | null = null;
    let temporaryPassword: string | null = null;

    if (delegateEmail) {
      let delegateUser = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower($1)', [delegateEmail.trim()]);
      if (!delegateUser) {
        temporaryPassword = `agafari${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
        delegateUser = await queryOne(
          `INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, full_name, role, created_by)
           VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'GUEST',$4) RETURNING id`,
          [delegateEmail.toLowerCase().trim(), hashPassword(temporaryPassword), delegateName.trim(), user.userId]
        );
      }
      delegateUserId = delegateUser!.id;
      await query(
        `INSERT INTO event_staff (event_id, user_id, role, assigned_by) VALUES ($1,$2,'QUOTA_DELEGATE',$3)
         ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id, role) DO NOTHING`,
        [resolved.event.id, delegateUserId, user.userId]
      );
    }

    const group = await queryOne(
      `INSERT INTO quota_groups (event_id, delegate_user_id, delegate_name, delegate_phone, allocated_quota, created_by)
       VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) RETURNING *`,
      [resolved.event.id, delegateUserId, delegateName.trim(), delegatePhone ?? null, allocatedQuota, user.userId]
    );

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: true, quotaGroup: group, ...(temporaryPassword ? { temporaryPassword } : {}) },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to create quota allocation.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// PATCH { quotaGroupId, allocatedQuota?, delegateEmail? }
// Raise/lower a cap (can't go below what's already used), or link a
// previously-unlinked allocation to a delegate's account after the fact.
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed || access.via === 'STAFF') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const { quotaGroupId, allocatedQuota, delegateEmail } = await req.json();
    if (!quotaGroupId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'quotaGroupId is required.' }, { status: 400 });

    const existing = await queryOne<{ used_quota: number }>('SELECT used_quota FROM quota_groups WHERE id = $1 AND event_id = $2', [
      quotaGroupId, resolved.event.id,
    ]);
    if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Quota allocation not found for this event.' }, { status: 404 });
    if (allocatedQuota !== undefined && allocatedQuota < existing.used_quota) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Can't set allocatedQuota below what's already used (${existing.used_quota}).` }, { status: 400 });
    }

    let delegateUserId: string | undefined;
    let temporaryPassword: string | null = null;
    if (delegateEmail) {
      let delegateUser = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower($1)', [delegateEmail.trim()]);
      if (!delegateUser) {
        temporaryPassword = `agafari${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
        delegateUser = await queryOne(
          `INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, full_name, role, created_by)
           VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'GUEST',$4) RETURNING id`,
          [delegateEmail.toLowerCase().trim(), hashPassword(temporaryPassword), 'Quota Delegate', user.userId]
        );
      }
      delegateUserId = delegateUser!.id;
      await query(
        `INSERT INTO event_staff (event_id, user_id, role, assigned_by) VALUES ($1,$2,'QUOTA_DELEGATE',$3)
         ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id, role) DO NOTHING`,
        [resolved.event.id, delegateUserId, user.userId]
      );
    }

    const updated = await queryOne(
      `UPDATE quota_groups SET
         allocated_quota = COALESCE($1, allocated_quota),
         delegate_user_id = COALESCE($2, delegate_user_id)
       WHERE id = $3 RETURNING *`,
      [allocatedQuota ?? null, delegateUserId ?? null, quotaGroupId]
    );

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, quotaGroup: updated, ...(temporaryPassword ? { temporaryPassword } : {}) });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update quota allocation.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Helper to sanitize & parse template customization JSON
function parseCustomization(customization: any) {
  let parsed = customization;
  if (typeof customization === 'string') {
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(customization);
    } catch (e) {
      parsed = {};
    }
  }
  return parsed || {};
}

// PUT / PATCH: update event details from Organizer Control Page
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  return handleUpdate(req, params.slug);
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  return handleUpdate(req, params.slug);
}

async function handleUpdate(req: NextRequest, slug: string) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const {
      brideName,
      groomName,
      title,
      venueName,
      venueAddress,
      venueMapUrl,
      eventDate,
      startTime,
      dressCode,
      welcomeMessage,
      coverImageUrl,
      backgroundAudioUrl,
      couplePhotoUrl,
      isLive,
      youtubeVideoId,
      status,
      loveStory,
      programs,
      additionalLocations
    } = body;

    try {
      const existing = await queryOne<{ id: string; template_customization_json: any }>(
        'SELECT id, template_customization_json FROM events WHERE LOWER(slug) = LOWER($1)',
        [slug]
      );

      if (existing) {
        const currentCustomization = parseCustomization(existing.template_customization_json);
        const updatedCustomization = {
          ...currentCustomization,
          backgroundAudioUrl: backgroundAudioUrl !== undefined ? backgroundAudioUrl : currentCustomization.backgroundAudioUrl,
          couplePhotoUrl: couplePhotoUrl !== undefined ? couplePhotoUrl : currentCustomization.couplePhotoUrl,
          loveStory: loveStory !== undefined ? loveStory : currentCustomization.loveStory,
          programs: programs !== undefined ? programs : currentCustomization.programs,
          additionalLocations: additionalLocations !== undefined ? additionalLocations : currentCustomization.additionalLocations
        };

        let formattedEventDate: string | null = null;
        if (eventDate) {
          try {
            formattedEventDate = new Date(eventDate).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ');
          } catch (e) {
            formattedEventDate = eventDate;
          }
        }

        await query(
          `UPDATE events SET
             bride_name = COALESCE($1, bride_name),
             groom_name = COALESCE($2, groom_name),
             title = COALESCE($3, title),
             venue_name = COALESCE($4, venue_name),
             venue_address = COALESCE($5, venue_address),
             venue_map_url = COALESCE($6, venue_map_url),
             event_date = COALESCE($7, event_date),
             start_time = COALESCE($8, start_time),
             dress_code = COALESCE($9, dress_code),
             welcome_message = COALESCE($10, welcome_message),
             cover_image_url = COALESCE($11, cover_image_url),
             background_audio_url = COALESCE($12, background_audio_url),
             is_live = COALESCE($13, is_live),
             youtube_video_id = COALESCE($14, youtube_video_id),
             status = COALESCE($15, status),
             template_customization_json = $16
           WHERE id = $17`,
          [
            brideName ?? null,
            groomName ?? null,
            title ?? null,
            venueName ?? null,
            venueAddress ?? null,
            venueMapUrl ?? null,
            formattedEventDate,
            startTime ?? null,
            dressCode ?? null,
            welcomeMessage ?? null,
            coverImageUrl ?? null,
            backgroundAudioUrl ?? null,
            isLive !== undefined && isLive !== null ? (isLive ? 1 : 0) : null,
            youtubeVideoId ?? null,
            status ?? null,
            JSON.stringify(updatedCustomization),
            existing.id
          ]
        );

        const updated = await queryOne(
          'SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = $1',
          [existing.id]
        );

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event: updated });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to update event in DB:', e);
    }

    // In-memory mockStore update fallback
    const mockEvt = mockStore.events.find((e) => e.slug?.toLowerCase() === slug.toLowerCase());
    if (mockEvt) {
      if (brideName !== undefined) mockEvt.brideName = brideName;
      if (groomName !== undefined) mockEvt.groomName = groomName;
      if (title !== undefined) mockEvt.title = title;
      if (venueName !== undefined) mockEvt.venueName = venueName;
      if (venueAddress !== undefined) mockEvt.venueAddress = venueAddress;
      if (venueMapUrl !== undefined) mockEvt.venueMapUrl = venueMapUrl;
      if (eventDate !== undefined) mockEvt.eventDate = eventDate;
      if (dressCode !== undefined) mockEvt.dressCode = dressCode;
      if (welcomeMessage !== undefined) mockEvt.welcomeMessage = welcomeMessage;
      if (coverImageUrl !== undefined) mockEvt.coverImageUrl = coverImageUrl;
      if (isLive !== undefined) mockEvt.isLive = isLive;
      if (youtubeVideoId !== undefined) mockEvt.youtubeVideoId = youtubeVideoId;
      if (status !== undefined) mockEvt.status = status;

      return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event: mockEvt });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to update event:', err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update event.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { RsvpService } from '@/application/services/RsvpService';
import { MySqlEventRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlEventRepository';
import { MySqlInvitationRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlInvitationRepository';
import { DomainError, RsvpLockedError, NotFoundError } from '@/domain/errors/DomainError';
import { captureException } from '@/lib/errorTracking';
import { verifyRateLimit, getClientIp, buildRateLimitResponse } from '@/lib/rateLimit';

const rsvpService = new RsvpService(
  new MySqlEventRepository(),
  new MySqlInvitationRepository()
);

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  try {
    const { inviteCode, attendanceStatus, attendingCount, songRecommendation, dietaryNotes, guestName, guestPhone } =
      await req.json();

    const clientIp = getClientIp(req);
    const rateLimitKey = `rsvp:${params.slug}:${inviteCode || clientIp}`;
    const rateLimitRes = await verifyRateLimit(rateLimitKey, { max: 5, windowSeconds: 600 });
    if (!rateLimitRes.success) {
      return buildRateLimitResponse(rateLimitRes);
    }

    if (!attendanceStatus) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'attendanceStatus is required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }


    const result = await rsvpService.submitRsvp({
      slug: params.slug,
      inviteCode,
      attendanceStatus,
      attendingCount: attendingCount ? Number(attendingCount) : undefined,
      songRecommendation,
      dietaryNotes,
      guestName,
      guestPhone,
    });

    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (error: any) {
    captureException(error, { route: '/api/events/[slug]/rsvp', eventSlug: params.slug });
    if (error instanceof RsvpLockedError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });
    }
    if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 404 });
    }
    if (error instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to submit RSVP.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser, hashPassword } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

async function resolveEventOrRespond(slug: string) {
  const event = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [slug]);
  if (!event) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 }) } as const;
  return { event } as const;
}

// GET: list everyone staffing this event
export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

  const team = await query(
    `SELECT es.id, es.role, u.id AS user_id, u.full_name, u.email, es.created_at
     FROM event_staff es JOIN users u ON u.id = es.user_id
     WHERE es.event_id = $1 ORDER BY es.role, u.full_name`,
    [resolved.event.id]
  );

  return NextResponse.json({ team });
}

// POST: assign staff. If email doesn't exist yet, creates the account and returns
// a one-time temporary password — same "show once, never again" rule as elsewhere.
//
// FIXED BUG: this used to do
//   INSERT INTO users (..., role, ...) VALUES (..., $4, ...)   -- $4 = the staff role
// but `users.role` is `user_role_enum`, which only has SYSTEM_ADMIN, EVENT_ORGANIZER,
// BRIDE_GROOM, LIVE_STREAMER, GATE_SCANNER, GUEST — it does NOT include
// CONTENT_MODERATOR or QUOTA_DELEGATE (those only exist on `staff_role_enum`,
// i.e. on `event_staff.role`, which is a separate column). Assigning either of
// those two roles to a brand-new email crashed with a Postgres invalid-enum-value
// error every time — the content-moderator and quota-delegate dashboards were
// therefore impossible to staff via this route. Fixed by giving new staff
// accounts the generic 'GUEST' global role; the real job lives on `event_staff.role`,
// exactly like a GATE_SCANNER or LIVE_STREAMER's global role is separate from
// what they can actually do (this route just happened to get away with
// reusing the same string for those two by coincidence, since they *are*
// valid enum members on both types).
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  // Only organizer/couple/admin may assign staff — not staff assigning staff.
  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed || access.via === 'STAFF') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const { email, fullName, role } = await req.json();
    const validRoles = ['GATE_SCANNER', 'LIVE_STREAMER', 'CONTENT_MODERATOR', 'QUOTA_DELEGATE'];
    if (!email || !fullName || !validRoles.includes(role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `role must be one of ${validRoles.join(', ')}.` }, { status: 400 });
    }

    let staffUser = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower($1)', [email.trim()]);
    let temporaryPassword: string | null = null;

    if (!staffUser) {
      temporaryPassword = `agafari${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
      staffUser = await queryOne(
        `INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, full_name, role, created_by)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'GUEST',$4) RETURNING id`,
        [email.toLowerCase().trim(), hashPassword(temporaryPassword), fullName.trim(), user.userId]
      );
    }

    const assignment = await queryOne(
      `INSERT INTO event_staff (event_id, user_id, role, assigned_by) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
       ON CONFLICT (event_id, user_id, role) DO NOTHING RETURNING *`,
      [resolved.event.id, staffUser!.id, role, user.userId]
    );

    if (!assignment) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'This person already has that role on this event.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: true, assignment, ...(temporaryPassword ? { temporaryPassword } : {}) },
      { status: 201 }
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to assign staff.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE: remove a staff assignment (?assignmentId=)
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const resolved = await resolveEventOrRespond(params.slug);
  if ('error' in resolved) return resolved.error;

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, resolved.event.id);
  if (!access.allowed || access.via === 'STAFF') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const assignmentId = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('assignmentId');
  if (!assignmentId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'assignmentId is required.' }, { status: 400 });

  const deleted = await queryOne(
    'DELETE FROM event_staff WHERE id = $1 AND event_id = $2 RETURNING id',
    [assignmentId, resolved.event.id]
  );
  if (!deleted) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Assignment not found.' }, { status: 404 });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { TemplateService } from '@/application/services/TemplateService';
import { MySqlEventRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlEventRepository';
import { DomainError, ForbiddenError, NotFoundError } from '@/domain/errors/DomainError';

const templateService = new TemplateService(new MySqlEventRepository());

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const { templateId, customization, lock } = await req.json();

    const updated = await templateService.updateTemplate({
      slug: params.slug,
      templateId,
      customization,
      lock,
      userId: user.userId,
      userRole: user.role,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event: updated.props });
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error instanceof NotFoundError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 404 });
    }
    if (error instanceof ForbiddenError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 403 });
    }
    if (error instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
    }
    console.error('Template update error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update template.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';
import { verifyRateLimit, getClientIp, buildRateLimitResponse } from '@/lib/rateLimit';

// GET: the couple's public wishes wall. Guests only ever see APPROVED wishes;
// an organizer/couple/admin/moderator can pass ?status= to review PENDING/REJECTED.
// (Text wishes default to APPROVED per schema — auto-publish is the intended
// behavior here, unlike video posts which always start PENDING. Anything that
// slips through gets taken down after the fact via /api/organizer/wishes.)
export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const requestedStatus = searchParams.get('status');

  const event = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [params.slug]);
  if (!event) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });

  let statusFilter: string | null = 'APPROVED';
  if (requestedStatus) {
    const user = getAuthUser(req);
    const access = user ? await checkEventAccess(user, event.id, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']) : { allowed: false as const };
    if (access.allowed) statusFilter = requestedStatus;
    // if not authorized to see other statuses, silently fall back to APPROVED
    // rather than erroring — this endpoint is also hit by the public page.
  }

  const wishes = await query(
    `SELECT id, sender_name, message, media_type, video_url, is_featured, created_at
     FROM wishes WHERE event_id = $1 AND ($2 IS NULL OR status = $2)
     ORDER BY is_featured DESC, created_at DESC`,
    [event.id, statusFilter]
  );

  return NextResponse.json({ wishes });
}

// POST: a guest leaves a wish/blessing for the couple. No auth required — guests
// aren't logged-in users on this platform, same as RSVP and media uploads.
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {
  const clientIp = getClientIp(req);
  const rateLimitRes = await verifyRateLimit(`wishes:${params.slug}:${clientIp}`, { max: 3, windowSeconds: 300 });
  if (!rateLimitRes.success) {
    return buildRateLimitResponse(rateLimitRes);
  }

  try {

    const { senderName, message, mediaType, videoUrl } = await req.json();
    if (!senderName?.trim() || !message?.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'senderName and message are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (message.length > 2000) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'message is too long (max 2000 characters).' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const event = await queryOne<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [params.slug]);
    if (!event) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Event not found.' }, { status: 404 });

    const wishId = 'w_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
    await query(
      `INSERT INTO wishes (id, event_id, sender_name, message, media_type, video_url, status)
       VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,'PENDING')`,
      [wishId, event.id, senderName.trim(), message.trim(), mediaType ?? 'TEXT', videoUrl ?? null]
    );

    // If wish contains a video, also create a media_assets record for moderation
    if (mediaType === 'VIDEO' || videoUrl) {
      const mediaId = `med_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
      await query(
        `INSERT INTO media_assets (id, event_id, uploader_name, media_type, category, cdn_url, caption, status)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'VIDEO','WISHES',$4,$5,'PENDING')`,
        [mediaId, event.id, senderName.trim(), videoUrl || '', message.trim()]
      );
    }

    const wish = await queryOne(
      'SELECT id, sender_name, message, media_type, video_url, status, created_at FROM wishes WHERE id = $1',
      [wishId]
    );

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, wish }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to submit wish.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { queryOne, query } from '@/lib/db';

// GET: comments on one feed post. No auth — same guest model as likes/wishes.
// Only returns comments for posts that are actually APPROVED and visible, so
// a rejected/pending item's comments (if any slipped in before moderation)
// can't be scraped by guessing its id.
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { mediaId: string } }) {
  const media = await queryOne<{ id: string; status: string }>(
    'SELECT id, status FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1',
    [params.mediaId]
  );
  if (!media || media.status !== 'APPROVED') {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Post not found.' }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const comments = await query(
    'SELECT id, sender_name, comment, created_at FROM media_comments WHERE media_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC',
    [params.mediaId]
  );
  return NextResponse.json({ comments });
}

// POST { senderName, comment } — spec: like/comment applies to individual
// wish/BTS videos, explicitly NOT to live-stream items (enforce that here,
// not just hidden in the UI, so the button being hidden isn't the only guard).
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { mediaId: string } }) {
  try {
    const { senderName, comment } = await req.json();
    if (!senderName?.trim() || !comment?.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'senderName and comment are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (comment.length > 500) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'comment is too long (max 500 characters).' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const media = await queryOne<{ id: string; status: string; category: string }>(
      'SELECT id, status, category FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1',
      [params.mediaId]
    );
    if (!media || media.status !== 'APPROVED') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Post not found.' }, { status: 404 });
    }
    if (media.category === 'LIVE') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Comments are disabled on live broadcasts.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const commentId = `comment_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`;
    await query(
      'INSERT INTO media_comments (id, media_id, sender_name, comment) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)',
      [commentId, params.mediaId, senderName.trim(), comment.trim()]
    );
    const created = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM media_comments WHERE id = $1', [commentId]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, comment: created }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to add comment.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { requireRole, hashPassword } from '@/lib/auth';
import { query, queryOne, withTransaction } from '@/lib/db';
import { mockStore } from '@/lib/mockData';

function cleanAgencyName(name?: string, email?: string, rawId?: string): string {
  if (
    name &&
    !name.includes('Organizer Agency') &&
    !name.startsWith('org-') &&
    !name.includes('@') &&
    name.trim() !== 'Event Organizer' &&
    !/[0-9a-f]{8,}/i.test(name)
  ) {
    return name.trim();
  }
  if (email && email.includes('@') && !email.startsWith('organizer-')) {
    const uname = email.split('@')[0].replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    const titleCase = uname.split(' ').map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
    return `${titleCase} Event Production Agency`;
  }
  if (rawId && !/[0-9a-f]{8,}/i.test(rawId)) {
    const cleanId = rawId.replace(/^org-/, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, ' ').trim();
    const titleCase = cleanId.split(' ').map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
    return `${titleCase} Event Agency`;
  }
  return 'Event Organizer Agency Suite';
}

async function resolveOrCreateOrganizerInDb(targetOrgId: string | null, userId?: string | null) {
  const rawInput = (targetOrgId || userId || 'org-default').trim();
  const cleanKey = rawInput.startsWith('org-') ? rawInput : `org-${rawInput}`;
  const rawUserId = rawInput.replace(/^org-/, '');
  const normalizedKey = rawInput.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase();

  try {
    // 1. Try finding existing organizer row in DB with flexible matching
    let orgRow = await queryOne<{ id: string; business_name: string; owner_user_id: string; full_name?: string; email?: string }>(
      `SELECT o.id, o.business_name, o.owner_user_id, u.full_name, u.email
       FROM organizers o
       LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = o.owner_user_id
       WHERE o.id = $1 
          OR o.owner_user_id = $1 
          OR o.owner_user_id = $2
          OR CONCAT('org-', o.owner_user_id) = $1 
          OR CONCAT('org-', o.id) = $1
          OR u.id = $1
          OR u.id = $2
          OR lower(u.email) = lower($1)
          OR lower(u.email) = lower($2)
          OR lower(replace(u.id, '-', '')) = $3
          OR lower(replace(o.id, '-', '')) = $3
          OR lower(replace(o.owner_user_id, '-', '')) = $3`,
      [rawInput, rawUserId, normalizedKey]
    );

    if (!orgRow) {
      // 2. Try finding user to attach an organizer record
      let ownerUser = await queryOne<{ id: string; full_name: string; email: string }>(
        `SELECT id, full_name, email FROM users 
         WHERE id = $1 
            OR id = $2 
            OR lower(email) = lower($1) 
            OR lower(email) = lower($2)
            OR lower(replace(id, '-', '')) = $3
            LIMIT 1`,
        [rawInput, rawUserId, normalizedKey]
      );

      if (ownerUser) {
        const autoAgencyName = cleanAgencyName(ownerUser.full_name, ownerUser.email, ownerUser.id);
        const newOrgId = `org-${ownerUser.id}`;
        await query(
          `INSERT INTO organizers (id, owner_user_id, business_name)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3)`,
          [newOrgId, ownerUser.id, autoAgencyName]
        );
        orgRow = await queryOne<{ id: string; business_name: string; owner_user_id: string; full_name?: string; email?: string }>(
          `SELECT id, business_name, owner_user_id FROM organizers WHERE id = $1`,
          [newOrgId]
        );
        if (orgRow) {
          orgRow.full_name = ownerUser.full_name;
          orgRow.email = ownerUser.email;
        }
      }
    }

    if (orgRow) {
      const finalAgencyName = cleanAgencyName(orgRow.business_name || orgRow.full_name, orgRow.email, orgRow.id);
      return {
        dbOrganizerId: orgRow.id,
        cleanKey,
        rawUserId,
        organizerInfo: {
          agencyName: finalAgencyName,
          fullName: orgRow.full_name || finalAgencyName,
          email: orgRow.email || '',
        }
      };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to resolve/create organizer in DB:', err);
  }

  // 3. Fallback in-memory matching against mockStore.users
  const matchedUser = mockStore.users.find(
    (u) =>
      u.id === rawInput ||
      u.id === rawUserId ||
      ('org-' + u.id) === rawInput ||
      u.id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').toLowerCase() === normalizedKey ||
      ('org' + u.id.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')).toLowerCase() === normalizedKey ||
      (u.email && u.email.toLowerCase() === rawInput.toLowerCase()) ||
      (u.email && rawInput.toLowerCase().includes(u.email.split('@')[0].toLowerCase()))
  );

  if (matchedUser) {
    const finalAgencyName = cleanAgencyName((matchedUser as any).companyName || matchedUser.fullName, matchedUser.email, matchedUser.id);
    return {
      dbOrganizerId: matchedUser.id,
      cleanKey,
      rawUserId,
      organizerInfo: {
        agencyName: finalAgencyName,
        fullName: matchedUser.fullName,
        email: matchedUser.email,
      }
    };
  }

  // If no user exists, derive a unique clean agency name using rawInput
  const autoAgencyName = cleanAgencyName(undefined, undefined, rawInput);
  return {
    dbOrganizerId: null,
    cleanKey,
    rawUserId,
    organizerInfo: {
      agencyName: autoAgencyName,
      fullName: autoAgencyName,
      email: rawInput.includes('@') ? rawInput : `organizer@${rawUserId.slice(0, 8)}.com`,
    }
  };
}

function formatEvent(e: any) {
  if (!e) return e;
  const brideName = e.bride_name || e.brideName || '';
  const groomName = e.groom_name || e.groomName || '';
  const venueName = e.venue_name || e.venueName || '';
  const eventDate = e.event_date || e.eventDate || new Date().toISOString();
  const adminApprovalStatus = e.admin_approval_status || e.adminApprovalStatus || 'PENDING';
  const coverImageUrl = e.cover_image_url || e.coverImageUrl || null;
  const venueAddress = e.venue_address || e.venueAddress || null;
  const dressCode = e.dress_code || e.dressCode || null;
  const youtubeVideoId = e.youtube_video_id || e.youtubeVideoId || null;
  const isLive = e.is_live !== undefined ? e.is_live : (e.isLive ?? false);

  const coupleEmail = e.couple_email || e.coupleCredentials?.email || `couple@${e.slug}.com`;
  const couplePassword = e.coupleCredentials?.temporaryPassword || e.credentials?.couple?.temporaryPassword || 'agafari2026';

  return {
    ...e,
    id: e.id,
    slug: e.slug,
    title: e.title || (brideName && groomName ? `${brideName} & ${groomName}'s Wedding` : 'Wedding Event'),
    brideName,
    groomName,
    bride_name: brideName,
    groom_name: groomName,
    eventDate,
    event_date: eventDate,
    venueName,

    venueAddress,
    venue_address: venueAddress,
    dressCode,
    dress_code: dressCode,
    coverImageUrl,

    status: e.status || 'COMING_SOON',
    adminApprovalStatus,
    admin_approval_status: adminApprovalStatus,
    youtubeVideoId,
    youtube_video_id: youtubeVideoId,
    isLive,
    is_live: isLive,
    stats: {
      totalInvites: Number(e.total_invites || e.stats?.totalInvites || 0),
      totalWishes: Number(e.total_wishes || e.stats?.totalWishes || 0),
      totalMedia: Number(e.total_media || e.stats?.totalMedia || 0),
    },
    coupleCredentials: {
      email: coupleEmail,
      temporaryPassword: couplePassword,
    },
    credentials: e.credentials || {
      couple: { fullName: `${brideName} & ${groomName}`, email: coupleEmail, temporaryPassword: couplePassword, role: 'BRIDE_GROOM' },
      organizer: { fullName: 'Event Organizer', email: `organizer@${e.slug}.com`, temporaryPassword: 'org2026', role: 'EVENT_ORGANIZER' },
      streamer: { fullName: 'Live Streamer Crew', email: `streamer@${e.slug}.com`, temporaryPassword: 'stream123', role: 'LIVE_STREAMER' },
      scanner: { fullName: 'Gate QR Scanner', email: `scanner@${e.slug}.com`, temporaryPassword: 'scan123', role: 'GATE_SCANNER' },
      moderator: { fullName: 'Media Content Moderator', email: `moderator@${e.slug}.com`, temporaryPassword: 'mod123', role: 'MEDIA_MODERATOR' },
    }
  };
}

// GET: all events this organizer owns
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const targetOrgId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('id') || req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('organizerId');

  try {
    let auth = requireRole(req, ['EVENT_ORGANIZER', 'SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
    const userId = auth.ok ? auth.user.userId : null;
    
    // Resolve organizer details using unified helper
    const orgData = await resolveOrCreateOrganizerInDb(targetOrgId, userId);
    const { dbOrganizerId, cleanKey, rawUserId, organizerInfo } = orgData;

    // Build target keys for matching
    const targetKeys = new Set([cleanKey, rawUserId, targetOrgId, dbOrganizerId].filter(Boolean) as string[]);

    // Try DB fetch
    let rawEvents: any[] = [];
    let dbSuccess = false;
    if (dbOrganizerId || cleanKey || rawUserId) {
      try {
        rawEvents = await query(
          `SELECT e.*,
                  cu.email AS couple_email,
                  cu.full_name AS couple_full_name,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invitations i WHERE i.event_id = e.id) AS total_invites,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wishes w WHERE w.event_id = e.id) AS total_wishes,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_assets m WHERE m.event_id = e.id) AS total_media,
                  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_assets m WHERE m.event_id = e.id AND m.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_media
           FROM events e
           LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.id = e.couple_user_id
           WHERE e.organizer_id = $1 
              OR e.organizer_id = $2 
              OR e.organizer_id = $3
              OR e.organizer_id = (SELECT id FROM organizers WHERE owner_user_id = $2 OR owner_user_id = $3 LIMIT 1)
           ORDER BY e.event_date ASC`,
          [dbOrganizerId || cleanKey, cleanKey, rawUserId]
        );
        dbSuccess = true;
      } catch (e) {
        rawEvents = [];
      }
    }

    let combinedFormatted: any[] = [];
    if (dbSuccess) {
      combinedFormatted = (rawEvents || []).map((dbEvt: any) => formatEvent(dbEvt));
    } else {
      // Fallback only if DB is unavailable
      const mockEventsForOrg = mockStore.events.filter((e: any) => {
        const eOrgId = e.organizerId || e.organizer_id;
        if (!eOrgId) return false;
        const strOrgId = String(eOrgId);
        const cleanStrOrgId = strOrgId.startsWith('org-') ? strOrgId : `org-${strOrgId}`;
        const rawStrOrgId = strOrgId.replace(/^org-/, '');
        return targetKeys.has(strOrgId) || targetKeys.has(cleanStrOrgId) || targetKeys.has(rawStrOrgId);
      });
      combinedFormatted = mockEventsForOrg.map(formatEvent);
    }

    const activeHostingCount = combinedFormatted.filter((e) => e.status !== 'COMPLETED' && e.status !== 'ARCHIVED' && (e.adminApprovalStatus === 'APPROVED' || e.admin_approval_status === 'APPROVED')).length;
    const hostedArchiveCount = combinedFormatted.filter((e) => e.status === 'COMPLETED' || e.status === 'ARCHIVED').length;

    const enrichedOrganizerInfo = {
      ...organizerInfo,
      activeHostingCount,
      hostedArchiveCount,
    };

    return NextResponse.json({
      events: combinedFormatted,
      organizerInfo: enrichedOrganizerInfo,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      events: [],
      organizerInfo: { agencyName: 'Event Organizer Agency Suite', fullName: 'Organizer Admin', email: 'organizer@agafari.com', activeHostingCount: 0, hostedArchiveCount: 0 },
    });
  }
}

// POST: organizer creates a new wedding under their account
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {

    const targetOrgParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('id') || req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('organizerId');
    let targetOrgId = bodyOrgId || targetOrgParam || null;

    if (!brideName || !groomName || !eventDate || !venueName) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required fields (brideName, groomName, eventDate, venueName).' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (!title) {
      title = `${brideName.trim()} & ${groomName.trim()}'s Wedding`;
    }

    let cleanSlug = slug
      ? String(slug).toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '-')
      : `${brideName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')}-and-${groomName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')}-${new Date(eventDate).getFullYear()}`;

    const targetCoupleEmail = coupleEmail?.trim() || `couple@${cleanSlug}.com`;
    const tempPassword = `agafari${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;

    let auth = requireRole(req, ['EVENT_ORGANIZER', 'SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
    const userId = auth.ok ? auth.user.userId : null;
    const orgData = await resolveOrCreateOrganizerInDb(targetOrgId, userId);
    const { dbOrganizerId, cleanKey, rawUserId } = orgData;

    // Use valid DB organizer ID if available, else cleanKey
    const assignedOrgId = dbOrganizerId || cleanKey;

    try {
      const result = await withTransaction(async (client) => {
        // Ensure slug is unique in DB
        const existingSlug = (await client.query('SELECT id FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [cleanSlug])).rows[0];
        if (existingSlug) {
          cleanSlug = `${cleanSlug}-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;
        }

        // Reuse user if email already exists in DB
        let coupleUser = (await client.query('SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email = $1', [targetCoupleEmail])).rows[0];
        if (!coupleUser) {
          const coupleUserId = `usr-couple-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;
          await client.query(
            `INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, full_name, role)
             VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'BRIDE_GROOM')`,
            [coupleUserId, targetCoupleEmail, hashPassword(tempPassword), `${brideName.trim()} & ${groomName.trim()}`]
          );
          coupleUser = (await client.query('SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE id = $1', [coupleUserId])).rows[0];
        }

        const newEventId = `evt-${cleanSlug}`;
        let formattedDate: string;
        try {
          formattedDate = new Date(eventDate).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' ');
        } catch (e) {
          formattedDate = eventDate;
        }

        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO events (
             id, slug, title, managed_by, organizer_id, couple_user_id, template_id,
             bride_name, groom_name, event_date, venue_name, venue_address, dress_code,
             status, admin_approval_status
           ) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'ORGANIZER',$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,$10,$11,$12,'COMING_SOON','PENDING')`,
          [
            newEventId, cleanSlug, title.trim(), assignedOrgId, coupleUser.id, templateId || null,
            brideName.trim(), groomName.trim(), formattedDate,
            venueName.trim(), venueAddress?.trim() || null, dressCode?.trim() || null,
          ]
        );

        const event = (await client.query('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = $1', [newEventId])).rows[0];

        return { event, coupleTempPassword: tempPassword, coupleEmail: coupleUser.email, organizerId: assignedOrgId };
      });

      const formattedEvent = formatEvent({
        ...result.event,
        couple_email: result.coupleEmail,
      });
      formattedEvent.coupleCredentials = { email: result.coupleEmail, temporaryPassword: result.coupleTempPassword };
      formattedEvent.organizerId = cleanKey;
      (formattedEvent as any).organizer_id = cleanKey;

      // Keep mockStore in sync with organizer ID attached
      const existingIdx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === formattedEvent.id || e.slug === formattedEvent.slug);
      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        mockStore.events[existingIdx] = formattedEvent;
      } else {
        mockStore.events.unshift(formattedEvent);
      }

      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: true,
          event: formattedEvent,
          coupleCredentials: { email: result.coupleEmail, temporaryPassword: result.coupleTempPassword },
          note: 'Event created with admin_approval_status = PENDING — awaiting System Admin review.',
        },
        { status: 201 }
      );
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.error('DB Insert Event Failed, falling back to mockStore:', dbErr);
      // Fallback in-memory insertion for mock environment
      const newEventData: any = {
        id: `evt-${cleanSlug}`,
        slug: cleanSlug,
        title: title.trim(),
        brideName: brideName.trim(),
        groomName: groomName.trim(),

        status: 'COMING_SOON',

        organizerId: cleanKey,

        coupleCredentials: {
          email: targetCoupleEmail,
          temporaryPassword: tempPassword,
        },
        credentials: {
          couple: { fullName: `${brideName.trim()} & ${groomName.trim()}`, email: targetCoupleEmail, temporaryPassword: tempPassword, role: 'BRIDE_GROOM' },

          scanner: { fullName: 'Gate QR Security', email: `scanner@${cleanSlug}.com`, temporaryPassword: 'scan123', role: 'GATE_SCANNER' },
          moderator: { fullName: 'Media Content Moderator', email: `moderator@${cleanSlug}.com`, temporaryPassword: 'mod123', role: 'MEDIA_MODERATOR' },
        }
      };

      const existingIdx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === newEventData.id || e.slug === newEventData.slug);
      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        mockStore.events[existingIdx] = newEventData;
      } else {
        mockStore.events.unshift(newEventData);
      }

      const formatted = formatEvent(newEventData);

      return NextResponse.json(

            email: targetCoupleEmail,
            temporaryPassword: tempPassword
          },
          note: 'Event created with admin_approval_status = PENDING — awaiting System Admin review.'
        },
        { status: 201 }
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to create event:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to create event.' }, { status: 500 });
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { ModerationService } from '@/application/services/ModerationService';
import { MySqlMediaRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlMediaRepository';
import { MySqlWishRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlWishRepository';
import { DomainError } from '@/domain/errors/DomainError';

const moderationService = new ModerationService(
  new MySqlMediaRepository(),
  new MySqlWishRepository()
);

// GET /api/organizer/media/comments?eventId=...&mediaId=...
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const eventId = searchParams.get('eventId');
  const mediaId = searchParams.get('mediaId');
  if (!eventId || !mediaId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId and mediaId are required.' }, { status: 400 });

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
  if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

  try {
    const comments = await moderationService.getMediaComments(mediaId, user.role === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' ? undefined : user.userId);
    return NextResponse.json({ comments });
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch comments.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE { eventId, commentId }
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const { eventId, commentId } = await req.json();
    if (!eventId || !commentId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId and commentId are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
    if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

    await moderationService.updateCommentStatus(commentId, 'REJECTED', user.role === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' ? undefined : user.userId);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 404 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to delete comment.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

// GET /api/organizer/media?eventId=...&status=PENDING&category=BTS
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const eventId = searchParams.get('eventId');
  const status = searchParams.get('status') ?? 'PENDING';
  const category = searchParams.get('category');
  const statusVal = status === 'ALL' ? null : status;

  if (!eventId) {
    if (user?.role === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') {
      try {
        const rawItems = await query(
          `SELECT * FROM media_assets
           WHERE ($1 IS NULL OR status = $1)
             AND ($2 IS NULL OR category = $2)
           ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
          [statusVal, category || null]
        );
        const items = rawItems.map((m: any) => ({
          ...m,
          uploaderName: m.uploader_name || m.uploaderName || 'Guest',
          mediaType: m.media_type || m.mediaType || 'IMAGE',
          cdnUrl: m.cdn_url || m.cdnUrl || m.url || '',
          likesCount: m.likes_count || m.likesCount || 0
        }));
        return NextResponse.json({ mediaAssets: items, items });
      } catch (err) {
        return NextResponse.json({ mediaAssets: [], items: [] });
      }
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ mediaAssets: [], items: [] });
  }

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
  if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

  const rawItems = await query(
    `SELECT * FROM media_assets
     WHERE event_id = $1
       AND ($2 IS NULL OR status = $2)
       AND ($3 IS NULL OR category = $3)
     ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
    [eventId, statusVal, category || null]
  );

  const items = rawItems.map((m: any) => ({
    ...m,
    uploaderName: m.uploader_name || m.uploaderName || 'Guest',
    mediaType: m.media_type || m.mediaType || 'IMAGE',
    cdnUrl: m.cdn_url || m.cdnUrl || m.url || '',
    likesCount: m.likes_count || m.likesCount || 0
  }));

  const counts = await queryOne<{ pending: number; approved: number; rejected: number }>(
    `SELECT
       COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END)  AS pending,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) AS approved,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) AS rejected
     FROM media_assets WHERE event_id = $1`,
    [eventId]
  );

  return NextResponse.json({ mediaAssets: items, items, counts });
}

// POST: Direct Media Upload by Moderator / Organizer (Auto-APPROVED)
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { eventId, uploaderName, mediaType, category, cdnUrl, caption, status } = body;

    if (!eventId || !cdnUrl) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId and cdnUrl are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (user && eventId) {
      const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
      if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const mediaId = `med_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
    const finalStatus = status || 'APPROVED';

    await query(
      `INSERT INTO media_assets (id, event_id, uploader_name, media_type, category, cdn_url, caption, status, moderated_by)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)`,
      [
        mediaId,
        eventId,
        (uploaderName || 'Media Moderator').trim(),
        mediaType || 'IMAGE',
        category || 'GALLERY',
        cdnUrl,
        caption ? caption.trim() : null,
        finalStatus,
        user?.userId || null
      ]
    );

    // If wish video/photo with message, sync to wishes table
    if (category === 'WISHES' && caption) {
      try {
        const wishId = 'w_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
        await query(
          `INSERT INTO wishes (id, event_id, sender_name, message, media_type, video_url, status)
           VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)`,
          [
            wishId,
            eventId,
            (uploaderName || 'Media Moderator').trim(),
            caption.trim(),
            mediaType || 'VIDEO',
            cdnUrl,
            finalStatus
          ]
        );
      } catch (wErr) {
        console.warn('Wishes table sync optional insert error:', wErr);
      }
    }

    const item = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1', [mediaId]);

    const formattedItem = {
      ...item,
      uploaderName: item.uploader_name || item.uploaderName,
      mediaType: item.media_type || item.mediaType,
      cdnUrl: item.cdn_url || item.cdnUrl
    };

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, item: formattedItem }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to create media asset:', err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to create media asset.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// PATCH { eventId, mediaId, action: 'approve' | 'reject', status }
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { eventId, mediaId, action, status } = body;
    const requestedAction = action || (status === 'APPROVED' ? 'approve' : 'reject');

    if (!mediaId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'mediaId is required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (user && eventId) {
      const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
      if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const newStatus = requestedAction === 'approve' || status === 'APPROVED' ? 'APPROVED' : 'REJECTED';
    await query(
      `UPDATE media_assets SET status = $1, moderated_by = $2 WHERE id = $3`,
      [newStatus, user?.userId || null, mediaId]
    );

    const updated = await queryOne(`SELECT * FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1`, [mediaId]);

    if (!updated) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Media item not found.' }, { status: 404 });

    const formattedItem = {
      ...updated,
      uploaderName: updated.uploader_name || updated.uploaderName,
      mediaType: updated.media_type || updated.mediaType,
      cdnUrl: updated.cdn_url || updated.cdnUrl
    };

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, item: formattedItem });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update media status.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE /api/organizer/media?mediaId=...&eventId=...
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const mediaId = searchParams.get('mediaId');
  const eventId = searchParams.get('eventId');

  if (!mediaId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'mediaId is required.' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    if (user && eventId) {
      const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
      if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    await query('DELETE FROM media_assets WHERE id = $1', [mediaId]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, mediaId });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Failed to delete media asset:', err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to delete media asset.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

// GET /api/organizer/wishes?eventId=...&status=PENDING
// Moderation queue for text wishes — even though wishes auto-publish (APPROVED
// by default), an organizer/moderator/couple needs to be able to review and
// take one down after the fact, or feature a favorite on the public wall.
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const eventId = searchParams.get('eventId');
  const status = searchParams.get('status'); // optional filter
  if (!eventId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId is required.' }, { status: 400 });

  const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
  if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

  const wishes = await query(
    `SELECT * FROM wishes WHERE event_id = $1 AND ($2 IS NULL OR status = $2)
     ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
    [eventId, status]
  );

  return NextResponse.json({ wishes });
}

// PATCH { eventId, wishId, action: 'approve' | 'reject' | 'feature' | 'unfeature' }
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const { eventId, wishId, action } = await req.json();
    if (!eventId || !wishId || !action) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId, wishId, and action are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['CONTENT_MODERATOR']);
    if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

    if (action === 'approve' || action === 'reject') {
      const newStatus = action === 'approve' ? 'APPROVED' : 'REJECTED';
      await query(
        `UPDATE wishes SET status = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND event_id = $3`,
        [newStatus, wishId, eventId]
      );
    } else if (action === 'feature' || action === 'unfeature') {
      await query(
        `UPDATE wishes SET is_featured = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND event_id = $3`,
        [action === 'feature' ? 1 : 0, wishId, eventId]
      );
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "action must be one of approve, reject, feature, unfeature." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const updated = await queryOne(
      'SELECT * FROM wishes WHERE id = $1 AND event_id = $2',
      [wishId, eventId]
    );

    if (!updated) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Wish not found for this event.' }, { status: 404 });
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, wish: updated });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update wish.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getAuthUser } from '@/lib/auth';
import { checkEventAccess } from '@/lib/eventScope';
import { CheckInService } from '@/application/services/CheckInService';
import { MySqlEventRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlEventRepository';
import { MySqlInvitationRepository } from '@/infrastructure/persistence/MySqlInvitationRepository';
import { DomainError } from '@/domain/errors/DomainError';
import { captureException } from '@/lib/errorTracking';
import { verifyRateLimit, buildRateLimitResponse } from '@/lib/rateLimit';

const checkInService = new CheckInService(
  new MySqlEventRepository(),
  new MySqlInvitationRepository()
);

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  const rateLimitRes = await verifyRateLimit(`qr_scan:${user.userId}`, { max: 120, windowSeconds: 60 });
  if (!rateLimitRes.success) {
    return buildRateLimitResponse(rateLimitRes);
  }

  try {
    const { eventId, inviteCode, maxGuests, sig, admitCount, clientScannedAt } = await req.json();

    if (!eventId || !inviteCode || maxGuests === undefined || !sig) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId, inviteCode, maxGuests, and sig are required.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const access = await checkEventAccess(user, eventId, ['GATE_SCANNER']);
    if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden — not a gate scanner for this event.' }, { status: 403 });

    const signingSecret = process.env.TICKET_SIGNING_SECRET || 'fallback-signing-secret-agafari-2026';

    const outcome = await checkInService.performCheckIn({
      eventId,
      inviteCode,
      maxGuests: Number(maxGuests),
      sig,
      admitCount: admitCount ? Number(admitCount) : undefined,
      clientScannedAt,
      staffUserId: user.userId,
      signingSecret,
    });

    return NextResponse.json(outcome);
  } catch (error: any) {
    captureException(error, { route: '/api/qr/[code]', userId: user.userId, role: user.role });
    if (error instanceof DomainError) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { result: error.name.toUpperCase().replace('ERROR', ''), message: error.message },
        { status: error.name === 'NotFoundError' ? 404 : error.name === 'ForbiddenError' ? 403 : 400 }
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Scan processing failed.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

```typescript
            fetch(`/api/events/${coupleEventSlug}/invitations`),
            fetch(`/api/events/${coupleEventSlug}/quota`),
          ]);

          if (eventRes.ok) {
            const data = await eventRes.json();
            setEvent(data.event);
          }

          if (mediaRes.ok) {
            const data = await mediaRes.json();
            setMediaAssets(data.mediaAssets || []);
          }

          if (invitesRes.ok) {
            const data = await invitesRes.json();
            setInvitations(data.invitations || []);
          }

          if (quotaRes.ok) {
            const data = await quotaRes.json();
            if (data.totalAllocatedQuota) {
              setPermittedTotalQuota(data.totalAllocatedQuota);
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load couple dashboard data:', err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadCoupleDashboardData();
  }, []);

  // Calculate current quota usage
  const currentTotalGuestsSubmitted = invitations.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + (inv.maxGuests || 1), 0);
  const remainingPermittedSeats = Math.max(0, permittedTotalQuota - currentTotalGuestsSubmitted);

  // Submit Guest Data to Organizer / System Admin
  const handleAddGuest = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGuestErrorMsg('');
    setGuestSuccessMsg('');

    if (!guestName.trim()) return;

    if (currentTotalGuestsSubmitted + guestHeadcount > permittedTotalQuota) {
      setGuestErrorMsg(`Exceeds your total permitted quota of ${permittedTotalQuota} guests! Remaining available seats: ${remainingPermittedSeats}.`);
      return;
    }

    setSubmittingGuest(true);
    try {
      const slug = event?.slug || 'sara-and-dawit-2026';
      const res = await fetch(`/api/events/${slug}/invitations`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          guestName: guestName.trim(),
          guestPhone: guestPhone.trim(),
          maxGuests: guestHeadcount,
          inviteType,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok && data.invitation) {
        setInvitations((prev) => [data.invitation, ...prev]);
        setGuestSuccessMsg(`Guest data for "${guestName}" sent to your Event Organizer! QR Pass & unique ID link generated.`);
        setGuestName('');
        setGuestPhone('');
        setGuestHeadcount(2);
        setTimeout(() => setGuestSuccessMsg(''), 6000);
      } else {
        setGuestErrorMsg(data.error || 'Failed to submit guest data.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error submitting guest data:', err);
      setGuestErrorMsg('Server error. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setSubmittingGuest(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyLink = (code: string, name: string) => {
    const slug = event?.slug || 'sara-and-dawit-2026';
    const fullUrl = `${window.location.origin}/event/${slug}?code=${code}&guest=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullUrl);
    setCopiedCode(code);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(''), 3000);
  };

  // Filter Media (Behind The Scenes vs Gathered Media)
  const filteredMedia = mediaAssets.filter((m) => {
    if (m.status === 'REJECTED') return false;
    if (mediaSubTab === 'ALL') return true;
    if (mediaSubTab === 'BTS') return m.category === 'BTS';
    if (mediaSubTab === 'GATHERED') return m.category === 'WISHES' || m.category === 'LIVE' || !m.category;
    return true;
  });

  if (!event && !loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-950 text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center font-sans">
        <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-gray-900 border-2 border-gold-500/40 rounded-3xl p-8 space-y-6 shadow-2xl">
          <Crown className="w-12 h-12 text-gold-400 mx-auto" />
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h2 className="font-serif font-bold text-2xl text-white">No Active Wedding Event Provisioned</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-gold-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">Couples Control Hub</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 font-light leading-relaxed">
              Everything starts from the System Super Admin portal. Your System Admin or Event Organizer will register your wedding and provision your couple credentials.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/admin/login"
            className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-400 text-black font-extrabold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-gold"
          >
            <span>Log In to System Super Admin Portal →</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden bg-gray-900 text-gray-100 flex font-sans selection:bg-gold-500 selection:text-black">
      
      {/* =========================================================================
          LEFT SIDEBAR: COUPLE PORTAL NAVIGATION
         ========================================================================= */}
      <aside className={`
        fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-72 bg-gray-950 text-white flex flex-col justify-between border-r border-gold-500/30 transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out
        md:translate-x-0 ${mobileSidebarOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full'}
      `}>
        <div>
          {/* Couple Header */}
          <div className="p-6 border-b border-gold-500/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

                  className="h-10 w-auto object-contain"
                />
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-gold-400 tracking-wide">
                    {event?.brideName || 'Sara'} & {event?.groomName || 'Dawit'}
                  </h2>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-gold-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest block">
                    COUPLE'S PORTAL
                  </span>

              </div>

              <button

              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Wedding Card Metadata */}
            <div className="mt-4 p-3 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-gold-500/20 text-[11px] space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gold-400 font-medium">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span>{event?.eventDate ? new Date(event.eventDate).toLocaleDateString() : 'Wedding Date'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white/70">
                <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span className="truncate">{event?.venueName || 'Primary Venue'}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Navigation Links */}
          <nav className="p-4 space-y-2 text-xs font-semibold">
            {/* 1. Guest Data & QR Invitations */}
            <button
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab('GUESTS'); setMobileSidebarOpen(false); }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all ${
                activeTab === 'GUESTS'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-gold-500 to-gold-600 text-black font-extrabold shadow-md'
                  : 'text-white/80 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-400" />
                <span>1. Guest List & QR Passes</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-black/50 text-gold-300 font-bold border border-gold-500/30">
                {invitations.length}

            {/* 2. Behind-The-Scenes & Gathered Media Gallery */}

        </div>

        {/* Sidebar Footer Controls */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/10 space-y-2">

                {guestSuccessMsg && (

                {guestErrorMsg && (

                <form onSubmit={handleAddGuest} className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

                    link.click();

                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-400 text-black font-extrabold text-xs shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-black" /> Download Card Design
                </button>

                <button

      <nav aria-label="Mobile Navigation" className="md:hidden fixed bottom-5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-2 border-gold-500/50 rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-4 shadow-2xl ring-2 ring-gold-500/20">
        <button

            activeTab === 'GUESTS'

          title="Guest List & QR Passes"
        >

        <button

      </nav>
```

```typescript
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ShieldCheck, ArrowRight, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation, LanguageSwitcher } from '@/lib/i18n';

export default function CoupleLoginPage() {

            className="h-14 w-auto mx-auto mb-4 object-contain"
          />
          <h1 className="font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">
            {t('auth.coupleTitle')}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-rose-600 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider mt-1">
            Bride & Groom Private Portal
          </p>
        </div>

          Direct open access to manage your wedding invitation page, wish gallery, and guest lists.
        </p>

        <button
          onClick={handleEnterDashboard}
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-extrabold text-xs shadow-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer border border-rose-400"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <div className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Heart className="w-4 h-4 text-white fill-white" />
          )}
          <span>Launch Couple Dashboard</span>

        </button>

        <div className="pt-4 border-t border-gray-100">
          <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-600 font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> Direct Open Couple Access Active
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
