```typescript
'use client';

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  QrCode, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  XCircle, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  UserCheck, 
  Search,
  ArrowLeft,
  Camera,
  CameraOff,
  RefreshCw,
  Zap,
  Lock
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useTranslation } from '@/lib/i18n';

interface ScanResult {
  code: string;
  guestName: string;
  maxGuests: number;
  scannedCount: number;
  tableNumber: string;
  status: 'VALID' | 'ALREADY_SCANNED' | 'INVALID';
  message: string;
  scannedAt?: string;
}

export default function GateScannerPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [authUser, setAuthUser] = useState<{ email: string; role: string } | null>(null);
  const [checkingAuth, setCheckingAuth] = useState(true);

  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');
  const [scanResult, setScanResult] = useState<ScanResult | null>(null);
  const [isCameraActive, setIsCameraActive] = useState(true);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);

  // Authenticate Scanner Staff User
  useEffect(() => {
    async function checkAuth() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/auth/me');
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.user && ['SYSTEM_ADMIN', 'EVENT_ORGANIZER', 'GATE_SCANNER', 'BRIDE_GROOM'].includes(data.user.role)) {
            setAuthUser(data.user);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Auth check failed:', err);
      } finally {
        setCheckingAuth(false);
      }
    }

    // Check if event parameter is passed
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const eventSlug = urlParams.get('event');
      if (eventSlug) {
        window.location.href = `/event/${eventSlug}/scanner`;
        return;
      }
    }

    checkAuth();
  }, []);

  // Start Camera Feed
  const startCamera = async () => {
    setCameraError(null);
    try {
      if (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 } }
        });
        streamRef.current = stream;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        }
        setIsCameraActive(true);
      } else {
        setCameraError('Camera access not supported on this browser.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Camera permission denied or unavailable:', err);
      setCameraError('Camera active in Viewfinder Mode (Permission denied or virtual environment).');
      setIsCameraActive(true);
    }
  };

  // Stop Camera Feed
  const stopCamera = () => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsCameraActive(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    startCamera();
    return () => {
      stopCamera();
    };
  }, []);

  // Dynamic API & Demo Scan Verifier Logic
  const executeVerification = async (codeToVerify: string) => {
    let query = codeToVerify.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!query) return;

    // Extract code parameter if a signed deep link URL was scanned
    if (query.includes('CODE=')) {
      const parts = query.split('CODE=');
      if (parts[1]) {
        query = parts[1].split('&')[0];
      }
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/events/sara-and-dawit-2026/invitations', {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ inviteCode: query, checkInCount: 1 }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (res.ok && data.invitation) {
        setScanResult({
          code: query,
          guestName: data.invitation.guestName,
          maxGuests: data.invitation.maxGuests,
          scannedCount: data.invitation.scannedCount,
          tableNumber: data.invitation.tableNumber || 'Table 1 - VIP Family',
          status: 'VALID',
          message: data.message || `✓ Valid Digital Pass Verified. ${data.invitation.guestName} (${data.invitation.scannedCount}/${data.invitation.maxGuests} Checked In).`,
        });
      } else if (res.status === 409 && data.invitation) {
        setScanResult({
          code: query,
          guestName: data.invitation.guestName,
          maxGuests: data.invitation.maxGuests,
          scannedCount: data.invitation.scannedCount,
          tableNumber: data.invitation.tableNumber || 'Table 1 - VIP Family',
          status: 'ALREADY_SCANNED',
          scannedAt: data.invitation.scannedAt || 'earlier today',
          message: data.message || '⚠️ WARNING: Pass was already checked in.',
        });
      } else {
        setScanResult({
          code: query || 'UNKNOWN',
          guestName: 'Invalid / Counterfeit Pass',
          maxGuests: 0,
          scannedCount: 0,
          tableNumber: 'N/A',
          status: 'INVALID',
          message: '🔴 ACCESS DENIED: Unrecognized or counterfeit QR code signature.',
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setScanResult({
        code: query || 'UNKNOWN',
        guestName: 'Network Error',
        maxGuests: 0,
        scannedCount: 0,
        tableNumber: 'N/A',
        status: 'INVALID',
        message: '🔴 ACCESS DENIED: Verification request failed.',
      });
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyForm = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    executeVerification(inputCode);
  };

  const handleCheckIn = async (count: number) => {
    if (!scanResult) return;
    const newCount = scanResult.scannedCount + count;
    setScanResult({
      ...scanResult,
      scannedCount: newCount,
      status: 'ALREADY_SCANNED',
      scannedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
      message: `Successfully checked in ${count} guest(s). Headcount updated to ${newCount}/${scanResult.maxGuests}.`,
    });
  };

  if (checkingAuth) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-stone-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center p-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-gold-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto" />
          <p className="font-serif text-gold-400 text-sm">Authenticating Gate Security Personnel...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!authUser) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-stone-950 text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 text-center font-sans">
        <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-black/90 border-2 border-gold-500/40 rounded-3xl p-8 space-y-6 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-500/50 text-rose-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto animate-pulse">
            <Lock className="w-8 h-8 text-rose-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h2 className="font-serif font-bold text-2xl text-white">Gate Scanner Portal Locked</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-gold-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">Restricted Staff Access Only</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 font-light leading-relaxed">
              The Gate QR Scanner is an internal security tool for authorized personnel. Public access is disabled. Please log in with staff or administrator credentials to proceed.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
            <Link
              href="/admin/login"
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gold-500 hover:bg-gold-400 text-black font-extrabold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-gold"
            >
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
              <span>Log In as Staff / Admin</span>
            </Link>
            <Link
              href="/"
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-stone-900 hover:bg-stone-800 text-gray-300 font-extrabold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-stone-700"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
              <span>Return to Public Homepage</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen w-full max-w-full overflow-x-hidden bg-white text-gray-900 p-4 sm:p-6 flex flex-col items-center">
      <div className="max-w-md w-full mx-auto space-y-6">
        
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-gold-500/30">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <img
              src="/branding/artboard-14.png"
              alt="Agafari (አጋፋሪ) Logo"
              className="h-9 sm:h-10 w-auto object-contain"
            />
            <div>
              <h1 className="font-serif font-bold text-base text-gray-900">
                {t('scanner.title')}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-gold-600 font-semibold">Door Access Control System</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Link
              href="/"
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold transition-all border border-gray-200"
              title="Return to Home"

              <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5" />

                : scanResult.status === 'ALREADY_SCANNED'

          >
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-4">
              {scanResult.status === 'VALID' ? (

                  <CheckCircle className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-600" />

              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="text-gray-500">Checked In:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-900">
                  {scanResult.scannedCount} of {scanResult.maxGuests}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed mb-4 font-medium">{scanResult.message}</p>

            {/* Action Buttons for Check-In */}
            {scanResult.status === 'VALID' && scanResult.scannedCount < scanResult.maxGuests && (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleCheckIn(1)}
                  className="flex-1 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold text-xs hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-md active:scale-95"

                </button>
                {scanResult.maxGuests > 1 && (
                  <button

                    className="flex-1 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-xs hover:bg-emerald-800 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-md active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                    Check In All ({scanResult.maxGuests})
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { IEventRepository } from '../repositories/IEventRepository';
import { IInvitationRepository } from '../repositories/IInvitationRepository';
import { Ticket } from '../../domain/entities/Ticket';
import {
  NotFoundError,
  InvalidQrSignatureError,
  EventExpiredError,
  AlreadyScannedError,
  HeadcountExceededError,
} from '../../domain/errors/DomainError';

export interface PerformCheckInInput {
  eventId: string;
  inviteCode: string;
  maxGuests: number;
  sig: string;
  admitCount?: number;
  clientScannedAt?: string;
  staffUserId: string;
  signingSecret: string;
}

export class CheckInService {
  constructor(
    private eventRepo: IEventRepository,
    private invitationRepo: IInvitationRepository
  ) {}

  public async performCheckIn(input: PerformCheckInInput) {
    // 1. Signature verification BEFORE database lookup (reject forged codes cheaply)
    const isSigValid = Ticket.verifySignature(
      input.eventId,
      input.inviteCode,
      input.maxGuests,
      input.sig,
      input.signingSecret
    );

    if (!isSigValid) {
      // Async logging outside transaction
      this.invitationRepo.logScanAsync(null, input.staffUserId, 'INVALID', 0, input.clientScannedAt);
      throw new InvalidQrSignatureError();
    }

    // 2. Verify event exists and is not expired/archived (Part C Finding C.1)
    const event = await this.eventRepo.findById(input.eventId);
    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Event', input.eventId);
    }
    if (event.isCompletedOrArchived()) {
      throw new EventExpiredError();
    }

    // 3. Find invitation by code
    const invitation = await this.invitationRepo.findByInviteCode(input.eventId, input.inviteCode);
    if (!invitation) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Invitation', input.inviteCode);
    }

    // 4. Domain headcount evaluation (Part B Finding 3.1: Partial Group Arrival)
    const requestedAdmit = input.admitCount && input.admitCount > 0 ? input.admitCount : input.maxGuests;
    
    // Evaluates headcount invariants via domain entity
    invitation.attemptCheckIn(requestedAdmit);

    // 5. Execute atomic DB update (with FOR UPDATE row lock)
    const { admitted } = await this.invitationRepo.atomicCheckIn(
      invitation.id,
      requestedAdmit,
      input.staffUserId
    );

    // 6. Log scan asynchronously OUTSIDE transaction lock (Part B Finding 4.2)
    this.invitationRepo.logScanAsync(
      invitation.id,
      input.staffUserId,
      'VALID',
      admitted,
      input.clientScannedAt
    );

    return {
      result: 'VALID' as const,
      message: `Checked in ${admitted} guest(s).`,
      guestName: invitation.guestName,
      admitted,
      remaining: Math.max(0, invitation.maxGuests - invitation.scannedCount),
      invitationId: invitation.id,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IEventRepository } from '../repositories/IEventRepository';
import { NotFoundError } from '../../domain/errors/DomainError';

export class EventService {
  constructor(private eventRepo: IEventRepository) {}

  public async getAllEvents() {
    return await this.eventRepo.findAll();
  }

  public async getEventBySlug(slug: string) {
    const event = await this.eventRepo.findBySlug(slug);
    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Event', slug);
    }
    return event;
  }

  public async deleteEvent(eventId: string) {
    const deleted = await this.eventRepo.delete(eventId);
    if (!deleted) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Event', eventId);
    }
    return { success: true };
  }
}
```

```typescript
export class ModerationService {
  constructor(
    private mediaRepo: IMediaRepository,
    private wishRepo: IWishRepository
```

```typescript
import { IUserRepository } from '../repositories/IUserRepository';
import { IEventRepository } from '../repositories/IEventRepository';
import { OrganizerHasActiveEventsError, NotFoundError } from '../../domain/errors/DomainError';

export class OrganizerService {
  constructor(
    private userRepo: IUserRepository,
    private eventRepo: IEventRepository
  ) {}

  public async deleteOrganizer(organizerUserId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const user = await this.userRepo.findById(organizerUserId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundError('User/Organizer', organizerUserId);
    }

    const rawOrgId = user.organizerId || organizerUserId.replace(/^usr-/, 'org-');
    
    // Check if organizer manages any active wedding events
    const activeEventsCount = await this.eventRepo.countActiveByOrganizerId(rawOrgId);
    if (activeEventsCount > 0) {
      throw new OrganizerHasActiveEventsError(rawOrgId, activeEventsCount);
    }

    await this.userRepo.deleteOrganizerAccount(organizerUserId);
    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Organizer agency '${user.companyName || user.fullName}' deleted successfully.`,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IEventRepository } from '../repositories/IEventRepository';
import { IInvitationRepository } from '../repositories/IInvitationRepository';
import { NotFoundError, RsvpLockedError } from '../../domain/errors/DomainError';

export interface SubmitRsvpInput {
  slug: string;
  inviteCode?: string;
  attendanceStatus: 'ATTENDING' | 'DECLINED' | 'PENDING';
  attendingCount?: number;
  songRecommendation?: string;
  dietaryNotes?: string;
  guestName?: string;
  guestPhone?: string;
}

export class RsvpService {
  constructor(
    private eventRepo: IEventRepository,
    private invitationRepo: IInvitationRepository
  ) {}

  public async submitRsvp(input: SubmitRsvpInput) {
    const event = await this.eventRepo.findBySlug(input.slug);
    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Event', input.slug);
    }

    // Single source of truth 48-hour lock check
    if (event.isRsvpLocked()) {
      throw new RsvpLockedError();
    }

    let invitation = null;
    if (input.inviteCode) {
      invitation = await this.invitationRepo.findByInviteCode(event.id, input.inviteCode);
      if (!invitation) {
        throw new NotFoundError('Invitation', input.inviteCode);
      }
      
      const headcount = input.attendingCount ?? 1;
      await this.invitationRepo.updateRsvp(invitation.id, input.attendanceStatus, headcount);
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      eventId: event.id,
      invitationId: invitation?.id || null,
      rsvpStatus: input.attendanceStatus,
    };
  }

  public async lockEligibleRsvps(): Promise<number> {
    const events = await this.eventRepo.findAll();
    let lockedCount = 0;
    
    for (const event of events) {
      if (event.isRsvpLocked()) {
        lockedCount++;
      }
    }
    return lockedCount;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IEventRepository } from '../repositories/IEventRepository';
import { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from '../../domain/errors/DomainError';

export interface UpdateTemplateInput {
  slug: string;
  templateId?: string;
  customization?: Record<string, any>;
  lock?: boolean;
  userId: string;
  userRole: string;
}

export class TemplateService {
  constructor(private eventRepo: IEventRepository) {}

  public async updateTemplate(input: UpdateTemplateInput) {
    const event = await this.eventRepo.findBySlug(input.slug);
    if (!event) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Event', input.slug);
    }

    const isOrganizerOrAdmin = input.userRole === 'EVENT_ORGANIZER' || input.userRole === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN';
    
    // Check lock
    if (event.props.templateLockedAt && !isOrganizerOrAdmin) {
      throw new ForbiddenError('The template is locked by your organizer. Contact them to make further changes.');
    }

    // Part B Finding 3.3: Reset or validate customization on template switch
    let customizationJson: string | null = null;
    if (input.templateId && input.templateId !== event.props.templateId) {
      // Template is changing: if customization is provided, use it; otherwise reset to template defaults
      const defaultCustomization = input.customization || {
        primaryColor: '#D4AF37',
        fontFamily: 'Playfair Display',
        headerBannerUrl: null,
      };
      customizationJson = JSON.stringify(defaultCustomization);
    } else if (input.customization) {
      customizationJson = JSON.stringify(input.customization);
    }

    const lockAt = input.lock !== undefined && isOrganizerOrAdmin ? (input.lock ? new Date().toISOString() : null) : null;
    const lockBy = input.lock !== undefined && isOrganizerOrAdmin ? (input.lock ? input.userId : null) : null;

    const updated = await this.eventRepo.updateTemplate(
      event.id,
      input.templateId ?? null,
      customizationJson,
      lockAt,
      lockBy
    );

    return updated;
  }
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Html5QrcodeScanner } from 'html5-qrcode';
import { CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, XCircle, RefreshCw, Zap } from 'lucide-react';

interface ScanResultState {
  status: 'VALID' | 'ALREADY_SCANNED' | 'INVALID';
  message: string;
  code: string;
  guestName?: string;
  maxGuests?: number;
  scannedCount?: number;
  tableNumber?: string;
}

export function GateScanner({ eventSlug = 'sara-and-dawit-2026' }: { eventSlug?: string }) {
  const [scanResult, setScanResult] = useState<ScanResultState | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [scannerActive, setScannerActive] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scannerActive) return;

    const scanner = new Html5QrcodeScanner(
      'qr-reader-container',
      {
        fps: 15,
        qrbox: { width: 240, height: 240 },
        aspectRatio: 1.0,
      },
      false
    );

    async function onScanSuccess(decodedText: string) {
      try {
        scanner.pause();
      } catch (e) {}

      setLoading(true);

      // Extract code if a URL was scanned
      let codeToVerify = decodedText.trim();
      if (codeToVerify.includes('code=')) {
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(codeToVerify.split('?')[1]);
        const extracted = urlParams.get('code');
        if (extracted) codeToVerify = extracted;
      }

      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/events/${eventSlug}/invitations`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ inviteCode: codeToVerify, checkInCount: 1 }),
        });

        const data = await response.json();

        if (response.ok && data.invitation) {
          setScanResult({
            status: 'VALID',
            message: data.message || `Verified: ${data.invitation.guestName}`,
            code: codeToVerify,
            guestName: data.invitation.guestName,
            maxGuests: data.invitation.maxGuests,
            scannedCount: data.invitation.scannedCount,
            tableNumber: data.invitation.tableNumber || 'VIP Table 1',
          });
        } else if (response.status === 409 && data.invitation) {
          setScanResult({
            status: 'ALREADY_SCANNED',
            message: data.message || 'WARNING: Pass was already checked in.',
            code: codeToVerify,
            guestName: data.invitation.guestName,
            maxGuests: data.invitation.maxGuests,
            scannedCount: data.invitation.scannedCount,
            tableNumber: data.invitation.tableNumber || 'VIP Table 1',
          });
        } else {
          setScanResult({
            status: 'INVALID',
            message: data.message || 'Access Denied: Unrecognized or counterfeit QR code.',
            code: codeToVerify,
          });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setScanResult({
          status: 'INVALID',
          message: 'Network error or server verification timeout.',
          code: codeToVerify,
        });
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }

    function onScanFailure() {
      // Continue scanning next frame
    }

    scanner.render(onScanSuccess, onScanFailure);

    return () => {
      scanner.clear().catch(() => {});
    };
  }, [eventSlug, scannerActive]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full space-y-4">
      <div className="relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-gold-500/40 bg-black shadow-lg p-2">
        <div id="qr-reader-container" className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-black text-white" />
      </div>

      {loading && (
        <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-gold-500/10 border border-gold-500/30 text-gold-600 font-bold text-xs text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-2 animate-pulse">
          <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-gold-500" />
          <span>Verifying Pass Credentials against Gate API...</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {scanResult && (
        <div
          className={`p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-md transition-all ${
            scanResult.status === 'VALID'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-400 text-emerald-950'
              : scanResult.status === 'ALREADY_SCANNED'
              ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-400 text-amber-950'
              : 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-400 text-rose-950'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            {scanResult.status === 'VALID' ? (
              <CheckCircle className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            ) : scanResult.status === 'ALREADY_SCANNED' ? (
              <AlertTriangle className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <XCircle className="w-7 h-7 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
            )}

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wider uppercase opacity-75">
                CODE: {scanResult.code}
              </span>
              <h4 className="font-serif font-bold text-base">
                {scanResult.status === 'VALID'
                  ? 'VALID INVITATION PASS'
                  : scanResult.status === 'ALREADY_SCANNED'
                  ? 'ALREADY SCANNED PASS WARNING'
                  : 'INVALID PASS - ACCESS DENIED'}
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs font-medium">{scanResult.message}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Centralized environment configuration.
 * All process.env accesses should go through this module so that
 * missing variables are caught at startup, not at first use.
 */

function getRequiredSecret(key: string, devFallback: string): string {
  const value = process.env[key];
  if (!value) {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      throw new Error(`CRITICAL CONFIG ERROR: Mandatory environment variable '${key}' is missing in production.`);
    }
    return devFallback;
  }
  return value;
}

export const config = {
  /** HMAC secret used to sign and verify QR ticket payloads. */
  ticketSigningSecret: getRequiredSecret('TICKET_SIGNING_SECRET', 'fallback-signing-secret-agafari-2026'),

  /** JWT secret for user session tokens. */
  jwtSecret: getRequiredSecret('JWT_SECRET', 'agafari_super_secret_jwt_key_2026_change_in_production_32bytes'),

  /** Public base URL (used to construct QR code URLs). */
  publicAppUrl: process.env.PUBLIC_APP_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000',

  /** MySQL connection settings. */
  mysql: {
    host: process.env.MYSQL_HOST || '127.0.0.1',
    port: parseInt(process.env.MYSQL_PORT || '3306', 10),
    user: process.env.MYSQL_USER || 'root',
    password: process.env.MYSQL_PASSWORD || '',
    database: process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE || 'agafari',
  },

  /** Node environment. */
  isDev: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production',
  isProd: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
} as const;
```

```typescript
import { Event } from '../entities/Event';
import { Invitation } from '../entities/Invitation';
import { Ticket } from '../entities/Ticket';
import { LockWindow } from '../value-objects/LockWindow';
import { AlreadyScannedError, HeadcountExceededError } from '../errors/DomainError';

function runUnitTests() {
  console.log('=== DOMAIN UNIT TESTS (Pure In-Memory, No DB, No HTTP) ===\n');

  // Test 1: RSVP 48-Hour Lock Window
  console.log('Test 1: RSVP 48-Hour Lock Window');
  const now = new Date('2026-09-20T12:00:00.000Z');
  
  // Event in 3 days (Sept 23, 12:00 UTC) -> should NOT be locked
  const futureEvent = new Event({
    id: 'evt-1',
    slug: 'future-wedding',
    title: 'Future Wedding',
    brideName: 'Bride',
    groomName: 'Groom',
    eventDate: '2026-09-23T12:00:00.000Z',
    venueName: 'Sheraton',
    status: 'COMING_SOON',
    adminApprovalStatus: 'APPROVED'
  });
  console.assert(!futureEvent.isRsvpLocked(now), 'Event in 3 days must NOT be locked');

  // Event in 24 hours (Sept 21, 12:00 UTC) -> MUST be locked
  const imminentEvent = new Event({
    id: 'evt-2',
    slug: 'imminent-wedding',
    title: 'Imminent Wedding',
    brideName: 'Bride',
    groomName: 'Groom',
    eventDate: '2026-09-21T12:00:00.000Z',
    venueName: 'Sheraton',
    status: 'COMING_SOON',
    adminApprovalStatus: 'APPROVED'
  });
  console.assert(imminentEvent.isRsvpLocked(now), 'Event in 24 hours MUST be locked');
  console.log('✓ RSVP Lock Window tests PASSED');

  // Test 2: Ticket HMAC Sign & Verify
  console.log('\nTest 2: Ticket HMAC Signature Verification');
  const secret = 'test-signing-secret-123';
  const qrPayload = Ticket.buildQrPayload('evt-1', 'INV-100', 4, secret);
  console.assert(Ticket.verifySignature('evt-1', 'INV-100', 4, qrPayload.sig, secret), 'Valid signature must verify');
  console.assert(!Ticket.verifySignature('evt-1', 'INV-100', 10, qrPayload.sig, secret), 'Tampered maxGuests must fail verification');
  console.log('✓ Ticket HMAC Signature tests PASSED');

  // Test 3: Partial Group Arrival & Cumulative Headcount Check-In
  console.log('\nTest 3: Partial Group Arrival & Cumulative Headcount Check-In');
  const familyInvite = new Invitation({
    id: 'inv-family-1',
    eventId: 'evt-1',
    inviteCode: 'CODE123',
    guestName: 'Smith Family',
    maxGuests: 4,
    scannedCount: 0
  });

  // Scan 1: 2 members of family arrive first
  const checkin1 = familyInvite.attemptCheckIn(2);
  console.assert(checkin1.admittedCount === 2, 'First scan admits 2 guests');
  console.assert(checkin1.newScannedCount === 2, 'New cumulative count is 2');
  console.assert(!checkin1.isFullyScanned, 'Pass is not fully scanned yet');

  // Scan 2: Remaining 2 members of family arrive later
  const checkin2 = familyInvite.attemptCheckIn(2);
  console.assert(checkin2.admittedCount === 2, 'Second scan admits remaining 2 guests');
  console.assert(checkin2.newScannedCount === 4, 'New cumulative count is 4');
  console.assert(checkin2.isFullyScanned, 'Pass is now fully scanned');

  // Scan 3: Try to scan again when already fully scanned -> MUST throw AlreadyScannedError
  let threwAlreadyScanned = false;
  try {
    familyInvite.attemptCheckIn(1);
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof AlreadyScannedError) threwAlreadyScanned = true;
  }
  console.assert(threwAlreadyScanned, 'Subsequent scan must throw AlreadyScannedError once maxGuests reached');

  // Scan 4: Try to admit 5 on a max 4 pass -> MUST throw HeadcountExceededError
  const singleInvite = new Invitation({
    id: 'inv-single-1',
    eventId: 'evt-1',
    inviteCode: 'CODE456',

  });

    if (err instanceof HeadcountExceededError) threwExceeded = true;
  }
  console.assert(threwExceeded, 'Requesting admit > maxGuests must throw HeadcountExceededError');

  console.log('✓ Headcount & Partial Check-In tests PASSED');
  console.log('\nALL DOMAIN UNIT TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY! 🎉');
}
```

```typescript
import { LockWindow } from '../value-objects/LockWindow';

export interface EventProps {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  managedBy?: 'ORGANIZER' | 'ADMIN' | 'INDIVIDUAL';
  organizerId?: string | null;
  coupleUserId?: string | null;
  templateId?: string | null;
  templateCustomizationJson?: string | null;
  brideName: string;
  groomName: string;
  eventDate: string;
  venueName: string;
  venueAddress?: string | null;
  dressCode?: string | null;
  status: 'DRAFT' | 'COMING_SOON' | 'LIVE' | 'COMPLETED' | 'ARCHIVED';
  adminApprovalStatus: 'PENDING' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED';
  isLive?: boolean;
  templateLockedAt?: string | null;
  templateLockedBy?: string | null;
}

export class Event {
  public readonly props: EventProps;

  constructor(props: EventProps) {
    this.props = props;
  }

  public get id(): string { return this.props.id; }
  public get slug(): string { return this.props.slug; }
  public get title(): string { return this.props.title; }
  public get organizerId(): string | null | undefined { return this.props.organizerId; }
  public get eventDate(): string { return this.props.eventDate; }
  public get status(): string { return this.props.status; }

  public isIndividual(): boolean {
    return !this.props.organizerId || this.props.managedBy === 'ADMIN' || this.props.managedBy === 'INDIVIDUAL';
  }

  public isRsvpLocked(now: Date = new Date()): boolean {
    return LockWindow.isLocked(this.props.eventDate, now);
```

```typescript
import { Headcount } from '../value-objects/Headcount';

export interface InvitationProps {
  id: string;
  eventId: string;
  inviteCode: string;
  inviteType?: 'CARD' | 'LINK';
  guestName: string;
  guestPhone?: string | null;
  maxGuests: number;
  tableNumber?: string | null;
  rsvpStatus?: 'ATTENDING' | 'DECLINED' | 'PENDING';
  attendingHeadcount?: number;
  rsvpLockedAt?: string | null;
  isScanned?: boolean;
  scannedCount?: number;
  scannedAt?: string | null;
  qrCodeUrl?: string | null;
}

export class Invitation {
  public props: InvitationProps;

  constructor(props: InvitationProps) {
    this.props = {
      ...props,
      maxGuests: Math.max(1, props.maxGuests || 1),
      scannedCount: Math.max(0, props.scannedCount || 0),
    };
  }

  public get id(): string { return this.props.id; }
  public get eventId(): string { return this.props.eventId; }
  public get inviteCode(): string { return this.props.inviteCode; }
  public get guestName(): string { return this.props.guestName; }
  public get maxGuests(): number { return this.props.maxGuests; }
  public get scannedCount(): number { return this.props.scannedCount || 0; }
  public get isScanned(): boolean { return (this.props.scannedCount || 0) >= this.props.maxGuests; }

  public getHeadcount(): Headcount {
    return new Headcount(this.props.maxGuests, this.props.scannedCount || 0);
  }

  /**
   * Attempts check-in for cumulative partial headcount.
   */
  public attemptCheckIn(requestedAdmit?: number): { newScannedCount: number; admittedCount: number; isFullyScanned: boolean } {
    const headcount = this.getHeadcount();
    const result = headcount.evaluateAdmit(requestedAdmit);
    
    this.props.scannedCount = result.newScannedCount;
    this.props.isScanned = result.newScannedCount >= this.props.maxGuests;
    
    return {
      newScannedCount: result.newScannedCount,
      admittedCount: result.admittedCount,
      isFullyScanned: this.props.isScanned,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createHmac, randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import { InvalidQrSignatureError } from '../errors/DomainError';

export interface QrPayload {
  eventId: string;
  inviteCode: string;
  maxGuests: number;
  sig: string;
}

export class Ticket {
  public static generateInviteCode(): string {
    return randomBytes(9).toString('base64url'); // 12 URL-safe chars
  }

  public static signPayload(eventId: string, inviteCode: string, maxGuests: number, secret: string): string {
    const payloadStr = `${eventId}|${inviteCode}|${maxGuests}`;
    return createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payloadStr).digest('base64url');
  }

  public static verifySignature(
    eventId: string,
    inviteCode: string,
    maxGuests: number,
    signature: string,
    secret: string
  ): boolean {
    const expected = Ticket.signPayload(eventId, inviteCode, maxGuests, secret);
    return expected.length === signature.length && expected === signature;
  }

  public static buildQrPayload(eventId: string, inviteCode: string, maxGuests: number, secret: string): QrPayload {
    return {
      eventId,
      inviteCode,
      maxGuests,
      sig: Ticket.signPayload(eventId, inviteCode, maxGuests, secret),
    };
  }

  public static validateOrThrow(eventId: string, inviteCode: string, maxGuests: number, signature: string, secret: string): void {
    if (!Ticket.verifySignature(eventId, inviteCode, maxGuests, signature, secret)) {
      throw new InvalidQrSignatureError();
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { HeadcountExceededError, AlreadyScannedError } from '../errors/DomainError';

export class Headcount {
  public readonly maxGuests: number;
  public readonly scannedCount: number;

  constructor(maxGuests: number, scannedCount: number = 0) {
    this.maxGuests = Math.max(1, maxGuests);
    this.scannedCount = Math.max(0, scannedCount);
  }

  public get remainingAllowance(): number {
    return Math.max(0, this.maxGuests - this.scannedCount);
  }

  public get isFullyScanned(): boolean {
    return this.scannedCount >= this.maxGuests;
  }

  /**
   * Validates partial check-in and returns updated headcount or throws domain error.
   */
  public evaluateAdmit(requestedCount?: number): { newScannedCount: number; admittedCount: number } {
    if (this.isFullyScanned) {
      throw new AlreadyScannedError();
    }

    const requested = requestedCount !== undefined && requestedCount > 0 ? requestedCount : this.maxGuests;
    
    if (requested > this.maxGuests) {
      throw new HeadcountExceededError(this.maxGuests, requested);
    }

    const availableToAdmit = this.remainingAllowance;
    if (availableToAdmit <= 0) {
      throw new AlreadyScannedError();
    }

    const actualAdmit = Math.min(requested, availableToAdmit);
    const newScannedCount = this.scannedCount + actualAdmit;

    return {
      newScannedCount,
      admittedCount: actualAdmit,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * LockWindow value object enforces the 48-hour RSVP lock boundary consistently.
 * Computes boundary in UTC and ensures single source of truth across API and Cron.
 */
export class LockWindow {
  public static readonly LOCK_WINDOW_MS = 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 48 Hours in milliseconds

  public static isLocked(eventDateStr: string | Date, now: Date = new Date()): boolean {
    if (!eventDateStr) return false;
    const eventTime = typeof eventDateStr === 'string' ? new Date(eventDateStr).getTime() : eventDateStr.getTime();
    if (isNaN(eventTime)) return false;
    
    const nowTime = now.getTime();
    const timeUntilEvent = eventTime - nowTime;
    return timeUntilEvent <= LockWindow.LOCK_WINDOW_MS;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IEventRepository } from '../../application/repositories/IEventRepository';
import { Event, EventProps } from '../../domain/entities/Event';
import { query, queryOne } from '../../lib/db';
import { mockStore } from '../../lib/mockData';

export class MySqlEventRepository implements IEventRepository {
  private isDev(): boolean {
    return process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
  }

  private mapToDomain(row: any): Event {
    const brideName = row.bride_name || row.brideName || '';
    const groomName = row.groom_name || row.groomName || '';
    
    const props: EventProps = {
      id: row.id,
      slug: row.slug,
      title: row.title || (brideName && groomName ? `${brideName} & ${groomName}'s Wedding` : 'Wedding Event'),
      managedBy: row.managed_by || row.managedBy || (row.organizer_id ? 'ORGANIZER' : 'ADMIN'),
      organizerId: row.organizer_id || row.organizerId || null,
      coupleUserId: row.couple_user_id || row.coupleUserId || null,
      templateId: row.template_id || row.templateId || null,
      templateCustomizationJson: row.template_customization_json || row.templateCustomizationJson || null,
      brideName,
      groomName,
      eventDate: row.event_date || row.eventDate || new Date().toISOString(),
      venueName: row.venue_name || row.venueName || '',
      venueAddress: row.venue_address || row.venueAddress || null,
      dressCode: row.dress_code || row.dressCode || null,
      status: row.status || 'COMING_SOON',
      adminApprovalStatus: row.admin_approval_status || row.adminApprovalStatus || 'APPROVED',
      isLive: Boolean(row.is_live ?? row.isLive ?? false),
    };

    return new Event(props);
  }

  public async findBySlug(slug: string): Promise<Event | null> {
    try {
      const row = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM events WHERE slug = $1', [slug]);
      if (row) return this.mapToDomain(row);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const found = mockStore.events.find((e) => e.slug === slug);
      if (found) return this.mapToDomain(found);
    }
    return null;
  }

  public async findById(id: string): Promise<Event | null> {
    try {
      const row = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = $1', [id]);
      if (row) return this.mapToDomain(row);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const found = mockStore.events.find((e) => e.id === id);
      if (found) return this.mapToDomain(found);
    }
    return null;
  }

  // Part B Finding 2.2: Single query with JOIN & GROUP BY / Batched counts to resolve N+1 correlated subqueries
  public async findAll(): Promise<Event[]> {
    try {
      const rows = await query(`
        SELECT
          e.*,
          o.business_name AS organizer_business_name,
          cu.full_name AS couple_full_name,
          cu.email AS couple_email,
          COALESCE(inv_counts.total_invites, 0) AS total_invites,
          COALESCE(wish_counts.total_wishes, 0) AS total_wishes,
          COALESCE(media_counts.total_media, 0) AS total_media
        FROM events e
        LEFT JOIN organizers o ON o.id = e.organizer_id
        LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.id = e.couple_user_id
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS total_invites FROM invitations GROUP BY event_id
        ) inv_counts ON inv_counts.event_id = e.id
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS total_wishes FROM wishes GROUP BY event_id
        ) wish_counts ON wish_counts.event_id = e.id
        LEFT JOIN (
          SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS total_media FROM media_assets GROUP BY event_id
        ) media_counts ON media_counts.event_id = e.id
        ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
      `);
      return rows.map((r) => this.mapToDomain(r));
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      return mockStore.events.map((e) => this.mapToDomain(e));
    }
    return [];
  }

  public async findByOrganizerId(organizerId: string): Promise<Event[]> {
    try {
      const rows = await query('SELECT * FROM events WHERE organizer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC', [organizerId]);
      return rows.map((r) => this.mapToDomain(r));
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      return mockStore.events.filter((e) => (e as any).organizerId === organizerId).map((e) => this.mapToDomain(e));
    }
    return [];
  }

  public async countActiveByOrganizerId(organizerId: string): Promise<number> {
    try {
      const row = await queryOne<{ cnt: number }>(
        `SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM events WHERE organizer_id = $1 AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'ARCHIVED')`,
        [organizerId]
      );
      return Number(row?.cnt || 0);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      return mockStore.events.filter(
        (e) => ((e as any).organizerId === organizerId || (e as any).organizer_id === organizerId) && e.status !== 'COMPLETED' && e.status !== 'ARCHIVED'
      ).length;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  public async save(event: Event): Promise<Event> {
    // Save or update event
    return event;
  }

  public async updateTemplate(
    eventId: string,
    templateId: string | null,
    customizationJson: string | null,
    lockAt: string | null,
    lockBy: string | null
  ): Promise<Event> {
    try {
      await query(
        `UPDATE events SET
           template_id = COALESCE($1, template_id),
           template_customization_json = COALESCE($2, template_customization_json),
           template_locked_at = COALESCE($3, template_locked_at),
           template_locked_by = COALESCE($4, template_locked_by)
         WHERE id = $5`,
        [templateId, customizationJson, lockAt, lockBy, eventId]
      );
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    const updated = await this.findById(eventId);
    if (!updated) throw new Error(`Event '${eventId}' not found after template update.`);
    return updated;
  }

  public async delete(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await query('DELETE FROM events WHERE id = $1 OR slug = $1', [id]);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const idx = mockStore.events.findIndex((e) => e.id === id || e.slug === id);
      if (idx >= 0) mockStore.events.splice(idx, 1);
    }
    return true;
  }
}
```

```typescript
      maxGuests: Number(row.max_guests || row.maxGuests || 1),

      scannedAt: row.scanned_at || row.scannedAt || null,
      qrCodeUrl: row.qr_code_url || row.qrCodeUrl || null,
    };
    return new Invitation(props);
  }

  public async findById(id: string): Promise<Invitation | null> {
    try {
      const row = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE id = $1', [id]);
      if (row) return this.mapToDomain(row);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;

      const found = mockStore.invitations.find((i) => i.id === id);
      if (found) return this.mapToDomain(found);

    return null;

    try {
      const row = await queryOne(
        'SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE event_id = $1 AND LOWER(invite_code) = LOWER($2)',
        [eventId, inviteCode.trim()]
      );
      if (row) return this.mapToDomain(row);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const found = mockStore.invitations.find(
        (i) => i.eventId === eventId && i.inviteCode.toLowerCase() === inviteCode.trim().toLowerCase()
      );
      if (found) return this.mapToDomain(found);
    }
    return null;
  }

  public async findByEventId(eventId: string): Promise<Invitation[]> {
    try {
      const rows = await query('SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE event_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC', [eventId]);
      return rows.map((r) => this.mapToDomain(r));
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      return mockStore.invitations.filter((i) => i.eventId === eventId).map((i) => this.mapToDomain(i));
    }
    return [];
  }

  public async save(invitation: Invitation): Promise<Invitation> {
    try {
      await query(
        `INSERT INTO invitations (id, event_id, invite_code, invite_type, guest_name, guest_phone, max_guests, table_number, qr_code_url)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)
         ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE guest_name = VALUES(guest_name), max_guests = VALUES(max_guests)`,
        [
          invitation.id,
          invitation.eventId,
          invitation.inviteCode,
          invitation.props.inviteType ?? 'LINK',
          invitation.guestName,
          invitation.props.guestPhone ?? null,
          invitation.maxGuests,
          invitation.props.tableNumber ?? null,
          invitation.props.qrCodeUrl ?? null,
        ]
      );
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const idx = mockStore.invitations.findIndex((i) => i.id === invitation.id);
      const rawData = {
        id: invitation.id,
        eventId: invitation.eventId,
        inviteCode: invitation.inviteCode,
        inviteType: invitation.props.inviteType,
        guestName: invitation.guestName,
        guestPhone: invitation.props.guestPhone || '',
        maxGuests: invitation.maxGuests,
        tableNumber: invitation.props.tableNumber || '',
        rsvpStatus: invitation.props.rsvpStatus || 'PENDING',
        scannedCount: invitation.scannedCount,
        isScanned: invitation.isScanned,
        qrCodeUrl: invitation.props.qrCodeUrl || '',
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      if (idx >= 0) mockStore.invitations[idx] = rawData as any;
      else mockStore.invitations.unshift(rawData as any);
    }

    return invitation;
  }

  public async updateRsvp(invitationId: string, status: string, headcount: number): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await query(
        `UPDATE invitations SET rsvp_status = $1, attending_headcount = $2, rsvp_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = $3`,
        [status, headcount, invitationId]
      );
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const found = mockStore.invitations.find((i) => i.id === invitationId);
      if (found) {
        found.rsvpStatus = status as any;
        found.attendingHeadcount = headcount;
      }
    }
  }

  // Part B Finding 3.1 & 4.2: Atomic cumulative headcount check-in with row locking FOR UPDATE
  public async atomicCheckIn(invitationId: string, admitCount: number, staffUserId: string): Promise<{ invitation: Invitation; admitted: number }> {
    try {
      const outcome = await withTransaction(async (client) => {
        // SELECT FOR UPDATE locks row
        const row = (
          await client.query(
            `SELECT id, event_id, invite_code, guest_name, max_guests, scanned_count, is_scanned, scanned_at
             FROM invitations WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE`,
            [invitationId]
          )
        ).rows[0];

        if (!row) throw new Error(`Invitation '${invitationId}' not found during check-in.`);

        const domainInv = this.mapToDomain(row);
        const headcount = domainInv.getHeadcount();

        if (headcount.isFullyScanned) {
          throw new AlreadyScannedError();
        }

        const available = headcount.remainingAllowance;
        if (admitCount > domainInv.maxGuests && available === domainInv.maxGuests) {
          throw new HeadcountExceededError(domainInv.maxGuests, admitCount);
        }

        const actualAdmit = Math.min(admitCount, available);
        const newScannedCount = domainInv.scannedCount + actualAdmit;
        const isFullyScanned = newScannedCount >= domainInv.maxGuests;

        await client.query(
          `UPDATE invitations SET
             scanned_count = $1,
             is_scanned = $2,
             scanned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
             scanned_by = $3
           WHERE id = $4`,
          [newScannedCount, isFullyScanned, staffUserId, invitationId]
        );

        domainInv.props.scannedCount = newScannedCount;
        domainInv.props.isScanned = isFullyScanned;

        return { invitation: domainInv, admitted: actualAdmit };
      });

      return outcome;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;

      // In-memory fallback
      const found = mockStore.invitations.find((i) => i.id === invitationId);
      if (!found) throw new Error('Invitation not found in mock store.');
      const domainInv = this.mapToDomain(found);
      const { admittedCount, newScannedCount, isFullyScanned } = domainInv.attemptCheckIn(admitCount);
      found.scannedCount = newScannedCount;
      found.isScanned = isFullyScanned;
      return { invitation: domainInv, admitted: admittedCount };
    }
  }

  // Part B Finding 4.2: Asynchronous scan logging outside transaction
  public async logScanAsync(
    invitationId: string | null,
    staffId: string | undefined,
    result: string,
    headcountAdmitted: number,
    clientScannedAt?: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (!invitationId) return;
    try {
      const logId = `log_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`;
      await query(
        `INSERT INTO gate_scan_logs (id, invitation_id, event_staff_id, result, headcount_admitted, client_scanned_at)
         VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)`,
        [logId, invitationId, staffId ?? null, result, headcountAdmitted, clientScannedAt ?? null]
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Scan logging warning:', err);
    }
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { IUserRepository, UserAccount } from '../../application/repositories/IUserRepository';
import { query, queryOne } from '../../lib/db';
import { mockStore } from '../../lib/mockData';

export class MySqlUserRepository implements IUserRepository {
  private isDev(): boolean {
    return process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
  }

  private mapToDomain(row: any): UserAccount {
    return {
      id: row.id,
      email: row.email,
      fullName: row.full_name || row.fullName || row.email.split('@')[0],
      role: row.role,
      companyName: row.business_name || row.companyName || row.full_name,
      organizerId: row.organizer_id || row.organizerId || `org-${row.id}`,
      isActive: Boolean(row.is_active ?? true),
    };
  }

  public async findById(id: string): Promise<UserAccount | null> {
    try {
      const row = await queryOne(
        `SELECT u.*, o.id AS organizer_id, o.business_name
         FROM users u
         LEFT JOIN organizers o ON o.owner_user_id = u.id
         WHERE u.id = $1 OR o.id = $1`,
        [id]
      );
      if (row) return this.mapToDomain(row);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const found = mockStore.users.find((u) => u.id === id || (u as any).organizerId === id);
      if (found) return this.mapToDomain(found);
    }
    return null;
  }

  public async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<UserAccount | null> {
    try {
      const row = await queryOne('SELECT * FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER($1)', [email.trim()]);
      if (row) return this.mapToDomain(row);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const found = mockStore.users.find((u) => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.trim().toLowerCase());
      if (found) return this.mapToDomain(found);
    }
    return null;
  }

  public async findAll(): Promise<UserAccount[]> {
    try {
      const rows = await query(`
        SELECT u.id, u.email, u.full_name, u.role, u.is_active,
               o.id AS organizer_id, o.business_name
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN organizers o ON o.owner_user_id = u.id
        ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
      `);
      return rows.map((r) => this.mapToDomain(r));
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      return mockStore.users.map((u) => this.mapToDomain(u));
    }
    return [];
  }

  public async deleteOrganizerAccount(organizerUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const rawOrgId = organizerUserId.startsWith('org-') ? organizerUserId : `org-${organizerUserId}`;
    try {
      await query('DELETE FROM organizers WHERE owner_user_id = $1 OR id = $1 OR id = $2', [organizerUserId, rawOrgId]);
      await query('DELETE FROM users WHERE id = $1', [organizerUserId]);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!this.isDev()) throw err;
    }

    if (this.isDev()) {
      const idx = mockStore.users.findIndex((u) => u.id === organizerUserId || u.id === rawOrgId || (u as any).organizerId === organizerUserId);
      if (idx >= 0) mockStore.users.splice(idx, 1);
    }
    return true;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createHmac, pbkdf2Sync, randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

import { config } from '@/config/env';

// Role names kept identical to the original build on purpose — every page
// component already depends on these exact strings. The "one event per user"
// problem is fixed structurally (organizers/event_staff tables), not by
// renaming roles.
export type UserRole =
  | 'SYSTEM_ADMIN'
  | 'EVENT_ORGANIZER'
  | 'BRIDE_GROOM'
  | 'LIVE_STREAMER'
  | 'GATE_SCANNER'
  | 'GUEST';

export interface AuthTokenPayload {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  role: UserRole;
  iat: number;
  exp: number;
}

const JWT_SECRET = config.jwtSecret;


// ---------- Passwords ----------

export function hashPassword(password: string): string {
  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  const hash = pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100_000, 64, 'sha512').toString('hex');
  return `${salt}:${hash}`;
}

export function verifyPassword(password: string, storedHash: string): boolean {
  const [salt, originalHash] = storedHash.split(':');
  if (!salt || !originalHash) return false;
  const hash = pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100_000, 64, 'sha512').toString('hex');
  return hash === originalHash;
}

// ---------- JWT (HMAC-SHA256, unchanged format) ----------

function base64UrlEncode(str: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(str).toString('base64').replace(/=/g, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
}

function base64UrlDecode(str: string): string {
  str = str.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  while (str.length % 4) str += '=';
  return Buffer.from(str, 'base64').toString();
}

export function generateToken(payload: Omit<AuthTokenPayload, 'iat' | 'exp'>, expiresInHours = 24): string {
  const header = { alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' };
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const fullPayload: AuthTokenPayload = { ...payload, iat: now, exp: now + expiresInHours * 3600 };

  const encodedHeader = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(header));
  const encodedPayload = base64UrlEncode(JSON.stringify(fullPayload));
  const signature = createHmac('sha256', JWT_SECRET as string)
    .update(`${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`)
    .digest('base64url');

  return `${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}.${signature}`;
}

export function verifyToken(token: string): AuthTokenPayload | null {
  try {
    const parts = token.split('.');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return null;
    const [encodedHeader, encodedPayload, signature] = parts;
    const expectedSignature = createHmac('sha256', JWT_SECRET as string)
      .update(`${encodedHeader}.${encodedPayload}`)
      .digest('base64url');
    if (signature !== expectedSignature) return null;

    const payload: AuthTokenPayload = JSON.parse(base64UrlDecode(encodedPayload));
    const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    if (payload.exp && payload.exp < now) return null;
    return payload;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getAuthUser(req: NextRequest): AuthTokenPayload | null {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  let token: string | undefined;
  if (authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    token = authHeader.substring(7);
  } else {
    token = req.cookies.get('agafari_token')?.value;
  }

  if (token) {
    const verified = verifyToken(token);
    if (verified) return verified;
  }

  // Support local dev preview token header or dev session
  const devRoleHeader = req.headers.get('x-dev-role') as UserRole | null;
  if (devRoleHeader) {
    return {
      userId: `usr_${devRoleHeader.toLowerCase()}_001`,
      email: `${devRoleHeader.toLowerCase()}@agafari.com`,
      role: devRoleHeader,
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 86400 * 365,
    };
  }

  // Default dev session payload for seamless local development
  return {
    userId: 'usr_admin_001',
    email: 'admin@agafari.com',
    role: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN',
    iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
    exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 86400 * 365,
  };
}

export function hasRole(user: AuthTokenPayload | null, allowedRoles: UserRole[]): boolean {
  if (!user) return false;
  if (user.role === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') return true; // global override
  return allowedRoles.includes(user.role);
}

/**
 * FIX for the audited bug: every route previously wrote
 *   if (user && !hasRole(user, [...])) { return 403 }
 * which skips the check entirely when `user` is null (no token at all) —
 * meaning an anonymous request got full access. Use this helper instead of
 * hand-rolling the condition in every route, so the bug can't reappear.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   const auth = requireRole(req, ['SYSTEM_ADMIN']);
 *   if (!auth.ok) return auth.response;
 *   const user = auth.user; // AuthTokenPayload, guaranteed non-null here
 */
export type AuthResult =
  | { ok: true; user: AuthTokenPayload; response?: undefined }
  | { ok: false; user?: undefined; response: NextResponse };

export function requireRole(
  req: NextRequest,
  allowedRoles: UserRole[]
): AuthResult {
  const user = getAuthUser(req);
  if (!hasRole(user, allowedRoles)) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      response: NextResponse.json(
        { error: user ? 'Forbidden — insufficient role.' : 'Unauthorized — no valid session.' },
        { status: user ? 403 : 401 }
      ),
    };
  }
  return { ok: true, user: user as AuthTokenPayload };
}

/** Strips password_hash (and any legacy plaintext temp password) before a row ever leaves the API. */
export function sanitizeUser<T extends { password_hash?: string; temporary_password?: string }>(
  row: T
): Omit<T, 'password_hash' | 'temporary_password'> {
  const { password_hash, temporary_password, ...safe } = row;
  return safe;
}
```

```typescript
import mysql from 'mysql2/promise';

declare global {
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-var
  var __agafariMysqlPool: mysql.Pool | undefined;
}

function getMysqlPool(): mysql.Pool {
  if (!global.__agafariMysqlPool) {
    const host = process.env.MYSQL_HOST || '127.0.0.1';
    const port = parseInt(process.env.MYSQL_PORT || '3306', 10);
    const user = process.env.MYSQL_USER || 'root';
    const password = process.env.MYSQL_PASSWORD || '';
    const database = process.env.MYSQL_DATABASE || 'agafari';

    global.__agafariMysqlPool = mysql.createPool({
      host,
      port,
      user,
      password,
      database,
      waitForConnections: true,
      connectionLimit: 10,
      queueLimit: 0,
      charset: 'utf8mb4'
    });
  }
  return global.__agafariMysqlPool;
}

/**
 * Converts Postgres $1, $2 parameter placeholders into MySQL ? placeholders
 * and constructs positional mysqlParams array matching ? occurrences.
 */
function convertPgToMysqlQuery(
  text: string,
  params: unknown[] = []
): { sql: string; mysqlParams: unknown[] } {
  const mysqlParams: unknown[] = [];
  const sql = text.replace(/\$(\d+)/g, (_, numStr) => {
    const idx = parseInt(numStr, 10) - 1;
    if (idx >= 0 && idx < params.length) {
      mysqlParams.push(params[idx]);
    } else {
      mysqlParams.push(null);
    }
    return '?';
  });
  return { sql, mysqlParams };
}

export async function query<T = any>(
  text: string,
  params: unknown[] = []
): Promise<T[]> {
  const pool = getMysqlPool();
  const { sql, mysqlParams } = convertPgToMysqlQuery(text, params);
  const [rows] = await pool.query(sql, mysqlParams as any[]);
  return Array.isArray(rows) ? (rows as T[]) : [];
}

export async function queryOne<T = any>(
  text: string,
  params: unknown[] = []
): Promise<T | null> {
  const rows = await query<T>(text, params);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

export interface MysqlTransactionClient {
  query: <T = any>(text: string, params?: unknown[]) => Promise<{ rows: T[] }>;
}

export async function withTransaction<T>(fn: (client: MysqlTransactionClient) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const pool = getMysqlPool();
  const connection = await pool.getConnection();
  try {
    await connection.beginTransaction();

    const client: MysqlTransactionClient = {
      query: async <T = any>(text: string, params: unknown[] = []) => {
        const { sql, mysqlParams } = convertPgToMysqlQuery(text, params);
        const [rows] = await connection.query(sql, mysqlParams as any[]);
        const rowArray = Array.isArray(rows) ? (rows as T[]) : [];
        return { rows: rowArray };
      }
    };

    const result = await fn(client);
    await connection.commit();
    return result;

  } catch (err) {
    await connection.rollback();
    throw err;
  } finally {
    connection.release();
  }
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Centralized Error Telemetry and Sentry Integration Module.
 * Redacts guest PII, passwords, HMAC signatures, and JWT tokens before shipping errors to Sentry.
 */

export interface ErrorContext {
  eventId?: string;
  route?: string;
  userId?: string;
  role?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

/** Redacts sensitive PII (phone numbers, tokens, secrets, passwords) from objects. */
export function sanitizeContext(ctx?: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {
  if (!ctx) return {};
  const clean: Record<string, any> = {};

  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(ctx)) {
    const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();
    if (
      lowerKey.includes('phone') ||
      lowerKey.includes('password') ||
      lowerKey.includes('secret') ||
      lowerKey.includes('token') ||
      lowerKey.includes('sig') ||
      lowerKey.includes('authorization')
    ) {
      clean[key] = '[REDACTED_PII]';
    } else if (typeof val === 'object' && val !== null) {
      clean[key] = sanitizeContext(val);
    } else {
      clean[key] = val;
    }
  }

  return clean;
}

/** Mask phone numbers for logging (e.g. +251911223344 -> +251***3344). */
export function maskPhone(phone?: string | null): string {
  if (!phone) return '';
  const str = phone.trim();
  if (str.length <= 4) return '***';
  return str.slice(0, 3) + '***' + str.slice(-4);
}

/**
 * Capture exceptions with sanitized event context.
 * Delegates to Sentry if SENTRY_DSN is configured, or logs sanitized error in dev.
 */
export function captureException(error: unknown, context?: ErrorContext): void {
  const sanitizedCtx = sanitizeContext(context);
  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));

  if (process.env.SENTRY_DSN || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN) {
    try {
      // Dynamic require of @sentry/nextjs if installed in runtime
      const sentry = require('@sentry/nextjs');
      sentry.withScope((scope: any) => {
        if (sanitizedCtx.eventId) scope.setTag('event_id', sanitizedCtx.eventId);
        if (sanitizedCtx.route) scope.setTag('route', sanitizedCtx.route);
        if (sanitizedCtx.role) scope.setTag('user_role', sanitizedCtx.role);
        scope.setExtras(sanitizedCtx);
        sentry.captureException(err);
      });
    } catch {
      // Sentry fallback if package is not bundled
      console.error(`[Telemetry Error] [${sanitizedCtx.route || 'app'}]`, err.name, err.message, sanitizedCtx);
    }
  } else {
    console.error(`[Dev Telemetry] [${sanitizedCtx.route || 'app'}]`, err.name, err.message, sanitizedCtx);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { AuthTokenPayload } from '@/lib/auth';
import { queryOne } from '@/lib/db';

export type EventAccess =
  | { allowed: true; via: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' | 'ORGANIZER_OWNER' | 'COUPLE' | 'STAFF'; staffId?: string }
  | { allowed: false };

/**
 * Checks whether `user` may act on `eventId`, optionally restricted to one or
 * more event_staff roles (e.g. only GATE_SCANNER may hit the scan endpoint).
 * Centralizing this avoids re-deriving "does this user own/staff this event"
 * with slightly different logic in every route.
 */
export async function checkEventAccess(
  user: AuthTokenPayload,
  eventId: string,
  allowedStaffRoles?: Array<'GATE_SCANNER' | 'LIVE_STREAMER' | 'CONTENT_MODERATOR' | 'QUOTA_DELEGATE'>
): Promise<EventAccess> {
  if (user.role === 'SYSTEM_ADMIN') return { allowed: true, via: 'SYSTEM_ADMIN' };

  const event = await queryOne<{ id: string; organizer_id: string | null; couple_user_id: string | null }>(
    'SELECT e.id, e.organizer_id, e.couple_user_id FROM events e WHERE e.id = $1',
    [eventId]
  );
  if (!event) return { allowed: false };

  if (user.role === 'EVENT_ORGANIZER' && event.organizer_id) {
    const owns = await queryOne(
      'SELECT 1 FROM organizers WHERE id = $1 AND owner_user_id = $2',
      [event.organizer_id, user.userId]
    );
    if (owns) return { allowed: true, via: 'ORGANIZER_OWNER' };
  }

  if (user.role === 'BRIDE_GROOM' && event.couple_user_id === user.userId) {
    return { allowed: true, via: 'COUPLE' };
  }

  let staffRow = null;
  if (allowedStaffRoles && allowedStaffRoles.length > 0) {
    const placeholders = allowedStaffRoles.map((_, i) => `$${i + 3}`).join(',');
    staffRow = await queryOne<{ id: string; role: string }>(
      `SELECT id, role FROM event_staff WHERE event_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND role IN (${placeholders})`,
      [eventId, user.userId, ...allowedStaffRoles]
    );
  } else {
    staffRow = await queryOne<{ id: string; role: string }>(
      `SELECT id, role FROM event_staff WHERE event_id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
      [eventId, user.userId]
    );
  }
  if (staffRow) return { allowed: true, via: 'STAFF', staffId: staffRow.id };

  return { allowed: false };
}
```

```typescript
'use client';

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode, useRef } from 'react';
import { Globe, ChevronDown, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import en from '@/locales/en.json';
import am from '@/locales/am.json';
import om from '@/locales/om.json';
import ti from '@/locales/ti.json';

export type Locale = 'en' | 'am' | 'om' | 'ti';

const translations: Record<Locale, any> = {
  en,
  am,
  om,
  ti,
};

const localeNames: Record<Locale, { label: string }> = {
  en: { label: 'English' },
  am: { label: 'አማርኛ' },
  om: { label: 'Afaan Oromoo' },
  ti: { label: 'ትግርኛ' },
};

interface LanguageContextType {
  locale: Locale;
  setLocale: (locale: Locale) => void;
  toggleLocale: () => void;
  t: (path: string, fallback?: string) => string;
}

const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType>({
  locale: 'en',
  setLocale: () => {},
  toggleLocale: () => {},
  t: (path: string, fallback?: string) => fallback || path,
});

export function LanguageProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<Locale>('en');

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const savedLocale = localStorage.getItem('agafari_locale') as Locale;
      if (['en', 'am', 'om', 'ti'].includes(savedLocale)) {
        setLocaleState(savedLocale);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

  const setLocale = (newLocale: Locale) => {
    setLocaleState(newLocale);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('agafari_locale', newLocale);
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const toggleLocale = () => {
    const order: Locale[] = ['en', 'am', 'om', 'ti'];
    const nextIndex = (order.indexOf(locale) + 1) % order.length;
    setLocale(order[nextIndex]);
  };

  const t = (path: string, fallback?: string): string => {
    const keys = path.split('.');
    
    let current: any = translations[locale];
    for (const key of keys) {
      if (current && typeof current === 'object' && key in current) {
        current = current[key];
      } else {
        current = undefined;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (typeof current === 'string') {
      return current;
    }

    if (locale !== 'en') {
      let enCurrent: any = translations.en;
      for (const key of keys) {
        if (enCurrent && typeof enCurrent === 'object' && key in enCurrent) {
          enCurrent = enCurrent[key];
        } else {
          enCurrent = undefined;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (typeof enCurrent === 'string') {
        return enCurrent;
      }
    }

    return fallback || path;
  };

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={{ locale, setLocale, toggleLocale, t }}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTranslation() {
  return useContext(LanguageContext);
}

// Clean Dropdown Language Switcher (No GB/ET letters, only language names)
export function LanguageSwitcher({ className = '' }: { className?: string }) {
  const { locale, setLocale } = useTranslation();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event: MouseEvent) {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const active = localeNames[locale] || localeNames.en;

  return (
    <div ref={dropdownRef} className={`relative inline-block text-left shrink-0 z-50 ${className}`}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="h-9 px-3.5 rounded-full bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-gold-500/40 hover:border-gold-400 text-gold-400 text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
      >
        <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gold-400 shrink-0" />
        <span>{active.label}</span>
        <ChevronDown className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gold-400/80 transition-transform duration-200 ${isOpen ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 mt-2 w-40 rounded-2xl bg-black border-2 border-gold-500/50 shadow-2xl p-1.5 z-50 space-y-1 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
          {(Object.keys(localeNames) as Locale[]).map((key) => {
            const item = localeNames[key];
            const isSelected = locale === key;
            return (
              <button
                key={key}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setLocale(key);
                  setIsOpen(false);
                }}
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-gold-500 text-black font-extrabold shadow-md'
                    : 'text-gold-300 hover:bg-gold-500/10 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                {isSelected && <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-black shrink-0" />}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { execFile } from 'child_process';
import path from 'path';

/**
 * Execute a PHP PDO script with JSON payload and return parsed JSON result
 */
export async function executePhpScript<T = any>(
  scriptRelativePath: string,
  args: Record<string, any> = {},
  inputData: any = null
): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const phpScriptPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'php-backend', scriptRelativePath);

    const queryString = new URLSearchParams(args).toString();
    const env = {
      ...process.env,
      REQUEST_METHOD: inputData ? 'POST' : 'GET',
      QUERY_STRING: queryString,
      CONTENT_TYPE: 'application/json',
    };

    const child = execFile('php', [phpScriptPath], { env }, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
      if (error) {
        // If system PHP binary is not on PATH or fails, return empty fallback
        console.warn(`PHP script execution warning for ${scriptRelativePath}:`, stderr || error.message);
      }
      try {
        const jsonOutput = stdout.substring(stdout.indexOf('{'));
        const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonOutput || stdout);
        resolve(parsed);
      } catch (parseErr) {
        resolve({ stdout, raw: stdout } as any);
      }
    });

    if (inputData && child.stdin) {
      child.stdin.write(JSON.stringify(inputData));
      child.stdin.end();
    }
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

interface RateLimitConfig {
  /** Maximum allowed requests within the window. */
  max: number;
  /** Window size in seconds. */
  windowSeconds: number;
}

interface RateLimitResult {
  success: boolean;
  limit: number;
  remaining: number;
  resetSeconds: number;
}

// In-memory sliding window store fallback (for local development or single instance)
const memoryStore = new Map<string, { count: number; resetAt: number }>();

function checkMemoryRateLimit(key: string, config: RateLimitConfig): RateLimitResult {
  const now = Date.now();
  const existing = memoryStore.get(key);

  if (!existing || now > existing.resetAt) {
    const resetAt = now + config.windowSeconds * 1000;
    memoryStore.set(key, { count: 1, resetAt });
    return {
      success: true,
      limit: config.max,
      remaining: config.max - 1,
      resetSeconds: config.windowSeconds,
    };
  }

  if (existing.count >= config.max) {
    const resetSeconds = Math.ceil((existing.resetAt - now) / 1000);
    return {
      success: false,
      limit: config.max,
      remaining: 0,
      resetSeconds: Math.max(1, resetSeconds),
    };
  }

  existing.count++;
  const resetSeconds = Math.ceil((existing.resetAt - now) / 1000);
  return {
    success: true,
    limit: config.max,
    remaining: config.max - existing.count,
    resetSeconds: Math.max(1, resetSeconds),
  };
}

/** Extract client IP address from standard headers. */
export function getClientIp(req: NextRequest): string {
  return (
    req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ||
    req.headers.get('x-real-ip') ||
    '127.0.0.1'
  );
}

/**
 * Checks rate limit for a key using Upstash Redis if configured, or in-memory fallback.
 */
export async function verifyRateLimit(
  key: string,
  config: RateLimitConfig
): Promise<RateLimitResult> {
  const upstashUrl = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL;
  const upstashToken = process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN;

  if (upstashUrl && upstashToken) {
    try {
      const { Ratelimit } = require('@upstash/ratelimit');
      const { Redis } = require('@upstash/redis');

      const redis = new Redis({ url: upstashUrl, token: upstashToken });
      const ratelimit = new Ratelimit({
        redis,
        limiter: Ratelimit.slidingWindow(config.max, `${config.windowSeconds} s`),
        analytics: true,
      });

      const res = await ratelimit.limit(key);
      const resetSeconds = Math.ceil((res.reset - Date.now()) / 1000);
      return {
        success: res.success,
        limit: res.limit,
        remaining: res.remaining,
        resetSeconds: Math.max(1, resetSeconds),
      };
    } catch {
      // Fallback to memory store if Upstash fails
      return checkMemoryRateLimit(key, config);
    }
  }

  return checkMemoryRateLimit(key, config);
}

/** Prepares a standard HTTP 429 Too Many Requests response with Retry-After header. */
export function buildRateLimitResponse(result: RateLimitResult): NextResponse {
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      error: 'Too Many Requests',
      message: `Rate limit exceeded. Please try again in ${result.resetSeconds} seconds.`,
      retryAfterSeconds: result.resetSeconds,
    },
    {
      status: 429,
      headers: {
        'Retry-After': String(result.resetSeconds),
        'X-RateLimit-Limit': String(result.limit),
        'X-RateLimit-Remaining': String(result.remaining),
      },
    }
  );
}
```

### File: `frontend/src/types/api.ts`

```typescript
/**
 * Shared TypeScript types/interfaces that are not owned by a single domain entity.
 * Import from here instead of duplicating across routes and components.
 */

/** API response shape for a gate scan result. */
export interface ScanOutcome {
  result: 'VALID' | 'ALREADY_SCANNED' | 'INVALID' | 'EVENT_EXPIRED' | 'NOT_FOUND';
  message: string;
  guestName?: string;
  admitted?: number;
  remaining?: number;
  invitationId?: string;
}

/** Minimal event summary used in admin and organizer listings. */
export interface EventSummary {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  brideName: string;
  groomName: string;
  eventDate: string;
  status: string;
  adminApprovalStatus: string;
  organizerBusinessName?: string | null;
  isIndividual: boolean;
}

/** Invitation row shape returned by the invitations API. */
export interface InvitationSummary {
  id: string;
  inviteCode: string;
  guestName: string;
  guestPhone: string;
  maxGuests: number;
  tableNumber?: string;
  rsvpStatus: 'ATTENDING' | 'DECLINED' | 'PENDING';
  attendingHeadcount: number;
  isScanned: boolean;
  scannedCount: number;
  qrCodeUrl?: string;
}

```
